themes.label: Accounts banned during recovery attempts
themes.summary: Users who lost access to old or original accounts (after phone switches, lost Game Center or Apple ID access, or Supercell ID linking changes) say that attempting to recover them triggered a permanent or 31-day ban for account phishing. Many report automated bot replies, slow or missing human contact, and rejection of receipts and screenshots as proof of ownership, and several feel they lost their current accounts as well.
themes.recommendation: Audit the account-phishing ban logic for recovery flows, specifically cases where a recovery attempt is made from a new account or device, and add a human review step plus a warning before any permanent ban is applied to players with long purchase histories.

themes.label: Long base upgrade timers
themes.summary: Many reviewers praise Clash of Clans for its strategy, slow pacing and community, but a large share say upgrade times for higher town halls, walls and troops take days or weeks, which pushes them to pay or stop playing. Some note the grind is manageable only with heavy play or spending, and a few mention that the timers are the main reason they play only occasionally. Mentions span Android and iOS across several versions, with the strongest complaints tied to later town hall levels.
themes.recommendation: Analyze upgrade completion times by town hall level and build type (walls, troops, heroes) against player retention and spending data, then prototype a targeted adjustment such as reduced timers for walls or a cheaper mid-game speed-up option, and A/B test it on a sample of higher town hall accounts.

themes.label: Hero Journey rewards disappearing or bugged
themes.summary: Many players report that Hero Journey chests and quest rewards show as 'no longer available' after a quest expires or after they level a hero, and some say rewards and equipment were lost or downgraded with no compensation. Several also say support was unhelpful, and the issue persists across multiple app versions including v18.400.9 and v18.600.5 on Android.
themes.recommendation: Investigate the Hero Journey reward expiry logic on Android v18.400.9 and later to find why claimable chests flip to 'Quest no longer available' after hero level-ups, audit affected accounts for lost or downgraded equipment, and grant compensation with a support macro for those cases.

themes.label: Attacks lost on brief disconnects
themes.summary: Players across Android and iOS, mostly on recent app versions (v18.400.x and v18.600.x), report that a momentary connection drop or network switch during a Clan War, CWL, or Ranked attack ends the attack with a 0% or wasted result, even when their internet is stable. Many say the game does not let them reconnect and resume, and some note that the same drop happens before a single troop is deployed. Several reviewers also point to the game restarting or showing a network error when their other apps work fine.
themes.recommendation: Create an engineering ticket to instrument attack sessions on Android and iOS by logging disconnect, reconnect, and network-switch events during war and ranked battles, then design a reconnect grace window that resumes the attack instead of auto-failing it, and review whether attacks with no deployed troops should be refunded.

themes.label: Builder Base matchmaking mismatched levels
themes.summary: Many iOS players say Builder Base matchmaking pairs them with opponents whose Builder Hall is one or two levels higher, with stronger defenses and maxed troops, so they lose and struggle to earn loot. Several users also say matchmaking seems tied to trophy count rather than Builder Hall level, and a few describe Builder Base as slow and unrewarding overall.
themes.recommendation: Pull Builder Base matchmaking logs for iOS players across Builder Hall 5 to 7 and measure how often opponents differ by one or more Builder Hall levels, then test a version that matches on Builder Hall level with trophy range as a secondary factor.

themes.label: Praise: strategy, clans, and updates
themes.summary: Nearly all reviews in this cluster are enthusiastic praise for Clash of Clans as a strategy game, highlighting base building, troop upgrades, Clan Wars, and the social or clan community, often with long-term tenure of several years. A minority mention a recurring friction point: long upgrade times at higher Town Halls, with one review also citing pay-to-win elements, matchmaking unfairness for mid-level players, and a grind. The concerns are mentioned in passing rather than as the main focus, and the cluster spans both Android and iOS across many app versions.
themes.recommendation: Protect the clan and base-building features that drive this praise, and pull the upgrade-time complaints from reviews mentioning TH12 and above into a ticket to size how many players are affected before changing any timers.

themes.label: Long upgrade times at high levels
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android, mostly at Town Hall 9 and above, say upgrade timers for walls, defenses, heroes and troops stretch to several days or even two weeks, leaving them with nothing to do while builders are busy. Many pair this with complaints that wall and hero upgrade costs are very high, and some say the wait discourages them from logging in.
themes.recommendation: Pull upgrade duration and cost data by Town Hall level and building type, then prototype a reduced timer curve for TH9 and above (for example capping most upgrades at a few days) and A/B test it against retention and gem spend.

themes.label: Global chat removal hurts recruiting
themes.summary: Players across iOS and Android are asking Supercell to restore global chat, which they say was the main way to find and recruit clan members and players. Many say the replacement clan search and recruit system shows inactive players or players already in clans, making it hard to find active members and making small or new clans struggle. Some suggest an on/off toggle, report or mute tools, or a beta to address the bullying and spam concerns that led to its removal.
themes.recommendation: Run a user research study and survey on the removed global chat, measuring how often players used it to recruit and whether an opt-in or toggleable version with report and mute controls would be viable, then scope a ticket for the clan recruiting search to filter out inactive and already-clanned players.

I’ve been playing Clash of Clans on and off for probably over 10 years. Recently I started getting back into the game. Checking out all of the new stuff has been great, but a couple of days ago, Supercell released a massive overhaul to the game’s UI. I’m not one to hate on game changes because they’re new. I play Minecraft and have to get used to that from Mojang. Looking at other recent reviews, I can see that I won’t be the first to tell you that these new UI changes to Clash are… less than optimal. As a matter of fact, while they “simplify” the initial look of the game, they heavily complicate things like building (I can no longer find the build menu, just the upgrade menu which imo was better separated). For some, this may be a good improvement. For me and most others (again judging by the recent reviews), however, makes building confusing. Unlike other reviews, though, I have a suggestion to satisfy both parties in the UI debate. Placing a “Classic UI” toggle button in the settings menu that could allow old school players to revert their UI to the old one would be nice. In this way, new players can still use the newer UI and get used to its less cluttered screen.

To the devs: Please for the love of god, stop making quality of life improvements. This latest Oct 2026 “enhancement” is one of your worst attempts to simplify the game interface. This game jumped the shark a while ago, destroying many of the fun strategic elements that made attacking bases interesting. The heroes are now incredibly OP, making it stupid easy to 3 star most bases, including higher level bases, which should come with some degree of difficulty. With walls essentially meaningless with all the heroes and troops able to cross it at will, base design has become rather pointless. I get that you want to make this game easier to attract little kids, but there has to be a limit to making it as wacky as possible for laughs at super silly attacks with no skill. The last few years have been painful to see a once interesting game devolve into meaningless strategy. However, many of us OG have persevered in spite of these terrible changes because we’ve been playing it so many years and remember how good it used to be. But this latest update really takes the cake in proving how terrible it’s gotten. I understand the desire to consolidate the interface, but how did this update ever pass the user focus group? What a mess! And all in the name of quality of life improvements! You know what would be a true improvement? How about a feature locking the base so no more buildings and especially walls can be accidentally moved by a random finger flick? There’s so many real quality of life improvements that could be made, but apparently, only things that never were an issue get changed. It takes true incompetence to fix things that aren’t broken while ignoring basic flaws year after year.

reviews.t: The new user interface is absolutely horrid and helping to ruin this game
reviews.x: Do not change anything that works well. New UI looks like AI slop and is very user unfriendly. The original UI could have been scalable via vectors and stacked more efficiently as well as flexible for the user. It is now harder to complete the simplest tasks: switching accounts, changing armies, looking at home village and admiring the view, sharing armies/strategies…all while competing in wars without getting a tie is almost impossible. The UI is now counter-intuitive ,and it seems that horrible artwork now takes up more of the screen than the traditional CoC layout. Hire some actual artists and listen to your community. The changes with the gold pass, the ore helper, the cc wait time, A/B testing, changing prior rewards, making F2P more time consuming…hero journey for max players..Change for change’s sakes instead of changing for positive reasons while also looking visually appealing and accommodating to all can be daunting, but it worked well the first 12 years or so. Just refine that, fix the bugs, and help make the game more challenging for those that want it. All of this makes it feel like a bad money grab.

Clash of clans is a classic, and a great game but… the system for upgrading heros is bafflingly terrible. To keep up with upgrading heros, it is extremely expensive. At town hall 15, after completing almost an hour of play, 12 ranked battles, I had enough dark elixer to upgrade 1.5 heros… There are certainly ways to farm a bit faster, but even still, there are 6 heros to upgrade, and would take at least an hour of efficient farming to fill a storage which would maybe be enough to upgrade 3. Upgrades for heros aren’t shorter than any other defense really, taking 4ish days per upgrade at my level, with AT LEAST 10 levels to get through per hero at each town hall, and if you fall behind at all, good luck. To make it worse, while upgrading you can’t use your hero’s, so no war, no ranked, no efficient farming, no practicing strategies, nothing to do, and can’t even work on resources to prepare for the next round of upgrades. If you want to play ranked weekly and keep up with your clan mates, you can’t even keep them continuously upgrading! You have to make sure they are all ready to go for ranked day. As I try to push to level 90 on my hero’s, my enthusiasm to play is utterly killed. The weirdest part is that there is absolutely no one who disagrees that this is the worst part of the game, probably causes more players to quit than anything else, and they have done nothing significant to address it. If we have to get through 41,600 hours of hero upgrades, yes, you heard that right, we should at least not lose the ability to use the hero’s during that time! Common sense.

reviews.t: Clash of clans is better than clash royale
reviews.x: ★★★★★ 5 Stars Clash of Clans is easily one of the best mobile games I have ever played. I've been playing for a long time, and it continues to keep me interested with regular updates, new content, and exciting challenges. The game does an amazing job of balancing strategy, progression, and competition, making every upgrade and battle feel rewarding. One of my favorite parts of the game is the variety of strategies you can use. Whether you're attacking in multiplayer battles, participating in Clan Wars, or competing in Clan War Leagues, there is always something new to learn and improve on. No two attacks feel exactly the same, which keeps the gameplay fresh and engaging. The clan system is another huge reason why this game stands out. Being able to work together with teammates, donate troops, share attack strategies, and compete in wars creates a strong sense of community. Some of the friendships and teamwork experiences I've had through Clash of Clans have made the game even more enjoyable. The graphics are colorful, polished, and instantly recognizable. The developers clearly put a lot of effort into the design of the villages, troops, heroes, and special events. Every update feels well thought out and adds meaningful content rather than just small changes. I also appreciate that progression feels rewarding. Building and upgrading a village takes patience and planning, which makes reaching new Town Hall levels and unlocking powerful troops feel like a real accomplishment. There is always a goal to work toward, whether it's upgrading defenses, strengthening heroes, or improving attack skills.

Secondly, why on earth does a classic mobile game need to have “skins” for the base that cost $40 flippin dollars. That’s insane. I get it. The game is dead. The devs are trying to squeeze whatever money they can out of this dead horse. But my god. It’s depressing to see what has come of one of my favorite childhood games. There’s many other issues but to wrap this up, the fact they got rid of the original ranking system essentially forcing you to do this new PVP “ranked” garbage is just plain dumb. Nevertheless, over all redownloading this classic I was extremely disappointed in the changes supercell has made to the game. Clearly they only care about profit and not the players.

reviews.t: A shell of its former self
reviews.x: I have been playing this game on the same account since 2013. It is very sad to see how greedy the devs have made the progression of this game. I have slowly started to find its more and more miserable to long on and play everyday because of how expensive and also boring the game is now. They have tried to monetize every square inch of this game and made progression for horrible. Since I started playing I have never been a max town hall and over the past like 4-5 years I’m always 1 town hall behind max because just as soon as I become max town hall they release an update that adds a new one and make everything you spent time and money on 1/2 the price and 1/2 the time. They milk you for money to get you close to the top and then pull the rug out from under you constantly. They took away global chat which is sad. I had been paying for the gold pass since its release every month up until recently because I just don’t play anymore. The meta is broken and you can just spam one troop and 3 star basically everything. The single player is a great concept but is neglected and never updated. I remember when town hall 9 was the highest and it was cool, now town hall 18 isn’t exciting at all because of how lifeless the games progression is. This was by far my favorite mobile game but now I’d argue it’s a disgrace to the community that got it to where it is today.

13 years in the game... It’s not just a number; it’s literally half of my life. I started this journey as a young kid full of excitement, and today, I’m logging in as a grown man. Over the years, everything has changed - my interests, my job, my surroundings - but this game has remained the one constant, a sanctuary of stability in an ever-changing world. For me, it stopped being just about gameplay or chasing achievements a long time ago. It’s a part of my history, a digital archive of memories from different stages of growing up. People often ask, 'Why haven't you quit yet?' The answer is simple: it’s a matter of principle and a tribute to the project that has been by my side for so many years. I couldn't bring myself to delete something that has become a part of who I am. Thank you to the developers for this long and incredible journey. We keep moving forward!

The clan system is the best part, you can join a community of people who have daily conversations and help each other out with donations, it builds a real sense of community. There is always something new going on and there is monthly events that keep you engaged and busy. I have played for 4 years and still find tons of interest. It’s the only mobile game i feel is worth my time. You can take a break for a few months or even a few years and your base will be there waiting for you to return. The upgrade times are supposed to be long, it’s supposed to take years to get to the max town hall. That’s the beauty in it. 10/10 would recommend

Not all heroes wear capes some of them just create amazing mobile games. That's how I feel about Supercell. While I've enjoyed many of their titles, Clash of Clans is a standout success that keeps me coming back year after year. The grind can be real; upgrading a Town Hall can feel like it takes forever, but that's exactly what makes it so rewarding. The game's longevity is a testament to its design and I’ve never gotten bored. What truly makes the experience amazing is the social element. Defending a well-planned base, launching a coordinated attack with your clan, and strategizing with friends creates a powerful sense of camaraderie. The game has also evolved masterfully over the years, with new content and a fair progression model that respects players' time and money, making it genuinely free-to-play friendly. If you're looking for a mobile game with endless replayability and a fantastic community, Supercell is in a league of its own."

reviews.t: Breaking Up with Clash After 10 Yrs
reviews.x: Well it’s finally happened. Ive been playing this game for over a decade. Spent money frequently for decorations, sceneries, and skins. My time with Clash of Clans is over. Town Hall 17 is where I stop, I no longer love the game. I adjusted to more heroes. I stuck it out when hero equipment was introduced. This new system has quickly killed my love for the game. It’s no longer a friendly game for the casual player. Now you have a trophy system that punishes you for being good at the game, as opposed to rewarding you. Simply making defenses do more damage and defending heroes have more HP but keeping it at the same TH is just lazy. I liked being able to have a design base set while in Legends and being able to take a breather from the constant raiding, I earned it. I made it to the top. and you took that away. This is the first time the game has been in a state that isn’t enjoyable to play. Do better so I can come back someday.

I have been playing clash of clans for a little over 10 years, and the trophy system is something that has always stuck with me due to its design, functionality, and accessibility. I’ve enjoyed the way it worked for the entirety of me playing the game. Now with this new trophy system rework, the designs have plummeted in quality, the new system is inconvenient, not fun, and is an overall downgrade to the overall old system. You have to wait a full week to rank up, and might not even rank up, or even rank down due to you only having a set amount of attacks and might get unlucky while doing so. It has almost completely ruined all things to look forward to when playing the game and has diminished the fun I’ve had with my recent experience. The only thing I ask is that maybe it can be brought back, but the new trophy system is its own different optional system. The old designs of the original trophy system were interesting and gave a lot of things to look forward to and would mean a lot if it was implemented back in some way.

The game is undeniably good, and I genuinely enjoy checking in regularly. I even spent money early on because it felt worthwhile. But now, I see no reason to keep buying gems - the value drops significantly the longer you play. Anything over a 6-hour build time feels excessive and punishing, especially for loyal players who’ve stuck around and progressed far. There’s often no point in opening the game when all builders are tied up and there’s nothing else meaningful to do. Ironically, I quit this game years ago for the same reason. I came back because I heard shorter wait times were being prioritized, but now it feels like we’re back at square one. Buying gems? I wouldn’t recommend it. You’re just spending money to speed up progress so you can… sit and wait again. The longer you play, the more it feels like you’re being pushed to prolong the grind, which makes the experience frustrating - especially for those of us who’ve invested time and money already.

reviews.t: I Few Changes I Would Like
reviews.x: I know the the supercell dev team will probably never see this but I thought I would throw out two quality of life changes that could make grinding and progressing a little easier. The first would be an ability to combine builders; this would make the end of each town hall get done quicker instead of having 3-4 builder just sitting around with nothing to do. It could be a x1 multiplier for each builder, so if every builder was on one building it would upgrade 6 times faster than if one was on it. That may be a little to broken so maybe it could be %50 faster for each builder. This also just makes common sense applied to real life. The other change would be extra scientists in the laboratory. Like the builders, you could buy the second researcher for 500 gems and the third for 1000. I feel like most people have maxed out buildings and walls for their town hall but never a maxed out laboratory.

Clash of Clans is a legendary mobile strategy game that has dominated the genre since its release. Developed by Supercell, this game is a perfect blend of base-building, resource management, and all-out warfare. Players start with a small village and must gradually upgrade buildings, train troops, and fortify defenses to withstand attacks from other players. The addictive gameplay revolves around collecting Gold, Elixir, and Dark Elixir to upgrade structures and create powerful armies. With a wide variety of troops - from sword-swinging Barbarians to spell-casting Wizards - each battle requires strategy and precision. However, no base is ever truly safe, as opponents can raid your village at any time, stealing your hard-earned resources and crushing your defenses. The real fun begins with Clan Wars, where players team up with others to battle rival clans for loot and glory. The game constantly evolves, introducing new troops, defenses, and game modes to keep things fresh. While upgrading buildings takes time - sometimes days or even weeks - the thrill of seeing your army overpower an enemy base never gets old. Clash of Clans is a game of patience, strategy, and a little bit of luck, making it one of the most engaging mobile games ever created.

Clash of Clans is an absolute blast from start to finish! This game hooks you right away with its perfect mix of strategy, creativity, and pure excitement. Building your village from a humble hamlet into a fortified masterpiece is insanely satisfying - every upgrade feels like a victory. But the real fun kicks in when you take your army to battle. Planning attacks, tweaking troop combos, and watching your strategy unfold against enemy bases is pure adrenaline. Whether you’re smashing through walls with a horde of Barbarians or dropping a perfectly timed Lightning Spell, every raid is a thrill ride. The social vibe takes it to another level - joining a clan, teaming up for wars, and chatting with your crew makes every win sweeter and every loss a chance to rally together. The constant updates, events, and new features keep it fresh, so you’re always chasing that next big upgrade or epic showdown. It’s the kind of fun that keeps you coming back day after day - Clash of Clans isn’t just a game, it’s a lifestyle!” Hope that captures the vibe you’re looking for! Let me know if you’d like any tweaks.

reviews.t: Clash of Clans: The Ultimate Strategy Game Experience
reviews.x: Clash of Clans is, without a doubt, one of the best mobile games ever created. Developed by Supercell, this strategy masterpiece has captivated millions of players worldwide with its perfect blend of base-building, resource management, and tactical warfare. One of the game’s strongest aspects is its depth. From upgrading your village and strategically placing defenses to training troops and launching attacks, every decision matters. The balance between offense and defense keeps gameplay engaging, ensuring that no two battles are ever the same. The social aspect of Clash of Clans also sets it apart. Clan Wars, Clan Games, and the ever-evolving Clan Capital bring players together, fostering teamwork and friendly competition. Few games have been able to maintain such an active and dedicated player base for over a decade. Supercell continuously improves the game with regular updates, new troops, spells, and events, keeping it fresh and exciting. The addition of Builder Base and seasonal challenges further expands gameplay options, ensuring there’s always something to do. With stunning graphics, smooth mechanics, and an addictive progression system, Clash of Clans remains the gold standard for mobile strategy games. Whether you’re a casual player or a hardcore strategist, it offers an experience that few other games can match. If you haven’t played Clash of Clans yet, you’re missing out on one of the greatest mobile gaming experiences ever.

Now, I’ve been playing Clash of Clans since late 2014- early 2015, and the game has really made me happy. I have really loved playing the game, however I feel like it can be overwhelming for newer players. The game used to be much simpler and now they’re adding all of these new mechanics (mostly for heroes). This is more of a suggestion review so, I suggest making more practice mode battles for these new mechanics so players can firstly, understand them, and secondly get better with them. I also think it would be beneficial for Supercell to add more things from the original game for example, the original 2D hero models as skins, and an option to switch between the old troop/hero icons and the newer ones added in 2016. This would bring back a lot of old players to the game and give a sense of nostalgia for existing players (and the 2D hero skins would for sure give supercell a quick buck)

I normally finish the pass then buy the gold one. I finished the pass with 15 hours left and I wanted to buy the gold pass to claim rewards. It was not giving me an option. I purchased through the supercell website and when I tried to activate it said that there is no time to activate and to do it on the next season. I think that’s pretty dumb to do, not everyone will buy the pass right away. I have a pass for next season now just sitting because I can’t use it to claim my current season rewards. We should be able to buy the pass and use it whenever. I understand there are builder boost and other things of the sorts, but I don’t get the pass for that. it’s all the upgrade stuff, heroes/building/spell books that I want.

Since you have no way for me to contact you directly, my grievances will be aired publicly. First, you’ve removed my ability to recruit new players directly to my clan. I have no way to bring in new players, except “publish the clan” which does nothing. And you’ve removed the global chat, so there’s no way to speak to other players about potentially joining. When I published my clan to attempt to recruit new players, I had one player who joined, used all of the attacks for the entire raid weekend, and then left. He/she did all of this before anyone else in the clan realized what was going on. Meanwhile, my entire clan was left with all of their attacks to use, but no way to use them. So, my suggestion would be, at a minimum, make sure that new players who join a clan cannot participate in the raid weekend until they have been in the clan for one raid weekend cycle. Third, we’ve missed the past 2 clan leagues. I’m not sure why. The best I can figure is that we had a published “interested in war” poll in the clan chat, and that somehow prevented us from joining the clan war league. My clan has been around a long, long time. If you guys can’t help me maintain it, or at least prevent its demise, I’m afraid I and my little group won’t be able to continue playing. Lastly, you need to provide some way for us to contact you when we have recognized problems. This is a little ridiculous, but through your website, the app, and even internet searching, there was no other way to get the point across to you.

I recently began playing this game again after a 10 year hiatus. A friend was playing and encouraged me to return. I was seriously behind and I have no issues paying to play a reputable app. I’ve probably spent a few hundred on the game in the past two months. My issue comes with the week long shield. I purchased it over a month ago and again yesterday. The shield allows you to attack but will cost you. I played 3 rounds until I was in league. I signed off with over 6 days left in my shield. I woke up to it being gone. AGAIN. The first time I had not even attacked and it was removed. You’re not allowed a 2 hour shield in League but you CAN have the other shields. I contacted support who basically said they didn’t care, refused to look into it, would not replace my gems or shield, and didn’t care I had been spending money. He was very rude! Well I won’t be spending anymore. That’s fraud. Idc how you want to spin it. You don’t offer a goods for purchase and then take it away. The game doesn’t play itself so if I’m signing off with 6 days of a shield, it should still be intact when I sign back on. As usual the game developers haven’t changed a bit.

reviews.t: Awesome game - addiction likely -- incredibly fun
reviews.x: This is a fantastic strategy game. The game play and the graphics are excellent. When you are first starting out, the game is most fun but once you get to th 9 or 10 the game becomes completely impossible from a defensive standpoint. There are just too many variables and your whole space is literally littered with traps and collectors , etc. it’s just too much. Also the game is so heavily weighted to offense. I left years ago because I had someone attack me and literally take no damage because of excessive spells and healers. I think it would be nice if once you are higher,if you could select a level to play at. I will likely never attack again with my town hall 10, but I am enjoying the versus part because I’m low level and it hasn’t gotten out of control yet. Also what happened to the last 30 seconds free? Now you want gems for saving 15 seconds? One more thing, I’m regularly asked to attack people 2-6 levels higher in the builder hall matching. I am bh4. I’m often attacked by levels 5-6 in the lower leagues. There is a huge difference between level 4 and 6. Sometimes people 5 levels higher attack me and get full trophies. It seems to me there should be a calculation of total power to make things fair, but right now it’s not balanced.

reviews.t: This game needs to give ALL players a chance to compete with each other
reviews.x: This game is the definition of pay to win. You can gem your way to max level in just under a week or so and free to play players can’t experience what people who play can and Thats not fare. It’s so rare that I get a magical book or hammer and everything in the shop is so expensive, ranging up to $50 to $100! This is a mobile game for crying out loud. This game can be fun at times but I can’t do much because of the TIME, OH MY GOODNESS THE AMOUNT OF TIME it takes to upgrade a building or a troop or even a hero. There are 100 hero levels and I have to wait days just to upgrade them once💀. And on top of all that, they keep adding new town halls and levels to Everything and it’s so hard to keep up. It’s like super cell is leaving us behind. This is the reason why I quit for a few years and I might as well do it again because I cannot compete at all. Fix your game and give All of us a chance. Why do we need to pay for everything? You’re already loaded super cell. At least give us challenges to do so we CAN unlock these magical books and gems. And I mean multiple challenges, not the one where you have to get three stars on a base and you get an elixir boost and 25 gems. Please super cell, please. I still love the game at the end of the day but darn

reviews.t: Veteran player here. Its missing one thing
reviews.x: Ive played for years. Thousands of hours. Probably about 6-7 years now. The only thing missing from the game is a function when you lose connection you can resume your attack. On rare occasions ive lost connection because of losing cell signal or my wifi acting up. I think if this occurs the attack should be paused for just a minute or two. And give the player a chance to come back and resume the attack. It happens every now and then. You’re attacking in war league. You only have one chance for your war league attack each day, and you’re in a spotty cellphone service area. You start the attack, put down a few troops then BOOM. connection lost. I think you should give us a chance to reconnect and resume the attack. If this was in the game everyone would give praise to supercell and the devs. The game las a whole would be perfect. I literally cant think of anything else wrong with the game.

reviews.t: After all these years my first review
reviews.x: After nearly playing this game since the first days it were released I’m writing I think my first ever review on clash of clans. Wowza. Clash I’ve loved you so much and it’s been a big game in my life, I don’t know why now I’m just reviewing it. Haha it’s been that fun game while we wait for dinner to come, or attack right before the movie starts in the theater. When we needed you most you were in our back pocket. I think at one point everyone had a serious clash phase. There were definitely some times when I played too much clash. But here we are loving the game more than ever. Just when you thought the game was done, clash was there. So here are some questions and I’d like some answers: for challenges, you let us make our own army instantly but why not us just let us keep our heroes up even if they are upgrading? It makes absolutely no sense. When heroes are upgrading you lose so many players since it’s part of the game so let us just challenge players and use our heroes even through upgrades. It would make it so I could play clash a lot more even when troops are training or my heroes are down. Anyways I wanna say thank you so much for all these years of fun. We love you.

Clash of clans is a online base builder with quite literally endless content. I’ve been playing since I was 8 years old and I’ve still yet to “complete the game”. It has so much content without be over saturated, everything is very manageable and you can still progress without spending hours and hours a day grinding. The systems for upgrading, attacking, and building your base are all very refined and I’ve never had much issue with any of it. The whole game feels very smooth and well put together with play styles for everyone. I’d recommend it for all ages, its characters and story line are very love able and the art style would be appealing to kids while give a nostalgic feel as I get older. Another great thing is you don’t need to purchase anything to make decent progress, you can get anything you need with having to spend money if you don’t want to. The community is also amazing, it has a competitive scene while also having many content creators who make tutorials and give tips for people starting out. I highly recommend the game, I love it and have played to for many many years and I don’t think I’ll ever stop.

Doubtful that the supercell team will read this… ever but in the off chance they do here it goes-> I played this game for 8 years consecutively got to town hall 12 I believe maxed everything out spent countless hours waiting and waiting the dreaded upgrade times for everything and spent a good chunk of change on the game too. I am in love with this game to say the least… HOWEVER the supercell team is absolutly unhelpful in any regards… recently I got a brand new phone so naturally I go to “restore my account with a supercell I’d” and guess what boom never get the emails never anything. So I got in contact with support only for them to tell me well nothing we can do and I haven’t gotten a single response back since then. Provided them with all the info they asked and my most recent purchases player tag village name EVERYTHING and they won’t even acknowledge it. You’d think a game developer of this caliber would go to greater lengths to help their long term players. Very disappointed. Hence the two starts this experience ruined the game for me.

Everything's good. However, I'm not able to track the member contributing to clan Capital. Also, the devs should allow lead and co-lead to modify the rules for new members that join or a board of rules to help members know the promotion, war, and clan capital rules. The priority upgrade in clan capital should also restrict other members from contributing to other buildings to better organize the upgrade. Same for clan wars which allow leader and coleader to customize the base to which mmbr attak

I’ve been trying to get logged in for a long time now after getting a new phone a few times as I’ve gone through a few phones and as a result I got kicked out of supercell. I tried multiple times to fix it but I never got a confirmation email. Tried reaching out to them but as some might know they have mostly automated messages with no actual help. With that being said after some time of no activity they terminated my account without my knowledge and now 5 years of building a base is now deleted thanks to their negligence. They tried telling me that I terminated it but that’s simply not true as I’ve been trying to get back into it with no help from them. I understand automated messages saves time for them but it’s terrible for customer service and helps no one. No thanks to supercell for all that time ive wasted on their game. Can’t stress enough how bad it is to try and get ahold of these guys as after 24 hours or so they make you re start the conversation and start over another automated conversation that you get absolutely zero notifications for so I’ve been dealing with them for weeks trying to stay on top of when they’ll get back to me just to waste more of my time. Thanks for nothing, sincerely a long time player of the game (5 years long time, as I can’t stress enough just about how much time I’ve spent here)

I’ve never thought I’d have to write a review on the AppStore ever in my life, and I didn’t expect it to be on a game which I thought was relatively consistent the past several years, but the matchmaking that came along, I believe in the last update, is just god awful. I am for the most part a maxed town half 13, but I find only town hall 15’s and 16’s, almost always maxed, 90% of the time. Additionally, even if I find a town hall 14, cause for some reason finding a town hall 13 is rare for me now, there is like an 80% chance they offer less than 12 trophies for a three star win. Lastly, I get attacked like 75-80% of the time by level 14-16 town halls and I’m just curious as to why they are finding such luck in lower town hall levels, when I can barely even find a match against my own town hall level. It throws salt on the wound when they are essentially guaranteed a 3-star and for some reason they get to bathe in the trophies I have had to search hard for, for at least 10 minutes, taking 28+ at a time. If not for this highly inconvenient change, I would have recommended this game to anyone, 5 out of 5 stars, but now it’s sort of unplayable for those who want to actually rise in leagues.

As a 5 year player, I used to love COC. It was amazing to join clans, make new friends, and have a blast but all this changed. I started playing in 2016 and I played for 2 years after that. In about 2018 I got burnt out and moved to other games that appealed to me more. I eventually joined the game again in 2020 (covid year) and played for around a year and quickly realized why I got burnt out last time. Then, later, I joined again in 2022. After playing for a while and upgrading my base multiple times, I realized just how long it takes to upgrade my towers and troops( it takes over 8 days to upgrade 1 thing) I have to upgrade hundreds of towers and would then take more than a year just to max out my current base. I also refuse to spend money to make quicker upgrade times and to get gems/ resources. … also, I wanted to point out the costs of the skins and bases. COC is a sucker for money and raised their price to $34 a skin. Thats ridiculous and almost nobody here would pay that just for a skin. With all the ‘upgrades’ comes more ridiculous skins, characters, and money. I love COC for a couple years but after that, it’s just a waste of time and money.

reviews.t: The game has gotten better over the years !!!
reviews.x: Clash of clans has always been a fun game ever since it came out but for some reason I came back years later and i love it even more. One of the reasons being it’s not pay 2 win it’s free to play when Clash of cans first released I don’t know if it was just me but back then, gems were hard to come by now they have added challenges you can do and earn gems without having to pay money just to get gems !!! So amazing it makes the game so much more better and Story mode I think I used to be able to get up Story mode level 3 or 4 I couldn’t remember then it asked me to buy gems because I would run out mind you they would only give you a certain number of gems to start off with I’m not sure how many gems it was but it was low. Maybe like 30 or 40 but overall I love Clash of clans and I’m glad they have added Challenges where you can get gems without having to pay. Thank you Super CELL

Seems like the logic in the game sometimes just decides to not work? Builder base attack and defense were both won and I still lost trophies. So there’s really no incentive for me to play that now. Also the idea that a player at max town hall can intentionally lose trophies to go down to bronze and attack people seems childish for both the player and the devs. You should be locked into your town hall level with all the others of the same level. This is common sense stuff that just is nonsensical. Edit: Gave it one last try on the builder base side of things after the first fiasco. Less impressed this time. Spawned my archers and a bomb goes off. Completely outside of the radius and any splash damage it provides. Not even within range of its trigger detonation. They all died. Again, not in its damage radius. I assume the company has spent enough time and gotten enough money where they are bored with keeping it alive anymore and are waiting to stop making content. They aren’t even trying anymore. $32 for a pointless background that only provides aesthetic. What absolute nonsense. 2nd edit: had archers spawn on a push trap. While still invis they are targeted and killed instantly. They died before the invis wore off. You devs need to find new jobs.

Clash of clans is a legend of a game that has had many users over the years. I have been a part of the game since the early days when it was first released, and had all the fun little quirks. I was with it through its development into the game it is today. During that time there were many changes made to the gameplay that were amazing, such as the builder's base, the clan games, new war system, and the sky base. Now these updates are great additions especially for those whom are maxed out in the normal village, but I have noticed a concerning change in the game. There seems to be an ever increasing number of advertisements for ingame items, along with a larger push to spend actually money on the game for skins or an advantage over others. I worry that Clash of Clans will fall victim too the "pay to win" gameplay and that it will no longer be the Clash we enjoy. This is the reason for my review, I see that this game is amazing and has great potential to continue growing, but it appears to be falling victim to the "pay to win" scheme.

I have played the game since 2017. I use it for fun, and for staying in touch with friends and my brothers. It gives me what I want out of a game, a fun gameplay experience, a challenge for me and the boys to overcome, and meaningful communication that creates memories I hold dear, all while requiring little time commitment. I have short 15 minute periods of being able to game, now that I am married and in my last year of law school. I no longer have the long time periods for long gaming sessions like in my younger days. While, I still like those games, and treasure those youthful memories, my favorite computer games have become dusty and unused. However, clash of clans has grown with me through the years. While I write this review on the toilet at work, clash of clans is accessible to the businessman on the go. You still can have childhood fun and enjoy games that are a challenge as well as seriously meaningful communication with my family members and friends who play with me. Some of my favorite memories are planning war attacks with my little brothers and training them the way they should be or meming with my friends in friendly battles. I look back on my younger years and smile, those were happy times. But I look ahead and see even happier times with my new family and gainful career that I think is fun and meaningful, and I still see clash of clans there with me, in my future years. Its small time commitment and easy access make it one of, if not my now favorite game. As the childhood chapter of my life closes, I cherish that clash of clans follows me forward as I step into adulthood. It seems as though some few things grow with you as you mature in life. I’m blessed to have clash of clans come with me. A fun game, and a great way to stay in touch with friends all while requiring little time commitment. I am thankful for clash of clans.

Golden since start, yet feels dead without a global chat, local chat? Or something to help recruit more players or help boost clan war activity; so many play for a few weeks then drop off to forget their account just remake a new and spend an ungodly amount of cash to rush back; all around amazing game to play and grind just, need more things to do when you run out of attacks instead of trophy or loot push.. night base campaign? What about boom beach, it kinda died off… mash up? Add some to elevate the boredom of completing all star bonuses within a few minutes please, clan war tutorial or campaign for the clan capital.. spend raid medals faster than I receive and not many see the potential of grinding more than the original story line since they’re spread out for progressions with grinding the main base… hopefully this next update or next couple updates we’ll see a qol to resources and time.. advice, focus on getting builder huts then everything else for late game, implement a way to send 100k for 5 gems to clan members seem fair instead of troops while stuck between mid tier with these walls being more than a half a mil each; 10/10 most of my friends spent 500$ just to ghost the game and never come back till an ad brings them that nostalgia. Maybe after each attack it speeds up everything by 1-2% till you complete your star bonuses and that’s if you get a star or something to further progression with mid tier… a hero for clan capital sounds cool till the upgrades takes more time than using in game.. if you’re not careful, easily spend 1k on gems to get half way of max town hall so rush to #9 or 10 if you’re wanting to be useful in clan war and donating troops, just don’t forget your walls if you plan for trophy pushing. Good day

I love the changes made to this game since my long hiatus. I love that troops no longer cost resources and I love that a lot of ingame purchases weren’t artificially inflated like everything else in the world. So I’ll give you 4 stars for the changes. A lot of love goes into this game, but still with waiting almost a WEEK for upgrades?? I wish I had the drive to look for a clan and play this game like I used to, but it’s still the same wait a looooong amount of time while your hero or building is completely down until the upgrade is complete. Maximum should be 3 days, doesn’t matter the townhall level. Time is the most precious and valuable thing we have, and it shouldn’t be used to turn a profit. I can say for sure that I will never play this game as hard as I used to.. since the main reason I quit was long waiting times for upgrades. No thank you supercell, but I appreciate the changes you made. I can at least play a little bit now and here without commitment to a clan like a job that doesn’t pay.

If you lose access to the email associated with your account. It’s basically gone, whether you lose the phone it was on the password or whatever. I reached out and immediately was accused of account sharing and selling my account and it was locked. I reached out again and made an appeal after the first time they locked my account after asking for random information, what year did you start playing, what devices, what old names and and town hall were you. And asks for a receipt. If you get any of those slightly wrong they just lock your account and it’s gone. I told them I’d send more receipts. As many as they wanted from 2015 to now because I was unsure what purchase was tied to what account since I had alts. And instead of asking more questions like they did 1 or 2 of the 4/5 times they just close to ticket and keep the account locked and gone. I’m leaving this review to tell others to give up hope dealing with their horrible customer service. They rush through every case just to close it and move on to the next.

I have played this game for roughly 10 years now. I have had a couple accounts. The one I currently have is an account I max everything on to see all done before upgrading town halls. I have had a lot of fun doing this, but I am now town hall 13. During town hall 12 there was no unlimited heroes event, and I remember that I basically didn’t get to use my heroes for the entire town hall basically. That had almost driven me to the point of uninstalling the game again and finding some new way to waste free time. This update feels like how the game should be at a base. I feel like it is very unreasonable for any hero to be unusable while its getting +300 hp +5 dps when it is already 50 times more powerful than that. Hero equipment has also made it feel like when I upgrade my heroes outside the event that it’s just time to take a break and step away until the upgrade is done. Please super cell make the game enjoyable for normal users permanently.

This game is absolutely amazing. In my opinion it’s the greatest game. Supercell did a great job with all the features and this game has been out for a long time now I got this game when I was 8 years old and that was in 2014 and I have taken breaks from clash of clans but as soon as I click on the app to play again I get addicted for another year and then u take a break it’s a cycle with this game which is good. The format of the game is just amazing u can customize ur base which is outstanding u can basically do anything to ur base. My favorite part abt this game has to be the clan wars. Going to war against other clans is awesome because u get to see other clans potential and lots of stuff, but clan war isn’t fun when ur going against maxed town hall 16 that did a perfect war on ur clan those fellas are just sweats but thank god supercell matches u against people ur level and skill. Best game ever on the App Store DOWNLOAD ASAP!!!

reviews.t: I’ve never written a review this is worth a read especially if your a dev or sum
reviews.x: i grew up on this game honestly and now that i’m older it’s very obvious that there’s sliders to slow you down. now that i’m at town hall 11 and everything takes like 4 days to upgrade which makes the game move at a miserable pace unless you spend money which makes it not only a cash grab but a lazy one at that. i give them credit for the original game design but there is malicious intent in the pace and in app purchases they are almost forced on you at a point and it becomes more pay to win as you get more competitive which is so disappointing because the game could be great if they weren’t ruining it on purpose. it is similar to EA with madden being pay to win (YEAH ITS THAT BAD FR) Im sure if you are reading this you have also seen that anyone who tries to say anything along the lines of what im saying get silenced. basically im just sad that these guys would ruin an iconic game from my like prime middle schools years and ruin it for more money like when is it enough and why doesn’t your community matter to you
reviews.a: this company is a joke lol

reviews.x: ive been playing since 2013 and always enjoyed the game and took breaks for a few months every now and then, once th15 came out i started playing a lot again as the game in my opinion was in its prime, the difficulty is just right,the strategies are fun to use,and the town hall/wall colorscheme looks great. but now with th16 the game is completely ruined. its FAR FAR too easy, and become pay to win. ive spent hundreds of dollars on this game but now that theyve introduced abilities and are constantly adding new ones and glowy ore its very clear its a cash grab especially with the new builder apprentice, and makes me not want to waste even a dime. the game is so easy any idiot can 3 star, wars all end in ties. making it easy at high levels so casuals can 3 star is completely stupid as casuals arent even at such a high level and the ones that are, are rushed. 3 stars at the highest level of the game should clearly only be attained by actually being good at the game, its crazy i have to say this. now theres hard mode completely seperating friendly wars and challenges which doesnt do anything outside of esports. hard mode is also way too easy and should be harder as well as me implemented back into the game. if not, at worst coc should at least implement hard mode in legends league, cwl, and clan wars, its crazy this has not already been done and everyone can see a clear lack of intelligence in the coc team

it is sad to leave such a terrible review, but I think this is deserved well to the supercell company because this needs to be heard. You cannot deny Contant creators for standing up for one another who are far more involved in advanced in someone else but this bad review is for the abuse of copyright infringement. The whole point of America’s free speech everybody’s entitled to an opinion you are owed your opinion, and your opinion should matter whether it doesn’t or it does. Your opinion should be something that people can take or ignore but at least it’s out there to infringe somebody for speaking out for something that was wrongly done to them or anything else on that matter that’s not OK and should be frowned upon in a country that should be exploiting free speech and they have copyright happen isn’t fair, especially to other Contin creators that are being targeted for almost the same reason and they have done nothing wrong except speak out on victims that have been hurt by this if there was a negative review option I would’ve gone to -200 because this is downright appalling. I played this game a lot, but now after this, I don’t even know if I’m gonna even open the app anymore due to the fact that they would stoop this to their own players to the people who have created content for the game to help other people, it’s downright sickening and I wouldn’t have any part of it.

I have played this game for 10 years, obviously enjoying it, but hearing about the recent events with supercell blatantly abusing their power over small creators and esports competitors, I’m just annoyed with them. They are targeting some competitors to remove them from competitions, most recently Max from VM, who was forcibly removed from his team after he qualified for the world championship (which is losing out on the chance to compete as well as a large amount of money). For this to happen, all 5 players on the team would need to agree to change the roster, as well as have supercell approval, but Max had this decision forced on him. Not to mention that they are removing small-medium content creators from their program and or copy right striking their entire channels or speaking out against either the corruption or even just poor game balance / pay to win problems. For all we know, Pcastro was targeted specifically as well, as he was the only player banned for what is a common occurrence in piloting other’s accounts, not only being banned from esports, but having every account he owned that had thousands of dollars poured into, outright perma banned. Clash royale and squad busters have become terribly pay to win, and clash of clans is going down that route now too.

reviews.t: Way to destroy your own community Supercell/tencent
reviews.x: I never write reviews for any of the games I have on my phone/tablet, so consider this a first. I’ve been down with CoC since it’s inception, back when blue walls were the max and “2 stars win wars”, and I have loved this game beyond all, as It helped me thru many dark times, and I’ve met great friends along the way thru this game, it was once a game that was balanced for both P2P and P2W. Then, greed set in. As new TH’s were introduced, so was the requirement to dump tons of money into the game in order to even enjoy 10% of playing it. And now Supercell/tencent go on to show their tyrannical true colors with all the stuff they are doing to our community and the content creators that work day in and day out to promote and keep their games relevant, destroying years of their lives and their livelihoods, all because they exercise their 1st amendment rights to free speech. This behavior is beyond unacceptable, and if losing millions of players in the past due to the greed factor wasn’t enough of a wake up call for you Supercell, this that you just did, will force you to wake up, either that, or watch this franchise tank like plants vs zombies. After 11 years of playing this game faithfully, I’m walking away from it. Now we understand why Darian left. I wouldn’t want to be associated with this either, I don’t blame him.

reviews.t: Love this game, but it needs some tweaks.
reviews.x: I have been playing this game since it came out just about. Been through it all. There are only a few things I would change. All these new challenge seasons need to stop, or give me the option to decline to participate so I can avoid the annoying notifications and “rewards” that are barely even rewards. Secondly, walls. In order to go from th14 to th15 walls i have to spend over 100 Billion in resources, that is ridiculous. Make the price increase by a smaller percentage as the level goes up to make it more doable. If not i’d have to spend a whole year on upgrading walls themselves. Lastly, the builder base needs to be changed back to how it was. It’s 10x the grind to get the 6th builder now and honestly its barely even worth playing because the progress is so much slower. My second account is stuck at builder th 5 because i can’t collect enough gold to finish upgrades while i’ve run out of stuff to do with the elixir. Give us a resource converter building or something to help the players higher up maintain consistent progression. These new updates are much more geared towards th7-th12 it seems.

The only way to unlock some special hero equipment/abilities is by playing during the events they have to collect points and then buy the new hero equipment with the points. If u don’t buy the event pass, u need to use all of your coins or points and u don’t have any left to buy any other event items. u just have enough to get the equipment and it’s usually like (3100 token). I didn’t play for the barbarian gauntlet event, and i never got enough credits to buy the strongest hero equipment for barbarian king. they put it in the shop for 1500 gems. U want me to buy $15 worth of gems so i can get an equipment that everyone should just be able to unlock as they progress through the game? Surely i can save up gems to buy it eventually but it will take forever without buying them, let alone the 4 hero abilities that are available to buy for 1500 gems EACH, and they all seem to have a competitive advantage. PAY TO WIN. Simple as that. Make the hero equipment available as you level up your town hall!! such a scam. U lost my respect with this one. i’m a th14 max and i never thought pay to win day would come to COC.

reviews.t: Awful single player battle match making
reviews.x: Ok what the heck is up with the match making and the trophies? Every single time I go to battle, I only see 2 trophies or sometimes 1 trophy that I can gain from an attack! It’s ridiculous. And it frequent too because I literally just got 3 bases back to back that would only give me 2 trophies. But guess what? Anytime I log in, I’m losing 30 trophies or more. Where are battles where I can make gains like that? Hardly anywhere to be seen unless it’s a base that’s 1 or 2 levels above me; which makes no sense because why would I attack a base that has more defensive power than my army? Seriously, it needs to be fixed because I’m becoming more and more mad every day when I have to spend so much on trying to find a base I MIGHT be able to attack (since I rarely get bases the same level; it’s always higher levels) and I have to fight so much to regain the trophies I lost because the trophy spread is awful. I feel like it makes more sense to have the trophies you can gain from an attack based off town hall level or league level instead of how many trophies the other player has. I really think that’s stupid. Like just think about how much that makes sense. A level 9 base can lose 40 trophies in one go because it has significantly more trophies than a level 12 base…of course the level 12 base player is going to win because they have more offensive power. Please balance the game for gods sake.

COC used to be an awesome game that I enjoyed playing but dear lord the microtransaction madness on this game… While I appreciate there are no ads which honestly amazes me, this is wholly a pay to win game now. Special even troops, event abilities for heros, and so on that you can’t really compete against without having them. I have no interest in spending thousands of actual dollars to progress to a point of being able to compete with people who spend even more time and money than I do in the game. I’ve had the same Town Hall for 9 years and I’ve upgraded my Town Hall once in the last 2 years. I do not pay for anything and I try to utilize Clan Wars and events for resources but it’s not worth the effort most of the time because the upgrades take FOREVER to complete. 11 Days for a single level 1 defense build is unforgivable. The developers know what they’re doing and why. The game used to be fun and engaging and I could play it with my friends, who have since given up on the ridiculous grind. Simply put, the entire game is now a remorseless cash grab that wants all the money, and they want it now.

When I was almost 4 the game came out, and my dad was an OG, and has taught me everything that I know on this game. The game does take time, but is worth every second, minute, hour, week, month, who knows maybe even years spent on the game. The ability that they have combined their games into Squad Busters is an even better idea, but it all originated from Clash Of Clans… Clash Of Clans has always been a long game, and is intended to get mor updates as I’m sure of it, but nothing will ever compare to me being on the couch with my dad watching him play a “really cool looking game that has wizards and dragons.” It has always been fun to see what Supercell would make next, from Brawl Stars to Clash Royale, etc. And the main thing that I love about the game is how even the smallest idea can turn into so much joy, hate, love, and determination for some people. The game is hard, and that is a fact, but if you keep pushing you will too be able to reach high amounts of love for the game. Thank you Supercell and all you have done for my family, keep on dreaming to achieve unimaginable things.

Clash of Clans is an absolutely fantastic mobile game that I keep coming back to again and again. The gameplay is incredibly addictive and satisfying, with a perfect blend of strategic base building, troop training, and clan-based multiplayer battles. The graphics are vibrant and the art style is charming, instantly drawing you into the colorful world of the game. The progression system is incredibly well-designed, providing a constant sense of advancement as you upgrade your village, troops, and heroes. What really sets Clash of Clans apart, though, is the social element. Being able to join a clan, coordinate attacks, and chat with fellow players creates a true community feel that keeps me engaged for hours on end. The competitive aspect of challenging other players and clans is also hugely rewarding. Whether you have 5 minutes or 5 hours, Clash of Clans provides an immensely satisfying mobile gaming experience. I cannot recommend this game highly enough - it's an absolute must-play for any strategy or multiplayer game fan. Supercell has truly created a mobile gaming masterpiece with Clash of Clans.

reviews.x: I enjoyed this game for quite a while until I got to Townhall 11 or so. All the upgraded timers were getting really really long and even before that I just didn’t really want to upgrade my defenses or army camps because it would take a while. like in my builder hall base just to upgrade my Townhall it took seven days a week that’s just way too long a similar thing happened with training armies. All the new troops would be cool and I would want them in my army, but they would have ridiculously long upgrade times and with increasing level on army camps I would be able to train even more of them for my army this might sound like a good thing, but having to wait an hour just to go on an attack that lasts three minutes. They did a great job with the base of the game no questions about that . However they made certain kinds of troops and spells SO overpowered there’s no stopping them . So more balancing would make the game nearly perfect . Example - lightning spells , lightning dragons over - powered needs to be nerfd you can drop the spells and destroy all a persons air defense once u hit TH11 ? no they need to be taken down minimum 25% . Lightning dragons same thing the attack should be shortened to fewer buildings in the chain you can’t have certain units be OP . Unless your going to add in another type of defense that counters that . Things that need to be buffd would be PEKA , Airdefenses of some kind. please for the love of god make it so you can use heroes while they are upgrading. at townhall 13 it takes about 70 days of upgrading PER HERO. add this to the fact that heroes are all but necessary to attack successfully, and that the new equipment upgrades almost entirely remove the benefit from upgrading them in the first place. upgrading them used to upgrade their abilities, but now it just adds a few hitpoints and damage. I don't even care that it takes 70 days, increase the time it takes to upgrade for all I care. I just think that it is absolutely ridiculous that you are locked out of using your heroes for so long unless you spend hundreds if not thousands of dollars. you can still use troops while they are upgrading, and in clan wars upgrading defenses are still usable. it just makes no sense to draw the line at heroes and have them be the only thing that is completely unusable while being upgraded. especially when it takes away from the main draw of the game which is attacking. you spend the entirety of upgrading your base per townhall level upgrading your heroes so that by the time they are maxed out, it's time to move on to the next townhall level. you literally spend more time without having usable heroes than with them, making attacking less fun knowing it would've been 3 stars if you had all of your heroes accessible. not to mention clan wars. almost every clan asks you to opt out of wars if your heroes are upgrading because of how essential they are to a successful attack. tldr: having heroes be inaccessible while upgrading seriously takes away from the enjoyment of the game in all aspects; defending, attacking, clan wars, and clan war leagues. please consider changing it now that hero ability upgrades work differently.

I have played this game on and off for almost 9 years. I recently started playing for 2 months straight but realized why I stopped playing in the first place after 4 years of not playing. I have spent less money than others on this game but feel like the only reason to waste money on this game is for speeding up building times. Then, I play consistently to earn trophies, but go a week or two without attacking on multiplayer as I am waiting for troops and defenses to upgrade. However, I drop back down more than 800 trophies. This is very discouraging because I don’t attack any bases, but I am still losing the trophies I worked for. I would not mind if I lost 10-15 trophies each time, but I am losing almost 25 or even 30. And then when I’m finally ready to attack, I only earn less than 10 or 15 trophies each time. I have to be searching for 10-15 minutes for a base that will give me 20 trophies at best. The events and weekend raids offered are the only things I enjoyed playing now after 4 years, but I do not look forward to spending anymore money or reinstalling this game in the near future.

The game overall I suppose is alright? Lots of main things have to be done though just so you win. My main issue is the battle pass. It’s close to being 10$. It’s not much, but it only last for a month before the ‘season’ ends. Other battle passes in other games have done it 50x better by just lasting more than a month. Those games that have better BP also are better game just because of this game’s BP. Also, other BP games (some) allow you to buy the next BP with the currency you get from it. Not this game! Not only is it close to being 10$, always resets after every month, you have to always buy the BP with your hard earned money, but it’s a game all about having to wait for things to be built!! Sure you can speed it up, but with real money.. Value from the BP is lost just because things are being built. There’s only enough builders to go around and build. I mean sure it gives back in other means but after that, what else? All what was given gets eaten up. You have to REBUY the BP again just to get more. How the BP works when thought about is just a major L. Nothing can be done to make it worthwhile, unless it’s as extended as, let’s say Apex Legends or COD. And or being able to rebuy the next BP with what was made from the BP. Like if it gets bought for actual money, the user can buy the next BP, and so on and so forth. If the user is doing it free though, they can go through 2 BPs before being able to join those that have already placed money into the BP. Just an epic idea.

reviews.t: A few suggestions but great game
reviews.x: This has to be one of my favorite mobile games of all time. I love the game early on because the upgrade times are short but as you go on and progress through the game it gets less fun because everything takes way too long. I’m a th12 and all of the major upgrades are more than 4 days. The prices also get ridiculous because you will have to save up or farm so much loot for one singular upgrade. My suggestion is that you start making the upgrade times less and maybe reduce each upgrade by like a day or so so you don’t have to just not play for the time of your upgrade. reviews.t: Clash joined the pay to win trash, sadly
reviews.x: First thing you should know when reading reviews, any review prior to update 16 is not the game you would load and play today. Prior to update 16, this was a pay to advance game. In other words, no one could purchase anything that wasn’t available to earn by playing. Packs you bought only sped up your progress, and gave you no winning advantage because you are matched with people like you. The absolute beauty of Clash before this update, is that you could take a break and come back and nothing was lost. You start where you last were. With the advent of Hero gear in update 16, makes this a pay to win game, which is honestly just trash games that do not last. If you take a break you cannot come back with no loss, because gear that was offered while you were gone cannot be earned again. The legacy gear that has been around since the beginning is the lowest class of gear. The highest gear is only offered in limited time events, so if you miss it, you are behind. That gear is only upgraded with orbs, which can only be earned with daily star bonus or wars. Sounds good, except they offer packs where you can buy orbs with money which is 100% a pay to win feature. Additionally the matching feature of opponents does not factor in your gear versus their gear. So, if you don’t have the gear, you will not win. From five stars to two stars with update 16. Dying game I suspect.

I loved Clash of Clans for years, always maintaining a maxed base and playing competitively. To focus on life, I would take a few months break now and then. During my most recent break, Clash of Clans released a new feature where you could link a phone number to your account. Right after this was released, someone hacked my account and put in their phone number. I have years of screenshots and proof that it’s my account. Since I wasn’t playing actively at the time, I only realized my account was taken when I got a message from a clan mate on discord. I assumed Clash of Clans support would be there to assist me with my problem. I tried for days to get through to them, but they refused to listen, and even assumed that I was trying to hack the account. I needed a human support member to verify that it was indeed my account, but they were so confident that their new phone number verification system was foolproof that they shut down any account that I tried to use to contact support. I even contacted their team on email, and was again rejected. After 10 years playing the game and thousands of dollars spent on my base, I have nothing to show for it. I’m not really sure where to go from here.

I love the game, only issue is the upgrade time, I personally feel as if maybe you should make the price of things higher, but get rid of the upgrade timer or at least reduce it, think about it, we’d be spending the same amount of time on the game but we’d be doing something like doing constant raids and such trying to get our money up and on top of that you could still make money on it by just allowing people to buy gold with real money I know you already have that but still I think it would make the game a lot more fun to play if you at least lowered the upgrade timer on like the heroes, they’re a very crucial part of every raid and every war and if I don’t have them for 4 days how am I going to participate and be a help to my clan in the war. All in all I love the game I’ve been playing for a long time but I just think it’s so excessive with the build and upgrade time.

Addressing these concerns necessitates a comprehensive review of the gaming experience. Opting out of notifications for incremental improvements is seen as a way to extend uninterrupted playtime, acknowledging the player's preference for immersive sessions. However, there's a notable discrepancy in the item-to-gem exchange rates, creating a perception of inequity, where items are sold at 1,500 gems, yet trade at a mere 50 gems. This apparent disparity raises questions about the fairness of these transactions and the underlying value proposition for players. Furthermore, the call for creativity and innovation in content creation is underscored by the financial commitment players make for a premium experience. There's a plea for developers to listen intently to the community, emphasizing that players are not just consumers but integral contributors to the industry's sustenance. The subscription fees paid for new content should reflect a commitment to delivering not only quantity but quality, fostering a sense of investment and value for the player. Ultimately, the request is for a more transparent and responsive interaction between developers and the gaming community. Building trust through fair practices, equitable transactions, and a commitment to delivering novel, engaging content is pivotal for a flourishing and mutually beneficial relationship between developers and players.
