You ruined a great game by revoking Heros' abilities. What's worse is you broke users Trust by taking something away from them that many had spent countless hours and alot of money earning by hard work and playing the game by the rules that you had established. In the new fremium environment, where games are sent updates and users don't buy a fixed copy of a game, Supercell and other developers have been given the trust of users when users spend time and money on a game. Supercell's obligation is to not take away features and abilities users have paid for. You clearly violated Users' Trust when you stripped away Hero's abilities that users had worked hard to earn, just so you could create a blacksmith barracks and make users pay for them a second time. Supercell had built a sterling reputation as a developer, which now been lost in an instant by such employing such shameful conduct. You should have created a second version of the game and let users choose, which one they wanted to use if you were going to make such a big change and revoke features consumers had paid for.

Clash of Clans is without a doubt the best mobile game ever created. It has lasted longer than any other game, and they are constantly creating new things. The developers are absolutely amazing, and you can tell they care about the game. No matter how many times I burn out, I always come back to Clash of Clans. However, once hitting town hall 13 I noticed a problem… Hero upgrade times. A max town hall 12 queen or king is level 65. A max queen or king for town hall 13 is level 75. This requires you to upgrade both heroes 10 times at around 6 days per hero. Plus, the grand warden and royale champion. The cost is almost max dark elixir as well. THIS IS ABSURD. I SHOULD NOT HAVE TO WAIT FOR MY HERO TO BE UPGRADED. I don’t even mind the cost, but the times are ridiculous. The regular defense times do not bother me, I understand the concept. What makes it even worse is if your heros are upgrading, you cant use them in war either. This leads to you not being able to 3 star usually. Either let me use my heros while they upgrade or take the time to upgrade out completely. It’s stupid.

I began playing Clash in 2013 with my son. At that time we both feel in love with the concept of the game. Eventually my son quit playing, but I was hooked. Initially having no clue how to play "properly" I rushed everything having no balance between my offenses and defenses. Over time I made friends internationally with some clanmates and began to learn how I should have been playing all along. Fast forward a bit and SuperCell released Clan Wars. This was everything I was looking for in a game, competition, social engagement, challenge, it was incredible. I went from being hooked to bring absolutely addicted to playing. I slowed down on the rushing everything, began learning the actual game mechanics and began encouraging others within the clan to do the same. Once we had gotten our acts together and fully filled the clan with like minded individuals, we began calculating base weights and doing arranged wars with other similar clans. That was a HUGE pain, but usually worked out and made for some intense gaming. Press forward a couple more years and I'd gained direct access to communicating with SC. I'd given them an open letter to their team from my team in what the game needed next as it seemed like SuperCell had hit a stump and didn't know where to go without player input. Looking at what everything that has come to pass since and everything that has become be part of the game today, they followed the plans we had laid out for them almost perfectly. It's amazing to play a game today that has a development team and leadership that have actively sought feedback from their players/customers like they did and I very much look forward to the continued expansion of the game itself. Thank you SC for both listening and crafting one of the best, not just mobile games, but games overall of all time! It's been an awesome spending the last decade with you add I look forward to the next one!

I used to love clash of clans. I played with my friends during class instead of paying attention in middle school, and it was the first mobile game I ever downloaded. Now it's a shell of its former glory because of corporate greed. When I used to upgrade a wall, I clicked the button to spend gold or elixir, then the confirm button is in the same place, so I can double tab if I'm sure, or exit if I'm not sure. The evil genius at Supercell decided to move the confirm button, and put the "use wall ring" button there instead. This does not improve gameplay or improve quality of life. Supercell introduced a mechanic that people didn't use much (wall rings), and instead of making them better they decided to punish the players by tricking them into using items. Do I hate every moment I play the game now? Yes. Do I get a little closer to suicide every time I accidentally use a wall ring? Oh yeah, and we're getting close to the end. I don't blame any of the original supercell devs, y'all (or at least the 0-1 of y'all that stayed) made my childhood, but the new team and business direction really know nothing better than how to chip at the few good things left from our youth.

Clash of Clans is a great game, but I do have a couple issues with the trophy system. Whenever I try attacking villages, they almost always have ridiculously low trophy amounts (1, 2, 3), and the penalty for losing is having 30-40 trophies deducted. Plus, when my village gets attacked, I also lose 30-40 trophies, and that is expensive to replace. In the builder base, I think it’s ridiculous that the amount of trophies I lose is almost the same as the maximum amount I can gain. Furthermore, why do I have to fight level 7 bases when I’m only at level 5? That’s guaranteed to lose me many trophies. Also, it would be nice if I could gain extra trophies from getting stars from my opponent’s second builder base. Also, could you improve the builder potion? It only applies 10x speed for 1 hour, which isn’t very useful, since many upgrades take well over 1 day, especially in the higher town hall levels. Plus, the price is quite high: 285 gems.

Been playing this on and off since like 2013, I really like a lot of the recent changes, taking a lot of grind out. Makes it a more engaging and enjoyable experience. Now the same needs to be done to the builder base, I've been stuck looking at BH7 for way too long and it takes so. long. to upgrade even a cannon. It's to the point where I don't even look at my builder base until I think the gem mine is maxed. I'm not the type to rush my bases, but that's the only way to stay engaged with the builder base. Now, the latest update included a new upgrade screen. It looks nice, that's about it. You can no longer see roughly how many upgrades are left for towers, it only shows you what the next level will do to the tower, which is a shame. I have fond memories from way back whenever, where I'd get excited because I was nearing the max level of a tower. That just doesn't exist anymore. You can't see how many magic items are left in your storages, that's super annoying. It's also annoying when you go to click on a wall ring to upgrade a wall, only to accidentally hit elixir, or gold instead of the wall ring that you INITIALLY clicked on. Why even allow players to change their minds at that stage? If I click on a wall ring to upgrade my wall, it's because I want to use a wall ring. I can't tell you how many times I've accidentally used the wrong currency since the recent update. It's the same deal for any type of magic item. It's beyond frustrating.

When I was 8 years old I watched my uncle play an interesting looking game while fishing for catfish on the Mississippi river. After I finished off my last bite of the twinkie that my mother forbid me to eat, but my uncle insisted I have, I washed it down with a nice gulp of mountain dew. "What game are you playing?" I asked my uncle, full of curiosity and junk food. "Well kid" he paused for a second probably pondering the decision of wether to upgrade his Town Hall or finish maxing out his towers. "This is Clash of Clans!" He exclaimed as he titled his shiny new iPhone 6s in my direction. The vivid colors on the screen captivated me, and the game's simplistic design stole my heart. In the following months, I diligently saved money to acquire a weathered iPhone 4, giving birth to my own Clash of Clans base. Since then every major event in my real life mirrored a triumph in Clash of Clans. I upgrading to Town Hall 10 the day I got my first girlfriend and on the somber journey home from my grandfather's funeral marked the ascent to Town Hall 11. Now, at 18 years of age with a Town Hall 12, six builders at my disposal, and a flourishing business of my own I have a clear vision for the future. Remarkably, I've never spent a penny on the game, yet owe Clash of Clans for shaping my life.

I’ve been playing this game for quite some time now and over all do really enjoy the game. Its the one game i always come back to knowing i will still have everything and will have uninterrupted game play. The progress over the multiple years from supercell is amazing. But, I have ONE complaint and I will enjoy the game so much better. War. It has been awhile since I have actually went to War in my clan simply because we are all casual players that get back on every once in awhile. I cant speak for regular Wars as i dont remember, but, I do know when it comes to War Leagues it is nearly impossible for low level clans with only 15 people to be able to get any medals or loot because we go up against clans that are level 20 with 50/50 people and half the time a bunch of th 15’s that you have to go against. I think there has to be some balance and fairness to clan war leagues to help the smaller clans level and actually win. For that reason, i made it 4 stars instead of 5 because of that one tiny complaint.

reviews.t: Ten year review from a veteran player.
reviews.x: The developers would probably never read this, but for anyone else here goes. I started playing Clash of Clans for over 10 years ago. Without a doubt this was the best mobile game I played at the time, made new friends and had a blast. I formed over 3 clans that are still very strong till this day. However I left the game in 2019 (burnt out) came back in 2020, left again in 2021 when I was almost fully maxed. Now I was considering coming back until I saw how so many things have changed, the game is even more beautiful than I left it. However, I quickly realized why I left the game as soon as I got back. The upgrade times are absolutely ridiculous, 19 - 21 days for just one upgrade, and I have over 100 of them. Which means I could spend almost 2 years just trying to get maxed if I decide not to spend money. Not to mention the time to upgrade heroes and troops. I love this game a lot, anytime I want to return I immediately get demoralized and quickly reminded why I left in the first place. If more emphasis can be put on resource collection as opposed to upgrade time, this game will be so much improved and it will see many old players come back. The walls are another set of grind, but I don’t mind those because they upgrade instantly. If you’re thinking of playing this game, download it and have a blast, but be warned that after about 8 months the real grind will begin to set in.

reviews.t: It is not the same game.
reviews.x: While it is still called Clash of Clans, it is not the same game that I grew up with. Everything from getting rid of global chat to not having elixir costs for troops anymore have cheapened the playing experience. However, while the developers have come up with new updates that keep the current playing population pacified, I, for one, am not content with just new aesthetics and mini games when there are serious issues that need to be addressed. No longer can you go onto the global chat to see who is recruiting into their clan to make it the best, rather, you now use esoteric and unimportant tags that hopefully show you active clans. No longer can you go into the global chat to expand your clan by talking to clashers, rather, you must now use a generated list of clashers that may or may not be active. No longer can you manage your economy efficiently when training an army, rather, you can just mindlessly spam one without a second thought. Most critics discuss shortening the upgrade times but I am in opposition to this. Those who seek to shorten the upgrade times are lazy and have no grasp of the competitive nature of timing your upgrades. Therefore, the developers must bring back the global chat, unit elixir costs in order to make the game align with its original purpose, to provide a place to get away from the world and to immerse yourself into a thriving community of competitive individuals. This game needs more human interaction!

reviews.t: Overall good game, as always has issues
reviews.x: As the title suggests, it’s a pretty good game. Get it and try it, it’s a fun way to burn time. Now to get in depth, as the other part of the title suggests it has issues. Every game does, no game is perfect. But let me start with a few good things about the game before the bad. It’s the only mobile game where I haven’t deleted it after a few months, I’ve never gotten bored with it. It has frequent updates, it doesn’t have bad graphics like most mobile games ( the graphics aren’t amazing, yet there not under good ). They are quick to fix bugs. I could list more but I still have the bad to say and the reviews already to long. So for bad, upgrading like most games takes sooooo long, I’m at the point to where it takes almost 3 days to upgrade something and I’m not to close to the end of the game. Base Defence is way to hard, attackers have so many solidiers to choose from with different abilities that it’s not even worth it to build walls. It’s not like the ads you see, progression is slow in 5 months your base isn’t going to be as good as they say in the ads. It’s really hard to find a good clan, and if you decide to make your own it’s really hard to get people to join it. There’s a lot more things I could list, but my fingers are tired and the review is long. I hope all the bad things I’ve said haven’t stopped you from getting the game, just try it. And if the developers read this, congrats you’ve made a good game, but please work on the issues listed. Cheers

I absolutely love this game. It’s a lot of fun to play and I really enjoy the grind. I have a few suggestions that I would love to see added to this game to maybe make the grind even more enjoyable. First suggestion is, instead of having one builder working on an upgrade, why not give the option to add more builders to speed things up. I know builder boost is a potion you can buy but why not allow people to combine builders? The next suggestion is similar to the first. When it comes to upgrading troops or spells in the factory, you can only have one troop or spell going. Why not allow both, one troop AND one spell? It makes more sense, in my opinion, to have one of each going since timer progression for items and troops differ. Overall, this is a fantastic game with so much awesome support worldwide and I love the community, I just figured I would offer these suggestions to help develop the game and further its popularity. Thank you.

First problem: The Builder Base troops just don't target onto the building that you want them to from my experience. I have lost about 100 trophies simply because a Barbarian would go around the Builder Base or a Bomber would instead blow up the wall further away from it when an actual building is right in front of it. Second problem: Balancing has always been an issue with this game and it still is today. All I've been fighting are Builder Halls level 5 (granted I HAD 1750 trophies (note: "HAD" because every fight I got was with a BH level 5 and ended up dropping to 1600 as my Hall level 4's troops just weren't enough)). It's as simple as pairing people up not with their total trophy count, but with the player's hall's level. If a level 4 goes against a level 4, the playing field isn't that different. A level 4 going against a level 5 simply because they have equal trophies is very unfair. And the argument of "Then the lower upgraded level 4s would be at a disadvantage"-- would they really be? A full army of one of the attacking troops like Raged Barbarian of Stealth Archer could easily get a very high percent and 1 to 2 stars if played right. So, it would be a nicer experience if matchups were based on Builder Hall level. It would also help with getting loot as you only get three chances to get loot a big chunk of hours. 2023 Update: Builder Base 2.0 is awful. Just go back to the old attack system. This new system has interesting concepts to make attacking more engaging, but it’s just too much of a change and asks for too much player involvement during each attack.

reviews.t: Would be 5 stars if not for upgrade times
reviews.x: PLEASE change upgrade times to be less than a week at the very very most. Some things take two weeks to upgrade which is just ridiculous, especially when your village is a higher level and literally everything takes that long, and you only have 5 builders to work on things at once. I know it’s intended to make people buy gems with real money but I feel like there should only be a couple of things that take up to a week at most and then everything else is a day or two. It makes things really boring waiting for upgrades. Also, it would be really great if you could buy a bunch of shovel of obstacles with gems or raid medals all the time, they are really nice to have with the new addition to the builder base so you can stash some of the cooler obstacles in that base to use for decorating. I have been trying to find ways to get more shovels and there aren’t any at all, unless one shows up on season challenges or weekly deals… which is very rare. Otherwise it’s a really fun game.

reviews.t: Zero way to build an actual clan.
reviews.x: This game is such a clubby little scam.. you can’t search in depth beyond just “search for players who also like this tag we’ve created.” They don’t let you search for players in your region. They don’t let you do a broad search to filter results such as “level, in clan or not in a clan, last time online, etc.” you have to make individual clicks on every random profile they gave you based on nothing at all, they could be a way better player than you, and already in a clan, so you waste your time. I have USED their scammy suggestions, and after 100 invites, I received zero accepts to my clan, despite being higher level than many new players. This is done intentionally by design, and we need to find out why a kids “game” and not a micro-transaction “in app purchases” scheme formula, is operating with such impunity. The internet has tons of forums talking about exactly this problem. There’s no way to efficiently talk to people and get them into your clan. I don’t want to hear your excuses either about how it’s because they got rid of the chat. The game devs are intentionally trying to tie those together by not responding to comment, but chat or no chat, you should have an easy to use interface with an actual search box with filter options, that kids can use. This is not a “kids” game. This is another Tim Apple scam game with in app purchases meant to create addiction in kids and turn them all into gamblers.

reviews.t: Why Clash of Clans is so good!
reviews.x: Clash of Clans (CoC) is a popular mobile game that has been praised for its engaging gameplay, strategic depth, and social aspects. Here are a few reasons why CoC is considered a good game: 1. Strategic gameplay: CoC requires players to think strategically in order to build and defend their villages, as well as to plan and execute successful attacks on enemy villages. Players need to manage resources, upgrade buildings and troops, and coordinate with clan mates to succeed. 2. Social features: CoC is designed to be played with others, and players can join or create clans to work together towards common goals. This social aspect of the game adds an extra layer of depth and engagement, as players can chat with clan mates, donate troops, and participate in clan wars. 3. Incentive to progress: CoC has a well-designed progression system that encourages players to continue playing and improving their villages. As players level up, they unlock new buildings, troops, and abilities, which keeps the game fresh and interesting. 4. Free-to-play model: CoC is free to download and play, which makes it accessible to a wide audience. While the game does offer in-app purchases, they are not required to progress in the game, and players can enjoy the full experience without spending any money. Overall, the combination of strategic gameplay, social features, progression incentives, and a free-to-play model make Clash of Clans a good game that has kept players engaged for years.

I would be delighted to write a 5-star recommendation review for Clash of Clans! Clash of Clans is an absolutely fantastic game that is perfect for anyone who loves strategy games. I've been playing this game for quite some time now, and I must say that it has never ceased to amaze me. The game's graphics are stunning, with every detail carefully crafted to perfection. From the intricate designs of the buildings to the breathtaking landscapes, Clash of Clans is a visual masterpiece. The gameplay is equally impressive, with a variety of exciting game modes and endless possibilities for customization. One of the things that I love most about Clash of Clans is the social aspect of the game. You get to team up with other players from around the world to form a clan and take on the competition. There's nothing quite like the feeling of working together with your clanmates to defeat an enemy clan and emerge victorious. Another thing that I appreciate about this game is the constant updates and new content. The developers are always adding new features and game modes, ensuring that there's always something new and exciting to look forward to. Overall, I would highly recommend Clash of Clans to anyone who loves strategy games. With its stunning graphics, engaging gameplay, and social aspect, this game is truly a masterpiece. So, if you haven't tried it yet, give it a shot – you won't be disappointed!

I’ve been playing clash of clans for several years and for the first 10 town halls you have a great game. After town hall 10 the upgrades are ridiculous. I am a town hall 12 and I spend more than a week at a time sitting inactive waiting for upgrades to finish. All of my builders are busy and my storages are full. I can’t even participate in wars effectively because my heroes are upgrading. Each upgrade takes around 10 days… each one… and there are still 3 town halls after town hall 12. So if you haven’t started playing clash of clans yet, don’t bother. It will take you more than 10 years to max everything out without spending any money and when you get into the later town halls all of the game play is boring and repetitive as you wait for upgrades to finish. Almost every complaint that supercell has for upgrade times has just been disregarded and not fixed. They have attempted to slap bandaids on it with league medals and adding more bases but they never fix the problem they only distract their users from it.

reviews.t: Requesting Easily Implementable Fix to Reach Wider Audience
reviews.x: Practice mode should allow you to choose one of your armies in quick train, and then attack an another player’s base using existing matchmaking mechanics. No trophies/resources are won from these battles, and the opponent doesn’t lose anything either, or even know someone interacted with their base. It takes zero time / elixir to train your army for these practice battles, so you can play as much as you like. The “battle whenever you want” concept is present in clash Royale, but not clash of clans. That’s the reason I play the former, but hardly ever the latter. The attacking gameplay is very fun, but waiting around for buildings / training to finish disrupts the flow and makes it not worth it. If I could attack whenever I want with whatever troops I want, simply for the joy of nonstop no pressure strategy, I would likely play this game much more often. Maybe a lot of other people who only play clash Royale feel the same way, and implementing this feature could attract a wider yet already nearby audience of existing supercell fans back to the game? If successful, a separate trophy league could emerge to give some competitiveness to this nonstop attacking style gameplay. Thanks!

reviews.t: Decent game but serious raid imbalances
reviews.x: This is a really good game. It’s fun to play and progresses reasonably quickly. I’m fairly new to the game, and it has been an every-day play for me. However, I DESPISE the raid and trophy system. The way it works is, you do a raid and you win, you get trophies. If you win against someone raiding your base, you also get trophies. But the way the attack unit system works, it’s difficult to attack someone at the exact same level as you, forcing you to attack players a level or two lower than you. However, this makes it almost impossible to win defenses. And the protection from raids that you get is diminished by raids you do afterwards. So basically, I do a few raids, earn some trophies, and then log off, but then I have very little time left on my shield, so I lose all the trophies that I earned from playing that day and some more. That and raids have been getting difficult for me, and don’t get me started on castle reinforcements. Overall, this is a great game but I and many other people would appreciate it if you perhaps changed the shield systems or matchmaking systems.

reviews.t: Lost gems and a hammer - support says “too bad”
reviews.x: I was waiting for an upgrade to finish on my Royal Champion. It had about 1.5 hours to go or 29 gems to finish now. My plan was to finish that upgrade with gems then use my hammer on my King and start another upgrade on my King. When I tapped the gem button to finish the RC, it prompted confirming I wanted to use gems which I confirmed. My gem count went from 352 to 323 as expected. When I went to upgrade my King, my hammer was gone. Nowhere to be found. I opened the in-app support and chatted with “Esteban” who confirmed twice that I used my hammer but wouldn’t touch the subject of why my gems also went down. I tried three times to reason with him that I was reporting a bug however his repeated replies of “we’ve hit a dead end” told me he didn’t care to check further. I’ve been playing longer than I can remember and even dropped not-so-small amount of money on it. I’ve never really had issues I needed to contact support for. This does not give me any hope that if I had an issue with an actual purchase that SuperCell would be there to help.

Lookin do a distraction and mind builder, and decided to try an old game I played years ago. A great way to spend those sub-zero days during our very cold dark winters here in New England. Read guides and Google suggests FIRST is a must or you realize many "town halls" later your strategy has put you behind the game. DONT upgrade Town Hall until you've patiently upgraded items, there's a map eatery that pls you create a "map" for upgrades during "shield" time. There are some sweet inexpensive packages to help you on your building and upgrade ventures, just don't get carried away w the "deals". You can also earn easy funds by doing single player attack that doesn't shorten your shield. For me, it's using enough brain power to feel like I'm learning some useful skills ( trust me you do) but not too much to make it too challenging or taxing ( like some other rpg games). For an improvement, I'd suggest giving motor tutorials or help buttons for these exact time savers and strategy improvers so you don't stumble upon them the way I did first time around. It doesn't have millions of players a decade later for no reason. Try it, you'll LOVE it. 💜📋💣💰⚔️🏰💪🏻👌🏻

i’m not sure why i come back to this game for a month or two every other year but it will stop. upgrade times are ridiculous. battles with TH 13-15 is nearly impossible to enjoy because everyone spreads their base to the edge of the screen. therefore, troop deployment has a small margin with lots of error. i ditched the main base for the builder base battles, just for that to now be programmed for error. you’ll drop a troop, (e.g. hog glider) it’ll lock onto that specific defense and land on it, but turn and attack a different defense. huh? you’ll drop the battle machine directly in front of a wall but it’ll avoid that wall and wall all the way around the opponents base, losing all its health on the way. huh? you’ll have 4 minions die to the archer from the defense post before any single one even reacts. how sway? i’ve had a hog know the health from a defense down all the way to 1 hp just for it to pause on the last swing and somehow completely die, with the defense still standing. the algorithm and programming is full of cheats. wait times for upgrades are ridiculous. why would i wait nearly two weeks for an archer tower upgrade, a hero upgrade, any troop upgrade?? stop redesigning games - that were initially fun - with an ulterior motive of monetization, having people pay for gems for faster upgrades & a better playing experience. that’s why this whole game went downhill.

Really the only thing I can pick at, my one wish if I had one to improve the game now, would be to allow players to buy gems with excess currency. I enjoy this game for many of its functions. I enjoy the battling without all the gore, so it can be played with people who are conscious of these things. It has a ‘Join Clans’ and a ‘Add Friends’ function if you want to play with family members and friends, or make new ones. It has an original layout far different from most games, that is fun to play. The only things that are negative about this game is the wait time, how all the sceneries, magic items and perks have to be bought with real currency and not in game gems and the ‘Clan War’ function. If the wait time for everything was cut in half people would be able to play without one hour to three day waiting periods which would cause people to play for longer periods of time. If the sceneries, perks, magic items, e.t.c, were able to be bought with gems, players would have more freedom in purchase options. Lastly, if players could have infinite ‘Attack’ options people would be even more attracted to the game since they wouldn’t have to wait for the war to end. Other than those obstacles, this game has comical graphics, a little bit of strategy and fantasy creatures with both great styles and different attacks. Once the obstacles are fixed I believe that this game will receive a lot of better ratings from old-time players and new ones.

I have been a fan of Clash of Clans for many years and it remains one of my all-time favorite mobile games. The gameplay is incredibly addicting and the strategic elements are well thought out and challenging. The graphics are top-notch and the character design is unique and visually appealing. I love the clan feature and the sense of community it fosters. It's always exciting to participate in clan wars and work together with my clanmates to come up with the best strategies. The developers are always releasing updates and new content, which keeps the game fresh and exciting. There are always new challenges to tackle and it never gets stale. The only downside is that it can be a bit of a grind at times, as you have to continuously upgrade your buildings and troops to stay competitive. However, this is to be expected in any strategy game and it's part of the fun. Overall, I highly recommend Clash of Clans to anyone who enjoys multiplayer games with a focus on building and strategizing. It has definitely earned its 5-star rating in my book. The combination of challenging gameplay, beautiful graphics, and a sense of community make it a must-play for any mobile gaming enthusiast.

reviews.t: Most Frustrating Waste of Time Ever
reviews.x: Clash has been an amazing game to play and to forge friendships in alliances. But all that has changed. If I could give zero stars I would. The latest straw on this camels back has been clan capital and the raid weekends centered on it. The development team released a patch that nuked a lot of people’s attacks for the raid weekend making it impossible to attack. When reaching out to the “support team”, they reported that this was a known issue and was being “worked on”. Apparently they broke their system really well as after 4 days there is still no fix, no compensation for the troubles they have now caused, no estimated fix eta, and no other information provided. Many people pay a lot of money to play this particular game, so there should be an outstanding development team along with a knowledgeable support team. As a developer standard operating procedures when releasing new patches is to TEST the patch before going live in a production environment. By skipping that all important step, they have a broken system that they don’t know how to fix. I’m not sure how the App Store validates applications but this one needs to be removed from the App Store until all of the game issues are 100% fixed. Worst “support” I’ve ever experienced.

In the beginning this used to be one of the more enjoyable games of its genre. In the last few years it’s fallen into the black hole that is micro transactions. Every single mobile, console and PC game has, to one degree or another, done the same thing. Time monetization on paper is good. Good for the dev, good for share holders if there are any and for players who don’t have a lot of time but still seek some enjoyment and entertainment in their lives who choose to speed up certain aspects. A trade off of time at work for time in game sounds great! Alas game developers, weather the grunt at the keyboard or the suit and tie that has never logged an hour in the game, has shifted the development strategy to maximize the use of micro transactions. The defensive AI in this game has been dumbed down to be almost random in it decision making, if not intentionally illogical as to nudge you into spending money to make up for lost time. It seem that any small world event, holiday, your dogs birthday, or even the neighbor painting the fence now has a slew of new purchase options. It’s no longer fun to play. I can’t and wouldn’t be able to recommend this to anyone anymore. Like moths to the flame, game devs today only see dollar signs. One day, hopefully before it’s too late, they will realize profits don’t matter when no one is playing at all.

reviews.t: Unless you go to COCU this is not for you

Just attacked in CLW, maxed heros and pets and war troops, penetrated the center of the base and ended up with 42 percent. It isn’t about defences or troops anymore, it is about base design and how troops are programmed to attack and ignore certain targets for the purpose of balancing I suppose. reviews.t: Fun… until I could never play again.
reviews.x: This game is a lot of fun. Plane and simple. It’s probably one of the best mobile games out there. This review is not to critique the game itself but the process within the game to combat cheating. More specifically I’m addressing action against account phishing. While reaching out to supercell to attempt to solve how to connect my account with an old account from another email I was faced with the receipt of an in game purchase I did not remember but it wouldn’t surprise me if this had come up a long while ago. In contacting the “help group” I never spoke to a single real person, only bots. When I denied that I had a receipt to validate I was banned. Not for a week or a month, forever. To resolve this, I reached out to supercell using every figment I had. Signing into my old account on my old phone and reaching out, going to the supercell website, emailing, even downloading boom beach to see if there was a help hotline listed anywhere. I received no help, and no contact from a single person. TLDR: play this game, please, it’s very good. Just don’t count on the customer service because even though the game is good, it’s still just a mobile game.

reviews.t: Way too expensive and much too long upgrades.
reviews.x: Clash is a wonderful game but it is plagued with non game nuisance like upgrade timers and artificial length. The game could be about playing it but it becomes just about waiting for upgrades to finish 95% of the time. The solution clash of clans introduced from the beginning I believe is still just spend money to speed things up. If I wanted to catch up to another player that has been playing longer than me, I would need to spend hundreds of dollars maybe even thousands to speed up something that could be a click of a button. The game isn’t even about raiding to get enough gold or elixir, it’s about playing for a day in between a 3-7 day window while you wait for your town to build up instead of playing the game 3-7 days to earn enough resources to upgrade your buildings. The involvement with clan wars and I guess the rank system are the only thing you could consider to be daily playable progress and you are going to hit a level of base you can’t make progress on until your troops are high enough level eventually anyways. It’s just a shame that this could be a game I play instead of a game I look at. I shouldn’t be angry at a simply game but it’s hard not to when I look at it and can’t upgrade or progress for 5 days while my builders finish making my air defense do ~5-10% more damage maybe. The clan bases and daily incentives are cool but it doesn’t matter when you have full storage for a week and can’t do anything.

It’s a great game, the original hit from supercell that is still not only relevant, but popular, with great gameplay and excellent co-op and clan features. My only complaints are the time it takes to upgrade things at townhall 11 are already getting pretty insane, and the game eventually turns into a waiting game, especially when clan events are in the off time. You could always grind builder base, of course, but it’s still annoying when the quality upgrades take a week+ to upgrade. I wouldn’t be opposed to a price increase in exchange for shorter build/research times. Resources are an issue, or would be, if it weren’t for the timers. I can see why the system is the way it is, but I still feel that having your research laboratory clogged for 9 days so you can get a single troop leveled up is too much. But I’m just listing my complaints at this point. There’s so much of value in the game, and these are the only things I complain about. (If we’re throwing balance out the window, can we just make the inferno tower useless? :P) regardless, 10/10 would and have recommended to friends.

reviews.t: The game is pretty good. Except . . .
reviews.x: Ok, here!s the catch. The game itself is fantastic. But good stuff also keeps getting taken out of the game without an exchange. So since the chat has been taken out and made the clan joining obscenely difficult, how about making it so that the gem amount is cut to 1/4 for stuff, and perhaps making it so you can watch advertisements to skip 20 minutes at a daily max of 30? That is fair, wouldn’t you say? I mean, it would also make up for some annoying stuff in there like repetitive catchphrases or sounds like from the heroes, Pekka saying “Butterfly” when there is one nearby (even though it’s a bit funny), and the valkyrie . . . I know the sounds she makes are accurate to a real valkyrie, but it’s HELLA ANNOYING! And 500 gems just to change a name? That should be 100, but it’s not. So cutting the gem amount to 1/4, making it so when you’re at the last 1 min then it’s free, videos to skip 20 minutes with a daily max of 30, I think that’s fair. What do you think?

I’ve been playing this game for a couple of years now and it’s the only mobile game that has kept my interest. The developers are not greedy. They routinely give away in-game items through events or the in-game store. I happily spend a little money each month for a load of additional free stuff through the gold pass or special offers. This game is absolutely accessible to completely free-to-play players though, as even those of us who spend a few bucks don’t get any advantages over anyone else in war. At best, it helps speed up some base building and research, but this effort stays relevant for a while so you don’t feel your money was wasted either (unlike grubby Final Fantasy Empires). This game has proven staying power and will continue to make revenue unlike the disgusting cash grabs we are subjected to by other companies (looking at you Diabo Immortal).

reviews.t: My favorite game of all time
reviews.x: Clash of clans has Ben around for almost 10 years. And it is so addicting! I have 4 accounts and I love all of them. Watching people play this is fun. But playing is is better! I have a few suggestions though. Add something to the builder hall. The builder hall came out three years ago! And the last time it ever updated was 2 years ago. There is a lot in the game. Clan capital. Clan wars. Clan games. CWL. Trader. A lot. Battle machine and archer queen need A.I work. And add something to the witch, headhunter, bat spell, and skeleton spell. Add more leagues after legend. Add more practice attacks and more goblin maps. Reduce training time to the home village. It takes 33 minutes to train super barbs and healers. Maybe cut it down a little bit. And the most important, upgrade times. It takes 17-20 days for upgrades at th14. Any upgrades starting at th9 gets up to 6 days. The lab should be cut down. It takes 2 to 2 in a half weeks to finish a lab upgrade which is ridiculous. Anyways I will always love your game. Great work Supercell.

reviews.t: Fun game that is ruining itself
reviews.x: They have not expanded the main play of the game (home village) in quite some time, though they keep introducing new elements to distract from that fact. The new elements are entertaining at first, but there is never enough thought into what to do with it beyond the original distraction. The builder village has stopped getting new updates, at an even bigger level than the home village, and now they’ve introduced a new village in the sky all without adding to the original game play that got people interested in the game in the first place. In addition, they took away global chat which effectively killed recruiting same language speaking clan mates. They also chose to eliminate troop costs which was one of the few strategic elements left in the game. Now advanced players have full storages with no way to spend them down….effectively eliminating any reason to attack other villages…ie, play the game. They have also decided that national flags represent a problem with their gameplay and removed them as well. Really fun game five years ago, but supercell has lost its way on how to keep the game fun and relevant.

It doesn’t make sense that y’all (supercell) approved their name but won’t let others mention it. Pleas fix this issue as soon as possible. I would also like to see art for the trap upgrades when I upgrade them just like you do for all the other buildings. Also any plans for builder hall sceneries? Maybe do co-sceneries for the builder hall and town hall? That would be amazing! One more thing, maybe add battle machine skins? reviews.t: Great game but a couple of suggestions
reviews.x: Overall this game is great and I love that you can’t max out instantly but the time it takes is insane. Around town hall 11, the price go up but more importantly, the time is insane where almost everything is at least 7 days. The worst part is that sometimes the upgrades don’t even seem worth it cause it adds like 5 damage and it adds a spike to the design. More than decreasing the prices, it would be better if upgrades took less time because honestly, how does an upgrade take longer than the actual building time. Regarding the clan capitol, the forge takes 3 days to make 1600 capital gold (I think). I just think it would be better if it didn’t need a builder or if it was way less time. Another suggestion involves troop training, as you know, there are barracks and dark barracks (same as brewers) and upgrading barracks, in no way involves dark troops, so what I was thinking is that maybe you could train barrack troops and dark barrack troops at the same time, so that it takes less time. It’s fine if it remains the same cause you can already use training spells, but if this feature was added, you could repurpose the training spell. Other than that, it’s a really good game and you will play for a LONG time.

reviews.t: Clash of Clans is better than Clash Royale
reviews.x: Clash of clans is a very solid game that forces you to think about your choices. Should you spend gold here or someplace else, should you upgrade this or a mortar, how will you place your building so they can’t be attacked by enemy troops as easily, etc etc. This gives a challenge to the game and makes it more fun, which is helped by the solid gameplay loop and balance. Clash Royale however has many problems when you get to higher arenas(during mid ladder) many of which have some of the strongest cards in them. Elite Barbarians, Mega Knight, Firecracker, Witch, Freeze, Electro Dragon, goblin barrel, etc. and I should point out that two of these are cards that are the lowest rarity in the game. Elite Barbarians deal a massive amount of damage alone but there are to of them. This is just one of the cards and the rest are equally annoying, but everyone uses them and then puts on a “holier than thou” act. And it makes me mad that Super Cell dose nothing about it.

I started playing in high school, stopped for a few years and then came back after college so spanning almost 10 years and this have been a great game. It’s well balanced, stays engaging, and has consistent progression. Also after coming back years later it was awesome to see they kept the core gameplay while also expanding with new features. The capitol in particular seems like a great new addition - I just went to TH14 and almost have a max Ed builders hall so cool to see something new to put those resources toward My minor critiques for the devs are: - the lab shouldn’t tell me to research when I don’t have the resources too, just like the collector tooltips - even more season pass rewards! I generally finish a bit past halfway through the month, so more rewards would be awesome. The last week of the month I generally don’t play much because my rewards and season bank are maxed out. You guys could follow the approach that you did in brawl stats and after you unlock the hero you can just keep getting resources by getting more season points. After getting back into that account I wasn’t receiving the verification emails. So I reached out to Suppercell for support and after a message or two they asked for the receipt to my first or last purchase and which device I played it on last. I didn’t really think of it very much, I just thought it was just some another game( at this point I didn’t know it was made by the same people), but I decided to download it cause it looked kinda fun. I wish we didn’t have to grind or wait so long for things to be upgraded I hate that it can take 5 days just to upgrade something it makes it very time consuming and the game get repetitive. It can take up to four to five months to even get to max which honestly I think is the most ridiculous part about this game it is a game you don’t won’t to play constantly cause then it gets boring and I get bored easily cause this game does waste a lot of the time and being nineteen and still playing this game I find it much harder cause I do have to work and do things so I get busy and if I forget to even upgrade one thing it sets me back and I hate that but besides all that it is a very fun game and I treaty enjoy it alot and I will continue you to play it.

Although it’s free to play, there are a few in game purchases that can speed things up. (10-20% faster) so it’s absolutely not necessary. This game is super easy, takes about 5 min to learn but a lifetime to master. I talked my gf into making an account after I had been playing for about a month, she doesn’t play games. She doesn’t like them never has. That was in 2014, in 2022 were both still playing th me game daily and every morning we wake up together and play for an hour or so. It’s tons of fun, and if your the kind of person who often wishes there was a good mobile game to play, here it is. Though I would suggest the battle pass (5$/month) it’s absolutely not necessary and I probably wouldn’t notice it if i didn’t have it. Anyways this game rocks. Some of the hero AIs could be tweaked and theirs always balancing issues but it’s always getting better and always improving. I love clash.

reviews.t: Very good, definitely should try it.
reviews.x: Clash of clans is a very fun game for those wondering if they should download it. It is free to play and had no adds whatsoever so you don’t have to tap an X every 5 seconds. Personally one of my favorite games out there, very popular and is good for all ages, even 60 year old men or women. You will get addicted in seconds. The actual game is a strategy game. You first start by building up a strong base, but eventually, you will need more loot. You can build up an army of very unique and useful troops and destroy your enemies for loot and trophies. You will eventually upgrade to greater town halls and unlock more stuff like spells, siege machines, heroes, hero pets, and much, much more. You also unlock new troops as you grow. You can also upgrade your troops if you feel they are too weak. There is also clans and wars in the game. Join a clan to chat with clan mates and receive troop donations from other players in your clan. You can also participate in wars, war leagues, and clan games for lots of loot and prizes. There is even a second island that is different from the 1st, you can train armies as well, but the troops are different. You also will attack someone as they attack you, so you better make sure you get the better score. There is also leaderboards for higher players, rise to the top to become the #1 player. There is always new stuff to discover and constant updates to see.

Worst customer service, they can't even understand the legal interpretation of their own Term of Service. Basically, I got an account locked for taking care or a base for a friend, which is not a violation of the Clash of clans TOS since they only say to not share the information if it will be a risk to the accounts security. I tried to unlock it and their responses were almost all generated and the "human" responses were so incompetent they made me feel like I was getting nowhere. I then followed THEIR websites steps and used an alternate account to try to resolve the problem with customer service again. Next thing I know they banned me for 31 days on the premise of "Account Phishing" Which isn't even close to the situation I'm in. Account Phishing is when a person tries to obtain another person's account information by illegal means such as counterfeit emails or through other scandalous methods. I am very disappointed with how this game has turned out, I used to love playing it so much with my friends and brothers. Now it's just a disappointment. I would even give it half a star if I could...

reviews.t: 100% Pay to Win; Free Play stinks after 1 month
reviews.x: If you’re lucky enough to start on a fresh server, this game is fun to play for free for about 30 days. After that, the financial gap becomes almost intolerably necessary. You cannot become a top player without spending A LOT of money. I spent two months doing dailies, spent probably $50, and got kicked out of the clan I began with because everyone else was so much stronger and dropped so much more money into this. The very top players easily spent over $1000 while I played. I wouldn’t be surprised if others spent several thousand. No joke. The next tier down, who had no chance at all against the top, probably had spent around $500. I’m not against people spending their own hard earned cash, that’s fine, but this game is not worth dropping anywhere over $100 to not even be in the top 1/3 of players in a server of a few hundred. To some it may be though. So, if you don’t spend long on a game, pick it up, play a month, uninstall, don’t worry about paying for anything because within that it month or two you’ll be just fine.

Clash of clans is one of the best strategic games I’ve ever played in my whole life. I’ve been playing CLASH OF CLANS for more than 8 years and never regret ever downloading it in the first place and I can’t stop playing it even if I clocked 90years old. However, there’s a very important aspect that needs to be adjusted which is the “DURATIONS OF BUILDING UPGRADES”. I discovered that despite the extremely high cost of building upgrades, the duration at which the said building takes to complete in just too much especially for players whose base starts from town hall level 11 upwards. Sometimes a particular building upgrades might cost 12,500,000 worth of golds while the duration to complete the upgrade takes nothing less than 14days when it comes to town hall level 12 upwards. Pls the duration is just too much and discouraging. I believe if the time frame is reduced, it won’t appear tedious and discouraging for players despite the high cost of golds. That’s my honest opinion.

reviews.t: CoC requires other games on device to be fun
reviews.x: I wish there was a 4.5 star, ‘cause I truly think CoC is worthy of 4.5 , but there isn’t. Anyway, please enjoy my essay. Lol. There is a main reason this review did not rate CoC 5 stars. And that is because CoC takes up a lot of time. For instance, it took me at least 6 months to get everything maxed out in TH 8 (my other account). Even though it took me 6 months to ,max out TH8, my playtime over those six months felt like I was playing for near 24 hours. I honestly think CoC developers need to make something for players to stay online and playing. Also, imagine you were new to CoC. You just joined and you made it to TH4, eventually the upgrade times get up to hours upon hours of waiting. And if you don’t spend money for builder’s huts, the gameplay just gets completely boring. I hope developers of CoC could add something like an attack rush, where you can attack other player’s towns, whilst not damaging, nor gaining any nearly any valuables. I could see 10% of the damage that you took to the base’s you’d get, but it would be too grindy on attack rush. I’m sorry this is very long, I just talk a lot. lol. Anyway, if you could add something to keep me playing, it would be great. Thx if you respond and peace out :) Have a nice day!

reviews.t: Good game, but there’s 1 thing I would add.
reviews.x: I love Clash of Clans a lot, it’s been my favorite game for a while and i’ve deleted and redownloaded it a few different times. I love the idea and the way you can interact with online players and build your one of a kind base. Everything about this game is cool. However, recently I came to the conclusion that I wanted to restart my base from the beginning and fix a few mistakes I made. But no matter how many times I deleted and redownloaded the game it always kept my progress. I’m not saying you should make so that every time you delete the game it erases all your data, but i’m suggesting there be a button in settings that would let you restart your village and begin a new journey in Clash of Clans. If you added this in the next update, i’m willing to bet you’ll get more people to play the game and have a great time doing it. I know that I will start to play the game again, and would love for you guys to check and do your best to add this feature. Thank you.

reviews.t: Best Mobile Game of All Time
reviews.x: Let me just say that I am a huge Supercell fan! With a little but great selection of games, I never get bored! Clash of Clans at first didn’t grow on me when I was in high school, but the auto upgrade feature helped me get back into it! The game is exciting, competitive and fun all at the same time and I can’t get enough of it! If I had to make a recommendation, and I believe it could be very useful, they should have a “help” button! For example, say I wanted to upgrade my mortar, I could request for help in my clan chat, and they could click help for maybe a short gem cost to help someone speed up their build process! Same thing with training your army, I believe this would be a key update that could easily help those who have lower town halls progress quicker! But to those who haven’t played Clash of Clans I highly recommend it!

Okay, best game you could ever get! It’s pretty idle so I can still get school done, but there is still stuff to do. I like the add on from a while ago, the builder base. Everything costs a lot, but gold and elixir is easy to get. My only problem would be, sometimes I train my army, pay for it, and still have to wait for it to train. After all is said and done, I get on to battle, but there’s no army. It’s not there! I don’t get my elixir back. The battle log has no new battles, so nobody hacked it. The resources are just gone. It makes star bonuses and the clan games/wars hard. I’ve been kicked several times because I’m not on enough to constantly train an army to get it half the time. That’s the only problem. Great game! And for the person reading this going omg, never gonna happen, i haven’t heard anybody else say anything about it, I think it’s just me. GET THIS GAME!

It’s really just un-enjoyable seeing that kind of loss.

reviews.t: Don’t waste your money or time
reviews.x: Biggest scam out there. Where to behind. Let’s start with the Builders Hall. AI’s are everywhere and NEVER and I repeat NEVER behave the same way. Builders Hall is the worst. From troops deliberately committing suicide by walking directly in the line of fire to walls that are impossible to break on one base and easily breakable on the other. The thing makes NO sense. Let’s face it. SuperSuck manipulates the game and manipulates the AI’s in the game to force you to reach a certain point where you can not progress without spending real money. They have already been caught manipulating the gameplay to invoke players to spend real money. Everything is centered and manipulated to force you to spend money. I’m a Legend in Clash Of Clans and I’ve spent over $32k into the game and they keep trying to bleed me more. Im rich but that’s not the point. It’s done because there is no other way. I’m done with the game and their years of refusal to fix the AI’s of which they respond with “we know about the issues”. So in 5 years they have known about the issues and have yet to fix even one? Yeah. Total dirt bag company. I’m selling both of my accounts and I’m done with the game.

Always have been a big fan of this game. It’s simple, but there is so much to it. It’s truly been a part of my childhood, and I love it dearly. Honestly, it’s one of the few games I’ve ever actually had one, legitimately one problem with. And this problem is something I’d love to see changed, but even the problem is maybe small. I think it would be super cool if you could allocate multiple builders to one project to take down the time. I love the game, but once you get to a certain point, everything takes a day or more to upgrade. My only suggestion for a change would be allowing you to either get a boost (meaning a building boost, like if you add an extra builder, you get a 10% time boost, and a second, you get a 20, a third 25, and then a fourth you get 50, and then if you put all 5 builders on it you get a 75% builder boost. This just allows the player to decide how valuable time is in certain upgrades). The second being that when you put another builder on the project, you get speed boost just like the one you get from the “Builder Potion”. The more builders, either the faster they build, or the longer the normal speed boost last. This is just an idea, love the game. If this didn’t happen, I wouldn’t stop playing.

reviews.t: Have played on n off for 9years now
reviews.x: While I have and continue to play this game off n on it is frustrating to see the lack of awareness to prevalent issues for long term players such as the communication censorship. As an adult only clan of whom most are into our careers we find clash to be our little escape throughout the day with our fellow clan mates, however the recent updating to the censorship has flagged regular words like “calling out” “mobile” “Reddit” and other generic non slang/offensive words is prohibiting proper communication and connection we have enjoyed over the years. We all have left reviews and emails hoping we can find some technical support but to no avail which is rather disappointing as some mates have started to become inactive due to the frustrations. If anyone from the Co. is reading this please consider an opt on or off for the censorship in chat, you guys already have taken global chat away so it is frustrating to have limitations on the convos we can have in clan with our teammates and still hope it can be resolved soon! -sincerely someone who wastes too much money on gems 😖

This is a great game, first of all. I’ve gone through three accounts due to the early days before supercell ID, and each one was not only fun, but prepared me for my current crushing town hall 10 account. I’ve watched updates come and go. First, I really miss the global chat and I’m not alone in this. It was a great way to just have casual conversations or find a truly fitting clan for your aspirations. Second, someone else mentioned a wave-by-wave defense mode to get resources by testing your base layouts. Learning to attack is all very well, but learning to defend in this way would be fun and help toughen the competition as well as yourself. The last improvement I can think of would be possibly lowering the builder hall requirement for O.T.T.O. and not allowing players to max out O.T.T.O. until the last level. I’ve found Builder Base progression to be quite slow compared to the home village, and it’s caused me and many players I’ve met to neglect their builder bases. Solid 5/5, keep up the good work.

reviews.t: Best mobile game ever, just two suggestions
reviews.x: I love this game, it’s a 24/7 game where there’s always something to do, even when buildings are upgrading, you can raise your trophies by fighting, you can do clan wars, and there’s even a whole 2nd base! (builder base). But two things that would make the game feel less slow are the old global chat and watching ads for gems, the global chat was a super fun vibe, some people were jerks but not all the time, also the game felt like it had a real community where you can talk clash without having to go on social media. The second thing that would help is ads for gems, I don’t think it should be a lot (maybe 5) but they would help to save up gems and a good quick way to get gems to use on level 1 builds you’re trying to get to the other higher level builds. But even without those in the game I’d still play love the game, keep up the great work Supercell! ❤️

This game is extremely fun and addicting, ive been playing it for many years, but i feel like something needs to be said. I’ve reached town hall 10 and i just re downloaded this game after several years, and i’ve been screwed over many many MANY times in this game. I will spend easily 15 minutes looking for a base to attack, which means i sit there staring at my screen for 15 minutes pressing one button hoping to find a good base to attack. It’s not like i’m a bad player, but trying to play without your hero’s whenever they’re down upgrading and using just the normal troops is almost impossible. Sometimes I will spend easily 20 + minutes attempting to find ONE base to attack, and whenever i do find a base, clan castle troops like balloons and electro dragons will DESTROY my troops before im even able to get one star on the base. I understand this and that, but this is broken and unbelievable. This is the kind of thing that made me stop playing the game last time, bc i simply do not have time to play this game for several hours just to upgrade one thing. Not to mention they’ll purposely put obstacles in place when you switch bases so you can’t use your old base if all 5 of your builders are busy. It’s mostly small stuff like that, but the small things add up and they’re only there so that you’ll buy more gems. It’s really stupid and the game seems to always want to work more against you rather than working with you. I still just think it’s unbelievable I spend 15-20 + minutes looking for one base sometimes, that’s just mind blowing tbh.

This is just the game I was looking for, it is also very relaxing. You start off with only a few things, and you have to mine and drill for gold and elixir. After that you can get your troops ready for battle, then you can play multiplayer or single player. It also has a lot of options. It’s very fun you can even play with friends, and trust me, I’ve seen people with stuff like gold walls, potions, kings that can fight, and dragons (Dragons are not huge beast, just small dragons) and surprisingly strong tiny little goblins. If I want to upgrade or build something I can click on it click upgrade and turn off my phone and it will finish while I’m at school, work, or just sleeping. I think that is is one of my top favorite games, it might not be for everyone but I think you should give it a try. I recommend not wasting gems to speed up something, you should remove all trees and stones every time you get on and by the end of the week you will have enough to build the next builders hut, if you have enough elixir to clear all the trees.

I think it’s very stupid that I can’t go without losing a rank because someone like 3 or 4 ranks above me just decides to absolutely wreck my base because they don’t feel like raiding someone their own level, meanwhile I’m getting little to no resources and time takes so long to level up one thing especially with just 3 builders, it’s incentivized to make you buy the battle pass or gems, one extra star for the gem generator, this game is really good and I’ve played since a kid but I can see the clear mobile game predatory nature that’s ever pervasive on any mobile appstore nowadays, imagine if things like this were in more games, heck it’s even in gta, It’s akin to doing 10 heists for cash to buy a jet when you could just spend 20 bucks. I wanna pay for crazier features not for time and being able to cut in line, this game is extremely pay to win, if I were a millionaire maybe I’d give the game a good review. but I’m not so my time isn’t spent on the game it’s spent playing other games while all my stuff takes weeks or several days to upgrade.

This game used to be good but you have taken advantage of players and forced it into a pay to win mechanic. With extremely long wait times and extremely high prices for upgrading anything… How is that ONE wall cost 2million to upgrade in a lvl 11th?? This number may be inaccurate but I believe there are 300 walls in a townhall 11 so multiply that by 2million it then jumps to 600 Million! just to max out the walls if you’re aiming for a complete base. I’m not kidding about how messed up this is… I can’t imagine how bad it increases when you lvl up. So you then have 3 options rush 1 the base because people can’t be bothered with that. 2 spent 600 million gold in just walls. Or 3 the preferred way by supercell to buy the pass that cuts off the price of everything. But doesn’t do much because you’re still having to wait crazy amounts of time. This applies to every aspect of the game by the way, not just walls. I know you guys are trying to make money but that’s ridiculous. This is not the way and you can do better. You’re forcing players hands by making things so freaking expensive and time consuming that they have to spend real money. PLEASE KNOW: this is a pay to win game and I’m sick of it.

reviews.t: Awesome game. No issues yet. Tips for starters.
reviews.x: I started the game about a year ago. It was hard to start, but after a few weeks, I got a hang of things. Right now, I’m a Town Hall 7. I haven’t had any problems that make me want to delete the game. I admit, it is really hard to get a third builder, but I can see why. IT HELPS SO MUCH. A tip for starters. Don’t waste the 200 gems you get at the beginning. You need 500 to get your third builder, and you start out with 2 of them. Don’t quit playing for a long period of time, or you’ll be raided a lot, and when you get back, you’ll be wondering why you lost so many trophies. Don’t do that!!! Be sure you get into a clan ASAP!!! Luckily, a bunch of my friends have a clan, so I got lucky. There are a lot of people with clans. He into one AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. Trust me, it helps. Those are some tips for starters. This game is AMAZING, I love it so much. Thank y’all for making this game.

Im in my high school drumline and the drumline decided to create a clan. I downloaded it under their request and at first I didn’t see what the big fuss was about. I played it more and more and found out that it actually pretty fun. I love challenging my friends bases and it is a good time with friends. The only problem is there aren’t updates pretty often. Adding more troops or new buildings or new features would be sweet. A few minor recommendations are when you play online and you see another person in your clan is online, you should be able to see who. It just says another person is online, not which person. Another recommendation is that you should be able to challenge your friends bases if they are in a different clan. I have a buddy that downloaded this game and we friended each other and there no way to challenge each other. That would be super fun. But overall a good game. If you could fix those two minor inconveniences, it would make this game just that tad bit better.

Hey supercell love coc its an amazing game i play it non-stop but theres four things i want #1 a th15 and a th16 like more to the jungle edition #2 more heroes and troops like a custom hero where you can create your own hero and use it in battle and same with troop #3 a shorter timer the timers are just way too long upgrade and training makes a crazy difference and when you have nothing to upgrade or anyone to battle i get stuck watching a show and some times i wish i could change the date and time on my ipad so i didnt have to wait 5 days #4 secret codes you can unlock to get more recources gems and free upgrades by completing hard challenges earning them and some are so secret you have to buy them with gems Thanks supercell you have made me so happy with your games And this is how it can make me and lots more people happier to from Maximellius2010 Syanara!

reviews.t: Some words are censored now? Seriously!?
reviews.x: I rarely write reviews, but one new feature makes me feel like I have to, my entire clan, and I imagine many other players are complaining about it. Before I get into it, I absolutely love this game. I’ve been playing for almost 2 years and have gotten to TH10 as of now, and it’s overall a great game, I didn’t have any complaints until now. I’m honestly lost for words, I woke up a few mornings ago and checked the game, and the chat is just ************************************ Seriously? Who asked for this other than the 7 year olds who aren’t old enough to be playing the game anyways? Even with filter clan chat off (I have no idea what this does) it’s still censored! There’s an easy solution: clan leaders should at least be able to turn the censoring on and off, or just remove the censoring entirely and tell clan leaders to say if swearing is allowed or not in their clan, which many already have. Adults play this game too, and yes, we swear. And when we swear ONCE in a message, the entire message is censored and we have to rewrite it. Also, I think the only send button should be the check mark above the keyboard. The amount of times I’ve accidentally sent an unfinished message and confused the crap out of my friends is almost funny. Not a big complaint, just figured I would mention it. Because of the stupid censoring, I’m going to have to take off a star.

I’ve been playing clash of clans for a good part of my life. I enjoyed every bit of it. However, as of recent months, I’ve felt that the name for our centralized base of operations (CBO) is wrong. Why Town Hall? It’s not a hall, nor is it the “hall” of a town. For starters, it’s a square. Not a hall. I won’t dabble into the politics of it, but to say a clash of clans base is a town couldn’t be more false. It’s a military base that harbors a few poor women that constantly suffer the effects of war. Putting prisoners into a military base doesn’t make it a town. Everything is wrong with the name Town Hall, and the mounting evidence makes this a problem that can be ignored no longer. I suggest the name be changed to “Tier House.” Not only does it concisely state the function (numerical tier system) of the CBO, it also more accurately depicts the architecture of the structure. Thank you for reading, I hope you take this review into consideration.

reviews.t: An Expensive Way to Spend Time in the Restroom.
reviews.x: I have waited a long time to write my review for this game. I started playing Clash of Clans in May 2013. I’ve played for five years. FIVE. YEARS. I’m almost finished with my level 9 walls. Level 9. I’ve spent a couple hundred dollars on the game over the last 5 years. Has it been worth it? I don’t know. That’s the problem. I’m a casual gamer and there is no way I would EVER spend that much money on any video game. Ever. But, if you want to be level 10 or 11 in this game with the good stuff, you will either do what I’ve done or you will shell out thousands of dollars. If you’ve got that money, then congratulations. I’ll keep playing....because...it will be cool to see my level 11 base just before my funeral. Clash of Clans is a LONG LIST of ways to get money from players’ pockets first. It is one of the best brain-tricking devices to have ever been released and disguised as a software “game”. That was the ultimate goal of the people at Supercell from the beginning - get as much money from people as possible as often as possible. I’ve felt that way for years now. Clash of Clans is “fun” (is it?) and a “game” after that.

This game used to be a lot of fun. You could play for hours doing challenges, war, farming or even rearranging your base as much as you wanted. You could even play in peace with a shield in place. Then somewhere along the way one of the Devs made the worst decision they’ve ever made regarding the game and added a “Personal Break” timer that now stops you from being able play or even load your base. Even if you’re offline, as long as you have a shield, it counts it as you being online and forces you stop playing. I like to think the Dev was going through a mid life crisis when they added that function. There’s no other explanation for adding it. Oh wait, there is. You now have to pay to get gems to buy another shield that’s allows you to play without being attacked. So either pay or only be allowed to play for 10- 15 minutes at a time then be forced out for 4 hours. That RIDICULOUS pop up appears every 10-15 minutes. REMOVE IT. Your game isn’t worth the frustration that personal break timer causes. Until then, consider this one less player to put up with your money grubbing ways.

reviews.t: Worst customer service experience I’ve ever had
reviews.x: I re-downloaded this game tonight to pick up playing again after seeing my fiancé getting back into it. I was unable to log back into the account I had, so of course I contact customer service for assistance. It starts off with a bot asking questions, okay fine pretty typical, I provide the information I can and wait to be connected to a real person. The real person then asks me questions such as when and where I originally started playing this game and what other devices I could have played on. I found the original download from December 2014 and gave all the information I could but honestly just do not remember that much detail about a game I’ve played on and off for the last seven years and what devices I could have possibly played on during that time period. I then get notified that I am attempting to gain access to someone else’s account and am banned for 31 days - I also now do not have access to the customer service portion of the app so there is no way for me to contact or even attempt to resolve this for the next month. I will never be playing this game again explicitly due to how horribly this was handled.

reviews.t: So negative stars is not a thing?
reviews.x: Have not played this game in a while. Started up a new account because my family wanted to play again, figured why not - fighting people with family is always a good time. Attempted to get my old account back so didn’t have to start from the bottom again. Email wasn’t get a notification through their system. Found out my account has been locked. Mind you I have a town hall level 9, nothing big, but saving time is saving time. After creating a ticket and putting in my old account information they start asking me bunch of times and dates that I don’t remember. After my best attempt at trying to answer they call me a liar and banned my current account. So I looked to get in contact with one of the reps and explain in detail the story instead of talking to a robot. Turns out reps and robots have same responses and no one wants to talk on the phone to hear the story. So now hear I am, locked out of a game I just put money on and can’t play the game with my family that is over a thousand miles away. They don’t have a phone number to call they have no real want in helping me play video games with my family. So now leaving this review. Hope you never have to deal with this kind of customer service that I have gone through.

I honestly love this game, my whole family and my whole church group plays this game in one clan non-stop!This game is honestly addicting. You can never get bored with it.
