This is my favorite mobile game ever. It has no adds, it is pay to win but it doesn’t affect the other players if you gem to max because they don’t have to attack you. Every other mobile game, all the ones that require no brain there just something to do, I get bored of. I haven’t gotten bored of this game and I’ve been playing for almost a year now. It’s constantly evolving and it’s really fun, especially with all the ways you can play, you can farm, push, find a balance between those two, or start your own clan and do clan wars, clan games, and clan war leagues. I always made fun of my friends for playing this game cuz it’s such a geeky game, but now that I play it, I regret saying that. Some advice, don’t town hall rush, max out your base before every upgrade, it’s gonna make it so much easier once you really get into the game. I town hall rushed, and I had like level four everything when I got to TH 8, I’m maxing out now and my base is looking really good. Way to go Supercell

First off, thank you supercell for creating such a good game. I downloaded this game within the first year it surfaced on the App Store. It’s been awesome to see every single update you guys have created. Over the years, I’ve downloaded, deleted, and re-downloaded the game. I really hope to see that feature come back as I know I’m not the only one that loved it. Anyway, I can’t wait to see whatever else y’all’s great company brings to the world of games!

reviews.t: Amazing 10/10 just a couple of fixes
reviews.x: Just a couple of days ago I re-downloaded the game as now I 1. Have time and 2. I’m not a small mindless child anymore. As of now, the game is great, better than that, amazing compared to the rest of these new apps on the App Store. Just a couple of changes could ensure those extra 0.2 stars rating on my behalf. The first one would be to make the 2nd builder free, scratch that optional, as 250 gems is actually quite expensive considering gems are literally the one thing that makes this game at least a little playable when all you builders are busy for like 3 hours. The other and final thing I find a bit, how do I phrase this, a little unfair would be the other island you access by rebuilding the boat, which only allows 3 battles that get you loot until you have to wait or pay gems, specifically 93 (usually), which could at least be lowered to a 50-70 gems considering gem challenge are quite hard to do. Apart from those two this game is amazing.

I have played this game pretty much non- stop for many years now. I love that you can build with or without spending a whole bunch of money whichever you choose. I find it gratifying to have given some money early on as a thank you to the inventors. Yet, have worked my way up to two well developed villages and my own clan. It is truly a game that is wonderful for down time and in many ways like chess. Individual troops have certain patterns they follow and you have to study those patterns in order to match up troops and spells. the more one plays, the more effective you become at attacks. Plus there is a community of people supporting each other. There are many life lessons as well to be learned. The more successful one is, the more difficult the level of competition. Very true to capatilism. And it also teaches you through that, that many defeats and some successes is success overall.

This game is amazing. It’s the best mobile game in my opinion. I love the strategy and the everything about this game. The only problems I have are how long upgrades take. Like seriously, upgrading your barbarian king one level takes 4 days? It’s only level 33 too, so I can’t imagine how long it’ll take when that level is in the 70s. You guys also keep cheapening stuff out. Like I remember when the barbarian king costed 10,000 dark elixir and the archer king costed 40,000 dark elixir and the grand warden costed 6,000,000 elixir. Now they’re all super cheap and I remember when I grinded to get to 40,000 dark elixir and when I got there it felt really rewarding getting the archer queen because she’s really good. But now at only 10,000 dark elixir to get the queen and 5,000 dark elixir to get the king and I think 2,000,000 or 3,000,000 elixir to get the warden, it doesn’t feel as rewarding the makes the game too easy in that way. Besides all the critiques I have about this game I’m still giving it 5 stars just because of how amazing it is.

I’m usually not of game playing mindset, my schedule doesn’t allow for aimless expensive games…however, my boys introduced me to this game as something we can do together. I was very apprehensive at first but soon realized this game was multi-dimensional and had appeal to most every ego / personality. Number one, it teaches one patience given building your base without financial assistance can take a long time but it’s worth it for the player without disposable income. This game builds a concept of Team Play and allows individual growth through single battles. There are some things I imagine improving but thats like telling the chef how to prepare one of his/her specials. There are a multitude of Clans / Teams to join so look for the right one for you. Some are super serious while others simply enjoy playing the game. I’m very competitive coming from an athletic background so this game allows the old boy to still learn from defeats and celebrate the wins. Hope you all enjoy this like we do…have fun and love your children. JC

reviews.t: A Great Game and a Classic
reviews.x: I’ve payed Clash of Clans since 2014 and it has been the one game that I can always come back to. It’s a classic game that I see as the number one base building game. The upgrading is great along with the attacking at the watch of the different levels. One thing I have really loved the most about Clash, is the community surrounding it. Clash of Clans has such a strong community and it is fun to talk to people wether it be in the actual game or outside of the game with friends. It is definitely a game that you can enjoy with friends and can be a side conversation every so often. The mechanics of the game work well and the only complaint I can really think of is that once you reach higher town halls upgrade times take weeks and a lot more time is spent upgrading. Other than that it is a great game and would recommend as a must have for anyone when it comes to trying out some type of base building/strategic attacking game.

ive had this game for about 8 years now and when i came back to the game from a break they added this terrible change to the game to where if you are much lower level than a clan mate, if the much higher level clan mate donated you higher level troops, it often decreased the level by itself by a LOT. I have an issue with this because first off, it ruins some points of having better clan mates and secondly, it completely ruins the point of the clan perk at level 5 and 10 of increasing the troop level in donations. overall i really would like this change fixed because this game revolves alot around having a good clan and this update makes donations alot worse. #bringbackglobalchat global chat was always a good experience because you could always talk to people in global chat about things that you would talk about in a community discord server or a reddit. it was genuinely one of the best and creative concepts in any mobile game out there but now that it is removed, it almost feels like theres much less of a connection between a player and the game. especially for those who dont use reddit or discord.

reviews.t: One of the best games out there
reviews.x: -Overall Thoughts- I’ve been playing Clash of Clans for about 5 years now. And let me just say, this game is amazing. All the different strategies you can use, the unique troops you can train, and all the polished town hall levels to play through. That’s not even mentioning the excitement of Clan Wars and Clan Games, plus the pure competitiveness of Clan War Leagues. -Progression- Many will say that progressing is too slow, and walls are too expensive. Progressing may be a drag at higher town hall levels (th11+) but that doesn’t mean that you are never going to reach a new level or unlock a new troop. In fact, with the new updates we are getting almost a 50% reduction to build times and build costs. Progression is no problem for me and thousands of others because it is so rewarding getting to that new town hall level. -Strategy- I would strongly disagree to anyone who would say that this is not the most strategic game out there, or at least on the App Store. Clash of Clans allows you to train different armies, experiment with new spells, and blow through enemy bases with them. Everyone enjoys using different attack strategies, and we’re not even talking about strategic base building, which really brings the game to life. If you’re looking to buy this game, the best time to dive in would be right now! Love this game, can’t say it enough.

This game is very fun, however, there are some problems that make the game much less enjoyable. For one, it is very gold-heavy, and most upgrades rely too much on gold. I find that I have full elixir storages and collectors and it just sits there as I wait for more gold to produce. Walls cost WAY too much, they take forever to upgrade overall and rely completely on gold, along with every single defense. Only thing that elixir is used for are things involving your troops. It takes forever to upgrade things when im waiting for gold to be produced 85% of the time. I suggest you create a sort of conversion system, where you can spend 2 elixir and receive 1 gold, a 2:1 system so when you’re running low on gold, you can use elixir to buy it and vice versa. There is also the fact of timing. It takes multiple days for some upgrades, whether that be troop upgrades, townhall upgrades, or defensive upgrades. This is a game, not real life. If anything, it should take hours, maybe a day. Multiple days is a ridiculous amount of time for upgrades, and I know a lot of people agree with me on this based on the reviews. Thank you so much!!

reviews.t: Incredible game but there’s a few issues
reviews.x: The SINGLE issue I have with this game is the tags in chat. I try to say words like “master” and other random non inappropriate words, but it tags them. And it’s incredibly annoying Bc when I’m saying “join the discord call” I have to send each individual letter in discord. Just please make this so that it only tags R-rated words (cuss words and slurs.) PG-13 words don’t tag pls. It’s just incredibly annoying and I honestly hate it. Also you should make it so you can have vertical typing because horizontal typing is ridiculously hard to do. If those two things were fixed this would be above a 5-star game. The only other problem with this game is the time. The troop training I kinda get so people won’t constantly attack and the potions are great, but the builds take too long once you reach town hall 9. I think the upgrades should reach one day once you hit town hall 12. Otherwise itll take like 6 months at least to max out town hall 10.

It’s a good game, but has a few problems. One: The builder island is dumb. It’s really annoying to keep up with two bases and the way the builder base is set up (like walls only being in groups of five) is really dumb. Second, with how many town hall levels they have now the time it takes to upgrade and research things takes WAY too long. Also, being able to donate SUPER high level clan castle troops to weak players is ruining the game. You can’t attack someone your level without ridiculously strong units coming out and wrecking you. They should nerf it and make it so that depending on your town hall level you can receive certain level troops. The pets and new hero’s are also getting a little dumb. They should have stopped with the warden. And last but not least, the new themes for town hall 12 and 13 are kind of dumb. Everything is starting to look like a fruit salad instead of a nice and uniform two or three matching colors. Town hall 9-11 looked very nice. PLEASE try to replicate the same effect. Environmental themes don’t look as good.

reviews.t: Amazing game but just a few improvements needed.
reviews.x: Clash of Clans is one of the best games I have ever played, I check in every day at 6:30 am and 4:30 pm. I loved the may that the game is free to play compatible, I have spent money on the game to get a builder though. I wish Supercell could add more achievements so it is easier to unlock said builders with gems. I also love the factor waiting for things even though waiting a a few days for an air defense is kind of annoying it gives me something to look forward to in my day to day life. One thing I also like is that I used to play Clash Royale before any of Supercells other titles, I played the game so much and so still do and I was so happy when I switched to CoC that I could see all of the faces that I was familiar with. I would say the only improvement this game really needs is more achievements for new players so they can get all 5 builders as fast as they can.

This game is absolutely perfect I usually don’t game on mobile , but this game is the exception , I’ve been playing this game since I had the iPhone 3GS or the 4 I can’t remember exactly , but this game is awesome and I like how you can play this game on and off throughout your day and still move up , I unfortunately lost my old account and started a new one about 2 1/2- 3 years ago and and am now almost a th12 (non-rushed) if you want a game that combines strategy , and and time management for an all around GREAT game , then you’ve found the game you’ve been looking for . My wife says I’m always playing this game but it is awesome and addicting , if you’re contemplating on downloading this game , just go for it , it starts off slow but if you stick with it , it gets better and better the higher you level up , great job supercell , you’ve created a masterpiece

reviews.t: One of the best games on the store
reviews.x: I wasn’t sure at first because it looked like one of those games that was just an idle to gain money to buy things that make you more money for no end purpose but it’s definitely a lot more than that, I do have an idea for the game devs though and I really hope they read this, -Once you get into higher level upgrades they take longer to finish, and sometimes you’re waiting on your Town Hall or other buildings to upgrade before you can do anything else, so if there was an option to put more than one builder on one project to lessen the time it takes to finish that would be great. I am currently waiting on my spell factory to upgrade before I can attack because I love using spells and my troop strategy needs them to be effective, I really hope this gets added to the game so I don’t have to dread upgrading my spell factory because it holds me back from attacking, Thank youu

The game is entertaining. Of course I have my gripes about it, as any game, where there are “meta” things to do... my top complaint is that lightening damages air missile defense and destroys them too easily, making air-assaults all too easy in this game. But I digress... with all of my gripes, I tend to play this every day. If you have no willpower, even though it is completely free, you can find yourself spending upwards in the hundreds of dollars in this game... so, be careful, it’s addicting. It is perfectly enjoyable to be played for free. This is not a “pay to win” game, it will just take a bit longer. The community (or at least the one I found) is very kind. I’d suggest private clans over public ones, they tend to get along better. There’s plenty of online tutorials and this game has been around for a good while. It can be chill, it can be competitive, it can be whatever you want. I only gave it 4 stars, because... seriously... lightening destroying missile defense... give those stupid things lightening immunity just like the storage silo’s already... that’s like 90% of the current strategy... FIX IT ALREADY!

reviews.t: Supercell deleted my account and didn’t give it back
reviews.x: I had an account and tried to make an appeal about getting my account back and couldn’t. So now I have to restart a mobile game that I’ve enjoyed since I was in the fifth grade. I haven’t always had access to a mobile device in my life. But I loved the fact that no matter what the device, my Apple ID never allowed the game to forget the original account by choice. Pretty upset about the fact that nobody helped me figure that one out. I’m restarting the game to play with my buddies but I doubt I’ll invest any time into the game much. I once gave the app a 5 star rating but I can’t deny my frustration with this turn of events. And now that I have a new account I can’t figure out how to restore a purchase that was previously made through the App Store linked to the same Game Center ID and Apple ID as the previous account. I hope one day I get that account back and have a laugh about something silly but simple that kept me from redeeming that account and those purchases. This game is the first thing I ever spent my own birthday money on. Super sad.

reviews.t: What happened to the Barbarian King?
reviews.x: I normally don’t write reviews here but I just want to say I’ve been playing clash of clans for almost 7 years and I honestly can’t believe time has gone so fast ever since. I still play it from time to time and honestly don’t believe the number of updates this game got. From new troops to new levels to another base (Builder Base). This recent update however caught my attention a bit. Let me just say you butchered the Kings default skin. The previous update made the King fierce looking now he’s sad? Disappointed? Did he break up with the Archer Queen or something? And his movements in the game still a little wonky especially when he punches, he looks as if he is trying to stretch his spine as much as possible. I know these new 3D animations are hard to do, the 2D models from before did it better, maybe recycle them and implement them on the 3D models so it doesn’t look weird you know? Well I guess that’s it for now.

reviews.t: GREAT GAME, JUST ONE BIG ISSUE
reviews.x: First of all, i’ve known clash of clans for roughly 6 years. I took a break for 4 years then came back and I really do think this game improved a lot. However, i’m currently a th9 and i’m really frustrated that whenever you move a single wall, you can’t do friendly challenges and wait for a whole 24 hours... that is super painful and frustrating considering that i’m really picky about my base. Why is that feature even there??? why was that added is there a specific reason for this??? Also about 5 years ago my base went missing and started me all over. I’m 13 right now and i was only 8 at the time which back then i didn’t know what i was doing. I didn’t bother to make a game center account because i was only 8 and didn’t know rocket science. But that is not my specific topic, I know you might’ve fixed it but as i’ve said 5 years ago my account just disappeared and started me over. I didn’t know what to do i was really upset. If you can reply to these 2 things explaining me why this/these things happen? THANK YOU. once again, i am not hater of your game.

reviews.t: I love this game, but I have a suggestion
reviews.x: This is one of the best games I have played, but I just thought of a cool idea. So, let’s assume this scenario: your upgrading to town hall 14, but it takes 17 days. Now, you don’t want to wait that long. So I thought of a solution. If you have any other free builders, it could go quicker. By that I mean if you want to upgrade something that takes six days, and you have six builders, you can have multiple builders working on the same thing. So if you have all six builders on that one upgrade, it will only take one day rather than six. So if you have all 6 builders, upgrading to town hall 14 would only take 2.83 days. I also think this would be really helpful in completing the game. This was just an idea I had. So again, 1 builder is not quicker, 2 builders is 2x quicker, 3 is 3x quicker, four is 4x quicker, five is 5x quicker and six is 6x quicker. I think this would be a really cool feature. Keep making awesome updates!

First of all, I think the game is amazing. I’ve been playing clash for several years now and I’ve had many different “on and off” periods of playing. I think the game is wonderfully managed and the updates are stellar. However, in terms of overall improvements, I would like to see a major overhaul of the builder base, maybe another builder hall level and more benefits for the home village, other than just the extra builder? I think the idea is great, but it just needs an extra feature or two to really bring it to life and add that extra dimension to clash. Lastly, I think that it would be great if you could be able to purchase past scenery with gems. In particular, past hero skins are able to be purchased with gems, but these are not particularly appealing to me. Since scenery typically costs around $5 to $7, I think it would be fair to price the scenery around 1500 or 2000 gems. This may seem like a small thing, but it would be so great! Please consider this! I love the temple scenery and the winter scenery and I think that other players would really enjoy this as well. Cheers and keep up the good work!

I love this game me and my family have a clan together that makes it funnier but even if you didn’t play with your friends or family clash of clans is a great game it’s free unless you want to spend money (like me😅) if you do I recommend buying the gold pass and more builders there are really helpful but other than that the game is free if you don’t like patients then I suggest this game is not for you because this game requires tons of patients but in the end you get this relief it’s really amazing but then you see the add another town all and it’s just like AHHHHHH but either way that’s just the best part I hope this game never ends it’s something that brings my family together Of course this game may take years and I know you’re probably thinking years!? But that’s just how long the game is it’s really exciting if you really think about it but of course this is just my opinion and my point of view of how I see this game if you download this game I hope it brings tons of joy to you have a good time!😊😁

I have been playing this game since 2013, with some long breaks. I am now th11 and the amount of time I spent getting there is unimaginable... Whilst I agree that it used to be way too hard to upgrade stuff back then in terms of getting resources and waiting for so long for the upgrades to finish, you are making it way too easy now. It was still fine when you added the pass that gives some rewards to players who are active and do the challenges, but that was enough. I don’t see the need to make it easier and easier for new players. It’s very unfair to players, like me, who have been playing the game for a very long time and put so much effort into getting where they are now as someone can reach the same position much more easily and quicker now. The reason I am writing this is because I just saw that you are going to implement upgrade costs and time reductions soon. Whilst there are some advantages for higher levels of town hall, it is mostly focused on the lower levels. I really don’t see the need to make those levels easier since they already aren’t really that hard, you just have to put a little bit of time and effort into the game and you’ll get past those levels no problem... Just stop making it so easy...

This is a great game. Despite being released 9 years ago it is still fun to play to this day. One of the things that make the game super fun is clan wars and clan war league. The one thing that ruins those are electro dragons. It is so frustrating learning an attack strategy and perfecting it all for some other person to spam them on your base and triple it. You put in time and effort and they don’t. You could use them for a couple minutes and already be doing very well. There is no skill whatsoever using them. That is a troop that might make me quit the game. There is simply nothing you can do about it. I see fully maxed bases just get destroyed because of this troop. It ruins the strategy and skill parts of the game. I think that they need to be removed completely. It would be much more rewarding for players that put time and effort into the game learning different attack strategies. Like I said I might just quit the game because of this. It truly ruins it for me and I’m sure many other people as well.

There are tons of good aspects about this game. From clans to multiple accounts there are plenty of ways to make the game fun. There are some well, better things they could do. To start, when I played a lot a while ago, there was a thing called global chat. This was one, if not the best thing of clash. Getting new members and having fun when you got bored was easily solved. The new way to recruit people isn’t great and doesn’t work half the time. You can’t even make a clan anymore without your friends’ support. The game would improve astonishingly if they added this back. The other bad thing about this game is the pay-to-win features. Now obviously this is good for the company and I do like it, I’ve spent a fair share of money on this game, but some people just buy there way to a th10 in a few days when you’ve been spending months upgrading to get there. Sometimes you just waist your money as a spender because you’re so incredibly rushed no one wants you in your alliance. I’d take anyone in as I started my own clan and we’re not growing to well. But in lower level leagues like gold and silver there are some maxed th12’s there when I’m thing to fight some th7 or 8. This is due to spending and there isn’t much to do about it besides complain. Thanks for reading this, bye.

I love this game, I am currently a town hall 11 and I have been playing the game for about 6 years, just a bit longer then playing clash royal, another great game made by supercell. I do have some ideas that I hope you may consider, for starters I would like to know why you removed global chat, it was such a good addition to the game and I personally loved using just to chat with people. Secondly I think that for the battle pass you should also be able to buy it with gems like 500 or something instead of paying 5 dollars. And finally I think a great addition to the game could be trading, such as trading gold for elixir. If I have max elixir and only 3,000 gold I would be able to send out a trade offer. I will be able to offer 2 million elixir in exchange for 2 million gold. This can also be used in things like spells or books. Thank you for reading my feedback, I love the game but I just think that these things can make the game much better.

I started playing clash right when it started, and took a long break until the summer of 2020. I was brought back by a friend and immediately remembered how much fun I had playing the game. There are no bugs that I have came across. You can join a clan and play with friends, it is literally a free game all the way throughout unless you want to spend money, and there is clan wars to play with friends against other clans. For more eager players, you don’t even have to max every building for each town hall(the main building). You can jus get everything it gives and leave it at level one. This has been my favorite game since fall of 2020, and I don’t see when this ever will end. Also, if you log in with supercell ID it saves your account and it allows you to create another one! This game literally lets you do almost anything you want. You can have one base for rushed, on base for max, one base for just experimenting and so many other things. I would definitely recommend this to anyone.

reviews.t: This Game Is Great But It Has One Problem
reviews.x: I have been playing this game for a long time now and have had many different accounts. Something I have noticed recently though is with the Builder Base. The Builder Base is the main base I play on so I am really high in trophies. I love this and everything but now it is impossible for me to win any battles. I’m not sure but I’m pretty sure you fight people with around the same amount of trophies as you which is really unfair. I’m only a level 5 Builder Hall but it keeps making me fight against level 6, 7, 8. This is unfair for me since all of their defense are way to high of a level for my troops to be able to destroy and their army is easily able to run straight through my base. I would like for maybe this to be changed and have you fight Builder Halls that are the same level as you to level the playing field. Besides this problem this game is really enjoyable. I Hope You See This And Perhaps Fix This Problem. Sincerely, FatefulAcorn83

I have been playing this game for a long time and would highly suggest it if you like long term games. I’ve heard complaints about how long it takes to finish the game (until more town halls are released) but there is also a reward in completing something that took that long to achieve so in my opinion the game is well balanced, and they make sure of that too which is great. Some things I would add maybe are smaller ideas like the shovel to the store and using clan war league medals to buy it would be a cool touch, even though the tool isn’t helpful it’s a fun thing that players can have if they’ve already maxed out or want to decorate a bit. Other smaller details like having the option for max level troops for friendly challenges to maybe get a feel if an upgrade is worth it or simply practice for when your army is ready or finally done upgrading. Just simple things but overall this game is perfect, keep up the work supercell!

Was figuring on hopping back into the game after somewhat years of not playing. I played all throughout high school and after college I kinda fell off and got too busy to play. To cut it short, I wanted to get my old base back because it was a lot of grinding and hours on that account, after digging around for my old phones and looking for a memory or storage of any kind to help the support team get my account back … I took pictures of the base and player tag which is what they requested and eventually they started to ask these “authentication questions” which I don’t mind because they had to confirm it was me.. now if u put two in two together u would realize oh, he took the pics and sent proof there’s no way it’s not his account… but boy was I wrong. They want me to answer questions that pertain to years back after I already explained to them it was a long time ago, instead of them understanding. They put a ban on my clash of clans account for 30 days for account phishing , and closed the support conversation down.. I have never been more stressed in my life after dealing with this kind of back and forth problem . It’s extremely upsetting because it took me almost two days to get this account recovered but instead of recovering it they banned me from it instead. Supercell you guys literally disappointed me and if anyone else went through this whole ordeal , don’t be afraid to speak up because this gaming company would rather give out bans then actually look for a solution . Good riddance .

Okay let me get one straight this game is the best game I have played in years but supercell you should find a solution to a better recruiting system because (a) It’s easier to recruit people instead of having to wait for people to join and (b) It’s much easier to find a clan with a nice environment and people and the new recruiting system is trash but I have a suggestion for supercell ever reads this review I think you should be able to donate troops from clan castle because (a) if your friend needs a troop that you have in your clan castle you can’t give it to them (b) if you wanna be nice and donate a troop you got from a town hall 9 player you can do that to. Another suggestion I have supercell is transferring troops to the town hall here from the clan castle are some examples on why you should add this (a) you wanna save some troops for whenever you need them like you want some troops to use but your clan castle is full and you wanna keep the troops you have in there well then transfer the troops into the town hall (b) you want some better troops for defending but your clan castle is full and you like the you have in there but they are not good at defending but really good at attacking well then just transfer them to your town hall P.S it would cost gems to move troops from the clan castle into the town hall example 1 troop storage space 1 or 5 gems 10 storage space 10 or 50 gems. Great game super cell keep up the great work and those are just suggestions/ideas 😄

Wow... I have never played such a great game before. I play clash of clans and have been since 2016 and boy this is one of the best games ever. It is a fun base defense game with state of the art graphics... HOWEVER there is one thing that I would like to change, I would like to add global chat back in the game, it is an awesome way to talk with other people from other clans and a great way to recruit people for your clan. The new recruit system is not good and it’s hard to find good people with it. Also maybe you guys need to check your matchmaking system for clan war league, we as a level 12 clan with only a little bit Of th13 and th12 with lots of th11 and th10s had to face clans with everyone town hall 12 and up, that clan had almost half in legend and we barely have six titan league players. This was not the only clan like this, we to face 2 other clans like it. But other than those two this game is perfect!! Can’t wait to see what you continue to do with the game.

reviews.t: Love it, though I have a suggestion
reviews.x: This is one of my favorite games by far. It has kept me entertained since I’ve downloaded it. Though I do recommend taking a break from the game for a bit when it starts feeling dull, as you’ll come back as enthralled as ever. Now for my suggestion. Could there be an option to be able to test out an army, like if you’re just trying some new strategies out? One that won’t require training up one, losing trophies if it doesn’t work well, and bothering your clanmates to post a challenge every few minutes? I feel like this would be a great asset to the game and for user experience. There could be either a set base of your townhall or a rotation of bases, and you could select an army beforehand - maxed heroes, troops, Clan Castle Troops, etc - and keep raiding to get the hang of it. We could be able to toggle the opponent’s heroes & CC troops, and maybe the CC troops could be random as well, or have the most common CC defence. I feel like this would be a great implementation to this already fantastic game.

reviews.t: Best mobile game of all time
reviews.x: I have absolutely loved this game since I started playing in 2017. I was a th7 at the time and rushed to th10 and the upgrading and loot penalty was so bad because of it and I ended up getting super unmotivated to play. I quit for 2 years and started playing recently in the past couple of weeks and so far have almost completely got my pink walls to max th9 walls with th9 defenses. I was able to do this in such a short amount of time because of how much I enjoy this game and how committed I am to fix my rush. I love everything about this game. The only problem I have with it is the clan system because it’s so hard to find good clans with committed clan mates, Aswell as the achievement rewards being too low for what they ask for in completion. There should be a couple of adjustments but otherwise this game is perfect and so fun to play. Every choice you make in this game is completely skill based instead of rng based, which most people agree is trash.

I would like to start this off by saying my gameplay experience was fun. However I have been banned for life after being called a racial slur. This slur starts with an “N” so you do the math there. I was so disgusted when it was said to me that I reported this individual. The individual received no punishment and continued to use this slur against me. I told them to “get the F out of our clan as we don’t have space for people like them”. That was the extent of my response and we kicked them. I was shocked to wake up the next morning to a life ban for defending myself from racism. In today’s society everyone should be treated equal. I brought this to Supercell’s attention in hopes of having my ban lifted however they sent me a form letter back in response stating they believe in a welcoming environment for all and bans were final. I replied back with how this impacts me and how I was not welcome but I am punished. I have received no response. I was and still am facing blatant racism from this company. The player who used these slurs against me faced no ban. My own clan mates reached out to Supercell themselves to attempt to clear my name but received a similar response to me. I don’t know what more to do. I guess my Clash days are over and I have faced discrimination again in my life. I hope this review deters you from playing this game and spending any money with them.

reviews.t: I love the game but good lord....
reviews.x: Don’t get me wrong this is a greatly designed game and I like playing it. But I have a huge problem with the builder hall, first of all Everytime I go to fight for resources I get matched with the most ridiculously more powerful players than me and it’s so annoying and frustrating to get anything out of it because I can’t get matched up against people my level rather then some Jackass who’s builder hall six with a roaster and level 10 builder machine like come on how else would I get resources faster. And their troops oh don’t even get me started Lol. Theirs is already maxed out. So I automatically know their gonna win the battles. Wanna know how I Know? Because I die so quickly thanks to their OP defenses so I get early access to how they absolutely demolished my base. I’m sick of it I will never get anything good if this keeps happening SCREW, the fact you get matched up with people depending on your trophies FORGET THAT PLEASE. AND JUST MATCH US UP WITH PEOPLE WHO ARE OUR EXACT SAME LEVEL OKAY? Not any lower not any higher that’s all I ask if you supercell. Other then that it’s a Great game to play.

reviews.t: Good game but some problems with matching
reviews.x: I’m just gonna start out saying that I love this game and deserves five stars because of how well it is made and just how long it has been able to keep up with other games. That said there are a few problems, such as when you are going to battle and you can t someone that you are strong enough to fight then you have problems. When I was playing just today I found that the players were always within one level of my town hall and that is hard because I had just started work on town hall 11 and was seriously outmatched by my opponents. So I was wondering if you guys could maybe set it up so that you can be matched by trophies like at the builder base. Also if you’re interested in this game please do get it. It is an amazing game I don’t wanna scare you away. And one more tip that I’ve found helps is max out as much stuff as you can before you upgrade your town hall

For those of you who don’t know I have been playing this game since it came out and I am telling you right now don’t get this. You build up a base and you join clan members sounds enjoyable right? But grinding to get a decent base and strategy for a game that you only play for like half an hour every so often is not good. Not only that but a clan I was in didn’t like the strategy Or the troops I would try to play in the wars and tried to coach me about a game that I barely spend time on. Also the leader of the clan allows a person who has other accounts to take over the wars with those accounts. FIX THIS PLEASE!!! It’s unfair to the other team if that one person has a better strategy than other clan mates and uses that same strategy on other clans that are the same level. I was kicked out of the war and heatedly talked to the leader about this. The leader clearly tried to defend themself saying that they were giving me a tip about strategy which I retorted back that I only play so often. He then further argued with me which then led me to get kicked out of the clan. If you want to play this fine, but heads up for clans that will have duplicate accounts and will defeat your clan in a blink. And also the leaders are try hards and are at the highest ranks who grind for trophies.

Clash of Clans is one of the greatest Mobile apps you can find with this type of gameplay yes, but the builder base clashing system is broken. The AI and the match-making system is absolute garbage. Playing as a builder hall 5 I am consistently up-tiered to builder hall 6 & 7 and it is completely unfair. When raiding a village at the normal village you can get maybe 1 or 2 stars against a higher town hall but when the amount of damage you do is a deciding factor if you win and the enemy has a stronger army and stronger base, then it’s mostly impossible. Sure, you get the inadequate player who is either rushed or just plain bad, but the advantage of having a higher base over your opponent is making it almost unplayable and the opposite of fun, frustrating. The AI is also complete garbage as most of the time you’re stuck wondering, “WHY ARE YOU GOING THAT WAY!!!!”. But both bases have that problem, but the wall breakers took a complete step backwards because they still target wall spikes. The AI also decides to run straight past other buildings to get to the building that was across the wall, which is stupid because none of them have enough health to run past three defenses. I’ve had cannons go past the town hall to attack buildings over a wall too. The AI is completely unprepared for handling walls and the match-making system is completely awful.

I’ve been playing this game for about 4 years. It was a lot of fun to play every so often for the first year, but it wasn’t my go to game. Once I got bored of the other games I was playing at the time, Clash of Clans became my main game. After a year or so, I got bored of clash of clans, and stopped playing for almost 2 years. I decided to reinstall it and it is great just like it used to be. It fills me with nostalgia and makes me happy. Although the game is somewhat “outdated” it’s still one of the best mobile games you can play. (In my opinion) I would 100% recommend this game to anyone because it’s easy to play but still required skill to climb the ranks, you have to use your brain to play it, and the entire experience is amazing! I can say that I will never forget this game and it will always have a place in my heart. Thank you SuperCell for making the best mobile game I could ever ask for! ❤️

Let me start by saying, if I could give negative 5 stars I would. Several years ago I signed up to play this game to have fun with my son. There was so much time and effort spent in building up my base and I was actually having fun with it. However, I had to return my iPad and mobile phone to my employer when I left the company and lost my account when I got a new device with my new employer. I have tried to get access to my old base through the customer service / support group for weeks now. After back and forth questions and answers, they banned me for 30 days from the game. No explanation, no phone number to call to chat about the challenges and frustration. So I waited for the 30 days to pass and started a new base. In the meantime, I tried again through service and support to ask for access to my old base. To my surprise, I am am now banned permanently from the game. Again, no explanation and no phone number to discuss the situation. I have never been more frustrated or insulted by a gaming company in my life. What a joke. I guess I will terminate my sons account so we can find another game to play together and have fun.

reviews.t: Ok some of you guys need to chill
reviews.x: Clash of clans isn’t purposefully making it unavailable to “iOS 10 and over” all apps do that. Look at Minecraft: one of the biggest games, it is only available to iOS 8 and over because it is compatible with that. When fortnite was available only people with iPhone 7 or later could get it and people with iPad Air 3 or later could get it. Stop criticizing Supercell as they are just trying to make a fun app. You guys forgot clash of clans is FREE. Name one time you’ve seen a clash of clans add. Supercell is not “discriminating against the poor” because guess what honey, if you have WiFi an IPad and have spent money on the game, you ain’t poor. Then to write a review on a 4.8 star game mad about it not working sounds like first world problems. I know you have a phone just play on there. You can make a account with supercelll so if you lose you’re account it will be safe. One time on my old phone (4 year old iPhone SE) it just shut down and I lost everything on my phone but I made an account so when I got my new phone I was able to recover my Clash of Clans base so thank you supercell.

I’ve been playing for about 7-8 years. I’m currently a town hall 11, I lost my old account and started new 2 years into it. This game is by far the best mobile game to be made, in my opinion. It’s fun while you’re on it, and when you’re not, you’re waiting for something to be upgraded. The community is great. You won’t find anyone being rude or condescending, if you do you went down a dark hole lol. Over all the game helps you develop strategies, it also helps you with currency management; that is if you’re trying to max out your resources to move quickly. I play roughly 10 minutes a day and I progress very well. It’s about being patient and smart. I won’t ever stop playing this. I’m proud of the work I’ve done one there. I would say more, but would not want to ruin it for new players. Join us to find all the new stuff on the game that makes it much more fun than before and much more fun than other games on the apple store.

Alright.. I’ve been playing this game since it hit the Apple store, it’s fantastic and I can’t find any other game that has all the aspects that this one has. Only one small flaw that I dislike about this is in one of your new updates, you removed the global chat. I feel as if this move was a bad choice to make, it is really hard to find players in need of a clan. All you can do now is find players in your friends list, which more than likely they will have a clan, or you can go into your league and search there, but the problem with that is you can’t find active players through that, you have to continuously search for a long time just for a few people, but with global chat, people will talk back and forth and sometimes stumble upon quite a few players in need of a clan. All I’m asking is that you bring back the global chat to enable more successful in finding people to join your clan, I hope you notice my review and take action or consider my proposal, Thanks Supercell

reviews.t: Probably the best mobile game out there
reviews.x: I’m a big destiny 2, cod, and assassins creed player, so I never really payed any attention to mobile games. Clash of clans, however, gives me a reason to look away from my console for a bit. It’s a terrific game that lets you fully customize and build your own base and compete with other players around the world. One problem is the building/upgrade time for buildings can take up to a whole week, most being 10-15 hours until they’re done. You can speed up the process of buildings and upgrades using gems which can be acquired through spending real money or by completing challenges. This game shines in that you don’t have to spend any real money to make progress or collect gems. I’ve probably collected over 2000 gems just by playing the game! It may be a bit of a pain when just starting your account, but after a while, you’ll really begin to understand why people love it so much!

reviews.t: I love the game but a few requests
reviews.x: I love this game a lot I have Been playing for a long time and took breaks but i have a few requests.1. In practice mode you can fight the town halls to practice but sometimes it’s annoying only being able to use certain attacks and certain bases so I’m asking if you can make in the next update that you can make army’s that’s free and being able to fight any base that’s a town hall above you for example let’s say I’m town hall 10 and town hall 11 I can use electro dragons but there is only one attack but a bad army and an annoying base so I want to be able to make an army with the troops from the next town hall and fight any type of th11 obviously not attacking real people and not getting any loot but just practice mode with making any army and you can attack any th11 base for practice. 2. You can’t have a lot of friends in the game I think you should be able to have more friends and same thing with bookmarking a certain clan you can only do like 20 which isn’t so much I hope you can add more. 3. In builder base it is so hard to upgrade stuff so I’m asking can you make it that you can get loot from the battles and/or always have a bonus and/or make stuff cheaper especially the walls it’s way to expensive. 4. There should be another server or app that’s not online but you have infinite loot and gems so you can have slot of fun attacking Fake people it’s like clash of clans just having a hacked version but not actually hacked and that you need WiFi to use but if not it’s fine it would be really fun and if you want it could cost a few bucks I bet you will make a lot of money if you do it and I’ll tell people to buy it. I think that’s it and one more thing can you make it easier to upgrade levels in clans?? Thank you tell me if I should send you a email instead. I hope i see this in the next few updates at least the practice mode thing but I hope more. Thank you! I love this game!!!!!!

I have been playing for almost 8 years and now have 25 accounts. Non-stop fun and strategy. Great to be in a clan for the chats, and helping your fellow clan mates. Love the clan wars. Great strategizing with your clan on attack strategies. You will love this game. Oh course there are hiccups, what game doesn’t have them but SUPERCELL is fast on fixing them. There is only one issue I have that still has not been rectified by them and that is the banned players that were cheating in the game, we are now stuck with them in our friends list with no way of getting rid of them. How they managed to get in there is beyond me. We can’t delete them and SUPERCELL won’t deal with their screw up, they won’t access your friend list. It is very frustrating having to clear out a friend request that is not there every time you log in to your account please fix this issue lord knows it is now 2 years later with no resolution. I would give you 5 stars if you would only fix this problem.

I have been playing clash of clans for on and off 7 years. The game is such a master piece. The simple game mechanics can be quickly understood, yet advance to chess like complexity. The upgrade process is fun, and always having something in the horizon to work too is amazing. The community has as much to do with the game as the developers. There is a tone of resources to learn about attacking, farming, base building, etc. Fairly frequent updates keep people engaged, and the quality of life is always getting better. Now, all of this greatness creates a problem. As you advance up the town hall levels, upgrades take longer. Of course. But, upgrade times start to get out of hand at about town hall 10. A few upgrades take over a week at th 10. The progression system is fairly logical, but it is hard to stay engaged when that exciting new troop won’t be ready for over a week. Amazing game. Even better Company. An absolute legend in mobile games. But, a little bit of room to improve.

reviews.t: Best game on the App Store
reviews.x: This masterpiece is exciting and addicting from the beginning, the idea of being able to control an army in order to strategize different fronts and tactics is truly beautiful. The game’s evolution over the years also shows how much the people at supercell care about their game, and they do a very good job at spicing the game up when things start to slow down in pace. Edrags for example, most people up into town hall 10 preferred ground attacks over air, especially with the GOWI wipe. But then Edrags dropped at th11, and it totally changed both the dynamic of raiding and setting up your defenses in order to counter the Edrags’s new and exciting gameplay. Their monthly pass is the cheapest on the market, and easily is over a 30 dollar value if you max out your storages each month at 25mil gold/elixir and 250k dark elixir. Thank you Supercell for always making sure I have a game that I can honestly say is an amazing mobile game.

I used to love playing this game as a child. I was a very dedicated player and even poured over $200 dollars into the game. Many years later, I just wanted to get back into the game and admire my old base and the countless hours and hard work that I devoted to this game. I found that I lost access to my account since I didn’t link it to a Supercell id and tried to contact their customer support to no avail. News flash, their support options are horrendous; their email was very difficult to find and offered no help (it referred me to the in-game support). To make matters worse, I can’t even use the in-game support because they banned me for phishing when I was trying to get my OWN account back! I even play their other games, Hay Day, Clash Royale, and Boom Beach, and yet they still suspect me to somehow be suspiciously trying to access someone else’s account instead of the logical explanation of trying to access my own account. To think that an enormous and successful game company such as Supercell has such an atrocious customer support system when their players are paying so much money to them is abhorrent. Shame on them for not putting their players (and customers) at the forefront when we are the sole reason that they’re making money! Sincerely, a frustrated and disappointed former clash player.

My biggest problem with this game is their slow update cycle. I’ve been playing this game since that fist Super Bowl commercial way back in the day. Alas! After countless hours, I am now a maxed TH. At first this was a fantastic feeling. Then, a couple months later, an update got released. No big deal, I’ll just continue my upgrades and do it again. It made it fun. This process continued for about a year. What I noticed during this time is slowly but surely, everyone in the clan was becoming maxed as well. Also, the time between updates kept getting a little longer than the previous. The result is everyone end up getting bored for about 2 months waiting for the next update. When the update finally drops, it’s only one or two TH levels and maybe 5 royal levels. Once you’ve played the game as long as I have you can get max again in a few weeks. Then, the cycle continues. More of the clan becomes maxed. The wait time gets longer. I finally gave up and deleted the game. It was tough. My clan was like family and we’d been together for many years. Some of us since the beginning. What SC needs to do is release an update that is substantial, massive maybe. Double the TH levels ... something ... anything to break the cycle. But alas, the recent update FINALLY dropped and it was exactly the same. Thanks but no thanks SC. I am done for good. I feel this is a trending feeling with a lot of other players. In a year or two, we will all say, “hey, remember Clash of Clans?”. “Yeah, that used to be a fun game before they got greedy”.

reviews.t: Just absolutely solid with an honest company
reviews.x: Super cell is an amazing company, I’ve played several of their games and particularly liked clash of clans and clash royale. I’ve been playing these two games for about 3-4 years and am close to maxed out on both. I will say the strategy of CoC is a little shallow and at some points I’ve got into seasons of just login, collect resources, do the duties of being a clan leader, log out every day. But they always draw me back in at some point and I end up enjoying it. Wall upgrades and hero upgrades are a little tedious but again, it’s been worth it to me. Both CoC and CR have just a solid base game that is just mostly faultless and doesn’t need money. I’ve spent $10-20 on clash royale but it had very little in-game effects, most cosmetics and slight time savers, you can definitely play it entirely free as I’ve done with clash of clans! On CoC even ‘season pass exclusive’ hero skins can be bought by in game currency (gems) after a while of saving.

Game is good and gets better the more time you put into it ,but if you started playing this game in its first few years you know they didn’t have supercell ID. I had a town hall 10 that I invested money and hours in a long time ago and I recently tried to recover it . I now have a new town hall 9 account that I made a year or two ago that I have invested time and money into as well. I contacted supercell help and I tried answering their recovery questions as best as I could but I don’t know who would remember exactly what device month and year they originally downloaded clash of clans on. At the end of the questioning I was banned on my new account for account phishing my old account that is in my original clan made by me and friends. I was even in the clan and doing war with my new account in that same clan. I had just bought the October season pass. I messaged supercell again and tried to see if they could unban be because the information they were requiring to recovery my old account was crazy, but they said bans are final they won’t unban anybody. I had no history of account phishing or any misconduct before and they just terminate my account like it’s noting. Now I have two accounts that I’ve put hours and tons of money into that I lost. Makes me want to stop playing.

This is good in general but troops should not have time to train. And buildings should take less to upgrade and heroes should not have a wait time to heal. We should not wait for anything to upgrade it should be instantly. Now, the biggest problem is when trying to recover an account or when a friend wants to give you his account but has been abandoned for a while. To begin with they should have a number for customer service because they take too long to reply to players. Also, because they take very wrong decisions. Yesterday I was trying to get an account that my friend had left abandoned. Well, just because I said that asking for the time that the account was inactive and the devices that you had played, because you would not remember that info, which is the reason why there are so many villages abandoned. Due to asking such non sense questions like those. Just because I said I did not remember that info, my account got banned. So even though the game has good things, this makes it the worst. People who work for this game should not be assuming things for missing info, they should find a way to make sure of what they think. I was never planning to steal someone’s identity. They make false accusations based on inaccurate information. That just takes everything away. The person did not even allowed me to explain anything. So maybe hire people who cannot accuse innocent people, because this is terrible. I have played this game for years and never experienced something like this, but the problem is the type of questions and the people behind that do not know what they are doing. There is no need to ban someone just because they do not know how to answer a question. This is the worst thing I have ever seen in this game and it is so unfair. Please work in all those issues.

This game is fire, there are a few things to keep in mind if looking to download it and play it. First never ever ever rush your townhall reason being is that it looks appealing to do that but ends up in more work later on and also it makes you less valuable to a good clan if your rushed. Another thing is don’t expect this to be the game you’re hopelessly addicted to and can’t stop playing 24/7, it is a slowww game to grind on and once u get into higher TH levels upgrades take DAYS and I’m not saying this is a bad thing, it does get annoying but it keeps people from being on it constantly which is good, now my situation is a bit different because I’m a clan leader and I have to be on more making sure that our war is going alright, demoting or promoting people and possible kicking the people I don’t want. So I have more responsibility and have to be more active then the average joe who can get on for 15 minutes a day start a few upgrades, do a few attacks and call it good. And lastly don’t let other people affect how much fun you have in this game, there are gonna be toxic people you bump into no doubt, so if u join a clan and one or two people are annoying or whatever don’t be so quick to just leave and find a new clan. These days there aren’t to many decent clans out there so if u find one try you’re best to make it work and trust me the leader will appreciate it. But if u land in a clan where everyone is toxic and rude and possibly inappropriate then feel free to leave, but what I’m saying is don’t let one or two people ruin you’re fun. Also if y’all want feel free to join MY clan (the clashers) were an English speaking clan that’s active daily that encourages donating and taking part in our daily clan wars!

I have been an avid fan of this game since 2013 and although it’s one of favorite mobile games of all time it still can never truly be great. The game is completely pay to win and everyone knows it, I just got back into it recently though and started a new base. I’m only at TH8 and it’s already bad, leveling up hero’s is awful and not rewarding, it’s literally impossible to make it onto the leaderboards without spending absurd amounts of money, and the attacking system although fun at lower levels one your maxed its boring since there’s no more new troops or strategies to learn. Something I can praise the game for though is that when I initially played the game the only way to get resources was attacking, the campaign, wars, collectors, and your moms credit card. Now there’s tons of ways to get all resources, but the main reason why this game can never truly be great is because you can’t play it for long. Sure you can spam gems all day but unless your Jeff Bezos it’s impossible to keep up. The game is a giant money scheme with the front of being a fun casual mobile game, and even though it is fun at times, it isn’t fun when it takes 4 days to upgrade 1 singular mortar to do 80 more damage. I would rate this game 5 stars but I have to go get 28,000,000 gold to finish my walls (I’m not kidding).

This game is AMAZING!!! The fact that it’s still well know and it’s 8 years old I beleive is amazing I played along time ago before they brought a clash royal twist to it and added new troops, and well I quit playing it got boring. This was about 5 years ago and I’m 15 now. And as of now and about 6 months ago I downloaded it again... and IT WAS BETTER!!! It is funner now and I still like it and all but I mean I’m a th9 and almost maxed out besides walls (which take a ton of gold or elixer) and traps! But tbh I’m getting bored again I’ve always liked this game but over time I kinda getting bored of it it’s the same thing till u get to a new th. So I mean it’s a 5 star game and all but it needs something major to happen. Maybe like how they added a night base, which was cool, they should add a sky base or a underwater base just to let u get back in the game more and while ur training troops u can go to another village idk but I think it would be cool 😎 anyway great game over all 👍

reviews.t: Banned for no reason? Thanks supercell
reviews.x: I was falsely banned for account phishing because I was trying to get my alt account back that I haven’t played on in 2-3 years. I’ve had the game since May 2013, I’ve spent over $80 on the game and I ask the “support team” one question about finding my old account and then I get banned and lost everything. I understand wanting to preserve privacy and I totally support that, but banning without any warning and permanently banning for a first offense which was false at that? I just don’t understand. I’ve also tried getting in contact with them anywhere that I can and they have been absolutely no help saying “the best place to get help is in game u see help and support.” How am I supposed to get help on an app that I can’t open because you’ve banned me?? Also, when in contact with the support team they asked me for information that I can only see if I was on the account (for example, my game ID). How am I supposed to tell you my information that is no longer visible to any person? I’d be fine with getting banned if I actually did something and I would understand that, but perma banning me for asking a single question and not even giving me a warning? Please tell me how that makes sense??

I lost my account due to my iPad breaking and having to get it fixed (didn’t have supercell id). So I got the same iPad after being fixed and the account wasn’t there, so I went to support and we were going back and forth for 3 days until I messed up my new email for the id, I missed one letter in email and when I contacted them back saying that I did mess up writing the email and told them the actual email I was trying to use and the one I accidentally used. Instead of them trying to understand that human error is a thing by missing ONE LETTER, I got perma banned and that was my maxed townhall 10 base. I was not gonna waste anymore time or money on the stupid game after all that work of about 4 years just to get perma banned because I missed one letter in the email I was trying to use. Get better people for support, ones that are patient and don’t just instant perma ban you because they think your “account phishing”. By the way I was contacting the support on the same iPad as my base I was trying to get and all the above conversations, so why would they think I was trying to get someone else’s account?

So i dont wanna give this 1 star just because im mad, because its a great game and even the leagues still work well. The problem is how there is not a very clear explanation of starting one. So im the leader of a clan, and i have a couple cos who were in the last league, and they saw you could change the members before a war at any time. Let me just say that starting league looks very similar to starting a normal war, so when one of my cos saw the menu of who to add to league, they thought it had to be either 15 or 30 depending on the league type they chose. Because normal wars you cant have any extras it has to be exact. It also tells you how many people youve selected at the bottom. So they selected a random 15 just to get league started thinking that they could just change it later. But now theyve started league with a random 15 players and we have no way of canceling or changing people out, even though preparation day for the first war barley started. Now 60% of my clan cant participate in league and we cant do anything about it. I would just like to see this changed in a future update. Like if you can change the members at anytime before a war, why would they make it so you are limited to those you selected before hand. It would make more sense just to let you change out the participants with anyone in the clan.

reviews.t: It's great if you wanna pay for the pass...
reviews.x: I’ve come back after a long hiatus, and really enjoy what’s been done. One change I would make: be able to see how much each individual in the clan has donated to the war clan castles (and have that add to their total in the clan castle like other donations). Nobody donates to the war clan castles, and this would be a good way to incentivize it. Because then, for CWL especially, that would play into who got bonuses at the end of the week. I’m tired as a coleader being the only one filling war cc. Loot isn’t as frustrating to grind for as in the past, though buildings still take an age and a half to upgrade. My primary complaint here is the season pass. In past months, there was great loot even in the free track, you could get several million of each resource (10,000s for dark elixir) Over the last several months, this has decreased significantly. And instead, they add an “exclusive” statue decorations?!? Those are ridiculous and do nothing! The potions are also kinda lame. Gimme wall rings and resource boosters, not power and hero potions...back to the “exclusive” statues, I don’t want my base to be pretty, I want my defenses to be strong. I want loot to upgrade and speed up building times, both builder base and regular like there was before! Feels like a cheap way to make people pay more money in this game, and I’m not someone who pays money on a mobile game that I jump onto for probably no more than 30 minutes in a day...stop being greedy Super Cell

I’ve been playing clash of clans for a while and I’m writing a review because I’ve had it and am very irritated by this. I have started to work more frequently on my builder base and what I have noticed is that as soon as your trophy count is about to reach another thousand, the game will purposely match me with a player with level 12 troops and a level 7 battle machine while I only have level 10 troops and a level 4 battle machine. Mind you my builder hall is only a level 5 while the opponents hall is always a level 6 and occasionally a level 7 which is obviously just setting me up for total destruction as I don’t even have the same amount of defenses as my opponent. And as I get 3 starred right as I’m at 1997 trophies my opponent claims 30 and then I get brought back down which is very frustrating. I know you want people to purchase gems and other items to boost upgrading but you can do it in another way, purposely matching players up with opponents they are obviously going to destroyed by and driving their anger level up just to get them to buy stuff from you is sick. The game is great but that aspect brings it down.

Absolute worse experience with customer service i have ever had. I started playing back in 2014 and took a break around 2016. Recently i tried to log back into my old account that i spent 2 years of time developing. During the account recovery process i provided all the required information, facebook used, checking account used for in game purchases, first and last purchases, all phones used during that time. It took 4 days of myself actively trying to communicate with the staff. Customer service only responded to me between the hours of 12:30am and 1:30am, with each response was a new customer service agent requesting the same required information. In the meantime of waiting for a response once every 24 hours, i was playing a fresh account just in case something would have happened. On the 4th day i responded requesting either email, phone or someone closer in to my timezone so i could possibly be reunited with my old account and pick up where i left off, basically th10 but basically maxed th9. After again another 24 hour wait i woke up to my account being banned for “Phishing”. Granted it was only a th5 acc with 4 active days of work its still the principle. You shouldnt want to participate in a company that doesnt support its customers or members.

reviews.t: Good Game, Costumer Support Is Bad
reviews.x: The game itself is great, I had played it since I was in middle school I am now a college student and as I’ll let y’all know I obviously was not gonna remember my log in credentials for that long. (I had changed my apple ID because i used to use my parents considering I wasn’t over 18 yet) I tried contacting support to see what I could do to get my account back, I was answered back and they told me they where going to check if they could do anything and they left me on hold for two hours then ended the conversation without an answer. So I decided to contact them again the following day and before they even replied back after I carefully described my situation and all I knew about my account ID number and everything they PERMANENTLY BANNED my account for “Account phishing” they probably thought I was trying to STEAL my OWN account. I wouldn’t have had such a big problem with it if I had gotten at least a fricken reply back. But support chose to not help me, they didn’t show any care. Simply ignored and permenantly banned me. Years of work into my account just gonne, I tried starting on a new account from zero but it’s just not the same anymore, it’s not motivating what so ever.

reviews.t: I love this game, but need changes!
reviews.x: I love this game I really do, I’m 15 years old and my brother is 19 years old me and him have been playing this game making new accounts back to back just for the fun of it. But I also loved our clan, I stopped playing for a while bc I wasn’t available to play and so most of our members left our clan and now that I’m back up playing the game it’s not really fun to be honest. I use to be on it for hours and hours playing and talking in global chat and getting people to join our clan and now that’s it’s gone my clan that me and my brother made is dead. We have a few people that stuck with us but like we would like to have more higher people in the clan but it’s super hard with the new tech to get people. If I’m being honest it doesn’t help at all I invite and invite but they don’t join. With the next update I really recommend you guys to add back the global chat or else you guys will be loosing more and more people who love the game everyday. Just a heads up.

reviews.t: Can a developer read this please?
reviews.x: Hello! I highly enjoy the game and the overall ease of progressing in the game. I often find that the clan aspect of the game is such an important one, especially given the monthly clan events we are able to participate in. In order to compete with bigger clans, this often means recruiting strangers. Given that this game is played internationally, this often means recruiting people that speak different languages other than English. I’ve found myself playing with plenty of people from various cultures and have used google translate on many separate occasions so that we could all be on the same page. I’ve wondered if there would be any way to implement some form of translation operating system within the game itself. This would allow more people from various countries and languages to come closer together. Honestly, given how long this game has been around I’m surprised there isn’t some kind of option to do this already. I didn’t even think it would be possible but I began playing State or Survival and noticed that they have implemented a translation option into their game chat. Now, it isn’t perfect and I still find myself going to google translate at times but it’s a start. Also, that game makes it easier to translate because you are able to copy the game chat directly instead of going back and forth trying to type everything manually. This may be another option that might be helpful too. If we can’t implement a direct translation system, how about an option to copy game chat directly? This would allow for an easier transition to using google translate. It would also most likely be easier to do and a quicker temporary solution. I don’t know if anyone within the community will actually read this but I hope someone actually does because I think it would be a huge improvement to an already successful game. If you’ve read this far, thank you for taking the time and I hope you have a wonderful rest of the day.

Hey, I’ve had the game since 2013 and it’s definitely come a long long way. I lost interest at town hall 9 (when the max was town hall 10) and then I decided to get back into it in mid to late 2019. I absolutely do not regret that decision. Supercell absolutely has come through with the updates to the game. Sure, they can add some more troops to the game but that will come with time. I have No doubt I would be a max town hall 13 if I had not had my 1-2 year hiatus from the game. This game has gotten me, my mom, my brother, and my girlfriend addicted to the game and we all have a great and enjoyable time playing in the same clan together! We absolutely love talking about the game and competing. If you’re on the fence about the game or have just started and are frustrated, get it, you won’t regret it. The journey is like No other. 5 star review for a 5 star game. ✌️ only negative is that they keep taking my money 😂 I’ve gotta stop

This game is quite fun and me as well as my family have thoroughly enjoyed playing the game and doing things as a clan together. It brings good discussions into the home and some more bonding time, but we’ve all agreed the game is getting a little boring. I stopped playing at town hall six because I merely couldn’t spend all the time to wait on upgrades and building time. The gems were too expensive, and I didn’t have al the money to purchase enough to complete a building. Which is why I’ve got a suggestion. Instead of just shortening the time it takes to build things, and or drop the prices (which would cause you guys to lose more money), what if you just made an option to where you could use a small amount of gems and it would drop the time. Say you only have 150 gems but the full building price is 2000 gems, instead of just waiting due to not having the money to buy more gems. Make a setting to where say 150 gems drops the time by a day or some hours, ( in general just certain gem amounts can drop a certain amount of times so you don’t have to buy the full thing.) So then, people with only five bucks or so of spending money can buy gems and drop the time off their building time just a bit. In the end, you’ll inevitably make more money that way as more people (who maybe didn’t buy gems before because of the price) will likely start buying smaller amounts gems that they can afford to use.

I think clash of clans has held its own over the years as a great game; I’ve been playing since 2015. But, i think an update that would have people log into a new updated server where only confirmed accounts exist and all forgotten ones are left behind in the old server. This wouldn’t delete accounts, but rather weed out many, many dead clans and dead accounts from the actual area of play. And say after 60 days of inactivity an account is moved back into the old server, and when everyone in a clan hits 60 days of inactivity, the clan is moved as well. Maybe you guys already do this, who knows. Also bring back the global chat - but maybe put an easy on/off button for it for those who don’t want to participate. Or a parent passcode if parents are concerned about their kids being on the global server. Also clan chats are dead, can we create incentive to make people talk? Or like redesign the chat thing and merge it with the “search clans” area? I think it needs to be easier for people to connect - it feels pretty lonely after like 10 mins. And people just keep joining and leaving clans like its nbd. Maybe add an in-app forum area. I know I’m throwing a bunch of suggestions but they’re just ideas, hopefully this helps.

reviews.t: Honest thoughts after playing since release
