reviews.x: I began playing this game when TH8 was max level and rumors for th9 were flying around. I loved the game from the time it was released up until a year and a half ago. I loved clash of clans because you had no need to spend money and could enjoy the game for what it was. The occasional 5$ here or there was spent for builders, etc. I was heavy into Game of War but that game became Pay to Win. It required 100s of dollars just to continue playing the game. The game became that way by offering 5$ packs and the developers got greedy. I am beginning to fear that is what is happening with this game. As a th13 working my way to max, I find it almost impossible to play and level up buildings without the gold pass. I have been in legends league and devoted to the 8 attacks every day but without the gold pass, you get eclipsed by all of your clan mates. This is really worrisome because it’s becoming a pay to win game. Without drastic changes heading off this pay to play ideology, I fear this game will begin to die. Many of my clan mates that are max th13s are upset with the game for the same reasons of pay to win and troop Ai being inconsistent. Many of these max level players are pondering quitting because they feel as though they can’t keep up. A simple way to balance this would be to make the gold pass cost 500 gems so people could earn it instead of spending money. It keeps free to play players happy and allows you to continue making money from those players who wish to spend 5$ for 500 gems. I love this game I hope it continues to flourish but without major changes, I worry for this games lifespan. I would love to have a developer respond to this on how they are planning to help keep their free to play player base. Thank you for your time!

This game use to be fun. Farming and playing it for a bit. Making friends and having fun with clans. Doing wars and collecting loot. Now supercell. You ruined the only fun game you made. “We added the personal break so you can do other things” Did you not clearly think. we could’ve done that on our own. We played your game a lot because we thought it was a fun and amazing game. We didn’t play the others because they weren’t as fun as yours! Now you forced us out of our accounts just so we can play some other stupid game! Like come on guys. Please get rid of it. I’ve been playing the game for so long with my friends I’ve grown to like it. And now I have to sit there for like 15 hours just so I can play the game. And other times it doesn’t even let me. It bugged out and it’s been going for 24 hours and it’s still bugged. Please get rid of it. You would make the game better and less stressful: while in the middle of something you’d just get kicked out. Please super cell. There’s millions of people who love your game. Don’t ruin it already.

Well I had downloaded the game because my friend had recommended it. I had often played it but didn’t enjoy it or understand it while I was a beginner. Eventually I had become more familiar with the game and started to enjoy it, and had played for hours every day. Then I had stopped playing as much and had deleted the game. I redownloaded it awhile after that; but yet again deleted it. Recently my friend asked if u still had it and I didn’t at that time. He had said I should download it and eventually I started to begin to deeply understand the game itself. He had got me into the a clan and it was amazing. The clan was friendly and almost all the time someone was online. Then I had my home village redone by my friend and then like 2 weeks ago I had it rebuilt by the clan leader. He was really friendly and had make me Co-Leader for trusting him. Now I play everyday for hours and cannot go a day without it. Although it seems as I’m saying it’s bad it’s not because I play everyday for maybe 2-2 1/2 hours combined each day and enjoy the game so much. My point is it’s overall a great game and very friendly, and I would recommend to anyone who needs and new game to play. I think the game was thought over well and have no concerns with anything.

reviews.t: Great game' but not to fun because
reviews.x: Overall this game is the best game in my opinion, but there is something missing, what is missing? I'll tell u there is no live events to give more coins, elixir or dark elixir I mean I know there is A (I mean it only 1 )A live event the clan wars but what about a race to get coins and stuff. what about a task to get a free premium pass for the monthly things (I can't look because the game is updating now) I mean thy would be amazing, but the quests would haft to be a 6 day only thing 1 set of tasks a month I mean that would be great for the people that can buy the pass I mean it might make your game more popular I would recommend it to my friends and family if you made a quest for 6 days every month it would be more popular in my opinion please think about it then ask other people that are players on there opinion (don't do this without opinions from some of the players just in case of people not liking it at all.)

This is a great addicting game that you could easily lose track of time while playing. But as in every game there are some things that could be changed for the better of the game. First, in friendly battles within the clan, why do you have to wait 24 hours to have a new base attacked. I would want to know right away if I should modify it or change the layout completely. Also for clan leaders to find members there should be another filter for non-rushes where the player has his building and defenses levels caught up to the town hall that he/she is currently at. Another change is that you should be able to buy the gold pass with gems. Most of your players are kids below 16 and can’t get a job to afford the pass. But by making it purchasable by gems, you would attract many more players because they can get all of the rewards. Also maybe you could add a setting that you can turn on called like max-lock, where it doesn’t allow you to upgrade your town hall until all of your building, defenses, traps, and walls are maxed out but the setting starts as off until the player switches it on. You should also bring back global chat, I understand why you removed it but this would be a helpful asset for clan leaders to recruit players and for the average player just to get advice or socialize with fellow clash players. And lastly, PLEASE CUT DOWN BUILD TIMES, and I mean for buildings, to train troops, and research time, it’s time consuming enough to save up the 3 millions gold to upgrade your X bow but then on top of that you have to wait like 3 days. I’m not saying to remove the time just cut it down please. Other than all of that, Great Game and highly recommended!!

reviews.t: This review is a MUST READ.
reviews.x: So the title says it all. I have been playing this game for 8 years. During my play time I have ran the top 3rd clan in the world. Now there is content to be enjoyed here BUT I have literally spent thousands and thousands of dollars on this game over the years to enjoy the content and stay competitive. Supercell is more focused on providing the players content in which you mostly have to pay for to enjoy when the content drops. The new headhunters arrived well how about you wait 10 days to try them out. Yes you can wait but who wants to wait that long? So upgrade times are too long. Supercell also increased the number of layouts also added a change of scenery to your village all in which YOU HAVE TO PAY FOR! There is literally no content that they have pushed out that didn’t force the player to pay for. Now let’s talk about that leaderboard now shall we? The leaderboard for trophies is bought. Players spend thousands of dollars piloting accounts and exploiting the system. The worst part is that SUPERCELL ALLOWS IT! Yes you read that correctly. One of the players in my clan was piloting her account and it was a top account in the world with more than +7000 trophies. I called her out and she admitted to piloting, I then forwarded the messages to support and nothing. They did NOTHING. The only reason is because she gives them too much money. Only reason why Stephanie was banned is because everybody called her out on it and supercell pretty much had to do something at that point. But if one player gives them all the evidence they need nope. They won’t care. Greedy company. That is why after 8 years I’m done for good. Please take my review into consideration if you’re thinking about supporting this game.

Yeah this is a great game in all, but there are a few problems. Number one. When your phone or iPad or whatever you’re playing Clash Of Clans on shuts off because you haven’t touched it in while, and you get back on.........and the game took away at least four-thousand of your Elixir or Gold. Then you can get frustrated. That’s only one problem. Number two. Yeah ok most people may not want to change their name in the game but some people do. So you should have a button to rewrite your name because you don’t like it. That is problem number two. Number three. The last problem. The clash of clans flag for your clan on the left side of the map for your base, and to upgrade to the next level for your clan. Yeah I know probably half of the people who play this game would know how to level up. However probably half of the people who play this game don’t know how to level up. So you should have kind of instructions on how to level up. That’s the last thing. Other than that the game is perfect there is no glitches and it doesn’t blur and the game crashes sometimes but not all the time there’s good graphics and details on the pictures of the game I play it every day and it gives me joy thank you for making this game it is perfect! That’s my review. Thank you for reading!

I’ve played this game for over 7 years now and the programming is questionable still. Troops behave in an illogical manner. Especially in the builder base. A troop won’t always go the closest building even when being attacked by it. The battle machine will walk around a wall to get to a silo while it’s being attacked right next to it. Also i don’t want 5 wall bombers at one time just so I can have 1 in the builder base. I should be able to direct my troops to move in a direction. After all they are MY troops. Just dropping them on each edge and then center doesn’t always send the troops up the center. Other war strategy games have directed attacks why can’t these troops. Same can be said on the defense side. Defense buildings don’t attack what is attacking them. If a building is being attacked it should defend itself against an attacker not what it’s randomly locked on to. The game is enjoyable enough but again I would be actually watching the competition on how they are writing there games if I were them.

Ok. So basically I love this game idea. I love how you can pho’s ally build your base to your liking. The night base is also amazing. I used to play it all the time, but now I just use it for the gem mine🙂. The one thing that really makes me rate this three star, though Is the idea of giving your troops away to other people through clans. This is why I don’t like it: level 2 town halls could easily three star a attack on a level 5 town hall, because they have bowlers and dragons from a req and go clan. That isn’t even the annoying thing, though. I hate when you are attacking someone, and all of a sudden, some LEVEL 20 BARBARIANS just come out of the castle and one shot everyone that I put down. It is extremely unfair. At least give a sign saying “this person has bowlers, barbarians, dragon in their clan castle” I just think it would make a lot of sense to Me. I will still be playing the game, but I really want this to be changed. If you do change it, then I will never thank you enough for doing the change. Thank you for your time🙃

reviews.t: Great game! Could make upgrades easier to do though.
reviews.x: I love this game! It’s surprisingly fun for people who understand how to play. The one thing is the upgrades. Yes, you could just buy the coins or elixir needed, but the kids who play this can’t do that. The time that it takes to do the upgrades is worse when you get farther in. The fact that you only have 1-2 builders that you can easily get, it is hard to get things done quickly. If you want to speed things up, you have to use a rare type of currency called gems. Again, you could just buy them. But I don’t want to, as well as probably a lot of other people, so you are stuck waiting 7 hours for an upgrade. The upside is that you have another area you get later on (I think level 15, correct me if I am wrong) and you get to start there, as well as your original island. The attack option is different for Builder Island (again, correct me if I’m wrong with the name). While you would normally just attack an island and see if you could destroy it on your original island, on Builder Island, you go against another player and see how much you can destroy of their island, vice versa. The person who does the most damage wins. In personally like this better than the normal battle because you can see how good your defenses are against attackers, while seeing how to improve your techniques on destroying other bases. Sadly, this game takes internet, so if you are on a trip or somewhere without service, you can’t play it. Otherwise, this is a great game, and I recommend it to anyone who likes strategy and time killing games! Thanks for reading my opinion on the game! Have a great day/night!

I have been playing this game since it came out. I am strongly thinking about deleting this game. Yes, it looks good and the game is good but you will have zero enjoyment playing this game because everyone you play against dumps thousands of dollars in real money into this game. This game is not worth even spending fifty dollars on. Do yourself a favor save your money to buy real life things like food and clothes and just use this game to pass the time if you must other than that delete it. The matching system is way off. Another way to get you to spend money. Again use this to pass the time or just delete it Game play is increasingly worse across all of the supercell games. All they want is your money. They don't care about your game experience. In fact they want you to get angry so you spend more money. The targeting of the troops is all wrong. Troops target buildings that make no sense for where you dropped the troop plus dragons go after the ground troops in the builder base for no reason and avoid going after the air defenses. This is all for one reason so you loose the battle get mad and spend real money. Super cell does not care about making this game make sense nor care about your experience they want your money.

reviews.t: GREAT GAME, GOT SOME GOOD IDEAS 👇
reviews.x: Overall, this game is one if the best games I’ve ever played. I love the idea of attacking, upgrading, defending and the clan wars/games. And that you can have two bases in different places. It’s a really well designed game. But I have two ideas that I would like to see added to this game and that would make it even more fun. I find it very enjoyable to be able to start over whenever I want if I’m rushed or just needed a fresh start in other games. I think it would make a difference in how many players enjoy the game when they know if they make a mistake they can start over but still be in the clan they were in, and still have all of the friends they had before not having to wait for supercell to delete your account, like I did, for one month. The second idea I had was being able to donate recourses such as gems, gold, elixir and dark elixir. Now this would make it a lot easier for clan members/friends who are about to upgrade something really big, and then they get raided and need to save again. I think it would greatly impact the way people think of this game and how fun it is. I hope you will take these ideas into consideration. Thank you for taking your time to read my review.

reviews.t: Really good game, some things need some work...
reviews.x: I love this game, I’m a town hall 11, and the normal base is super fun. With the diversity in ways you can attack, and the fact that a lot of this ways can work and no troop is absolutely useless is really nice, and I have little to no problems with the main base (except maybe it could take less time to upgrade things...) however, my problem lies with the builder base. The separate town hall on a different island has introduced several new defenses, and is mostly fun... mostly. The problem I have is how busted the crusher is. As a defense in the game, it’s cool, but the fact that it three shots troops that are supposed to be tanks is kinda busted. And it’s not the fact that they exist, because normally you could at least try to avoid them, but for some reason when you want a troop to break a wall, they travel all the way around the base to the one little opening that someone has both their crushers. It makes it hard to attack when you constantly get troops dragged to where the crushers are. And I know there is bombers and stuff, but they take up an entire army camp so I lose so much space for actual troops. I just dislike how the builder base attacking has a lot of changes needed in my opinion, but other than that it’s a great game...

Such a good game been playing for 6+ years and have loved every year. A couple things I would add just to make it a little more enjoyable is that you should get matched up in the clan war leagues with the players that you put in let’s just say that we put in a town hall 6 as our number 15 and then the other clans number 15 is a town hall 10. Also I don’t know if people will just take advantage of this but I think you should be able to donate resources to your fellow clan mates because when you are stuck at a town hall 10 and all you have to upgrade is your hero’s I think you should be able to give a certain amount out dark elixir or Gold or Elixir. And I think you should try to make the builder base more enjoyable I always say to my fellow clashers is the builder base didn’t have a gem mine I wouldn’t play the builder base at all but like make it to where the gems aren’t the only thing that translates over to the home base. Thank you

Like many people who began playing clash of clans at a young age like I did, I stopped playing for a few years. During this quarantine, I wanted to play on my old account but wasn’t sure how to go about getting it back. I contacted supercell from a new account, provided them information about my old account and spent pretty much a full day providing that information to a bot. The next day I was responded to by someone named Santiago. He asked me a few more questions, payment history, old account name, etc. I went to log back in a few hours later to see if Santiago had responded, and I was unable to do so. My account was permanently banned for a phishing attempt. I’ve emailed them twice now and haven’t gotten a reply that didn’t seem auto-generated. I don’t know how such a huge company doesnt have a phone number to call. Now, I don’t know if I’ll be able to play since my apple id is permanently banned due to an attempt to recover my old account. Horrible, horrible customer service. If anyone sees this from supercell my id was chadywick, i was level 88 with a townhall 9. Please help me get my account back so I can play while we’re all quarantined!

reviews.t: Games amazing but plz take out electro dragon out of clan castle
reviews.x: Games been fun, having clan that you and your friends can play together, interact with other people, and form strategy. The only problem that I’ve come across is the freaking electro dragon. I’ve have so much trouble trying to kill one single electro dragon, and it doesn’t help that most of the base that I attack have there clan castle in the middle of the base. So I have to waste so much troop just to get the stupid dragon out, and at that time all of my troops are wipe out. I like to used loons minions lava hound strategy a lot, but an electro dragon can wipe out all the loons in one single shot. It also does not help that I’m going against a fully maxed out electro dragon with my puny level 6, 5, 4 troops. Its been a nightmare going against this maxed out dragons that at this point I just quite playing the game. Plz take out the electro dragon or at least have them only at townhall twelve or something.

reviews.t: Love it, more loot, better language
reviews.x: I love this game with all my heart. Best mobile game I’ve ever played. I loved how you guys made it that it was easier to get home base loot. I also love how in the pass, we can get builder base loot. It’s also ways when we can play as a team and each our bases grow and make new friends. I realized that after Clan War League, we gets stars and use them in the shop. And it’s very easy to get what you need. But, I was looking at the builder base ad noticed we can’t use the stars their. So I was thinking we can get loot their and other important items their if we need them. I proclaim this because I’m on the verge of being a builder base hall 6 and it takes way to long to get maxed walls when I get only get an amount of that gold in one day. If we were able to get builder base loot there, people could be able to upgrade more without waiting for to long.

Supercell, makers of Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Hay Day and Clash Royale seem to have a problem with Americans. They are based in Europe so I suppose they are catering to the home team but its also apparent they really like the Asian countries as well. I happen to be a night worker, so I’m up all night regularly and have noticed that most special events that bring extra opportunities for stars, points, gems, etc., always seem to start between the hours of midnight and 4 AM in the U.S. This is prime hours for Europe and Asia but most Americans are sleeping. So, of course, this gives an obvious advantage to Europeans and Asians. Maybe this explains why the top clans and players in the world are always from China, Japan and Korea with a few Europeans . No big deal since these games are becoming boring and repetitious but after building your bases and developing your troops over several years to then be stomped on by some short timer from China who bought his base and maxed it out takes the skill out of the game and replaces it with whose daddy gives the biggest allowance. Too bad. These were great games at one time but the endless procession of pointless upgrades, designed to force you to keep spending money or get crushed, has caused the SuperCell games to become predictable and reward those with the deepest pockets over those with skill.

reviews.t: A Fun Game but needs work
reviews.x: I’ve been playing for about three years it’s a fun game but ever since they took out global you can’t get good members any more the ai in the builder base needs to be fixed it drives me mad to watch all my troops right next to the builder hall and decide to hit a wall to leave the builder hall and war omg something always seems to go wrong either troops act stupid or the heroes do and I think attacking with only a min left should not count as a full attack is three mins and people who only get 100 points in clan games are very annoying you should allow clans to pick how many points people have to in order to collect the rewards it definitely would make clans more easier to manage we have herd every excuse in the book that’s for sure and as far as the townhall weapon goes I hate it it’s way to over powered and makes no sense to me as when I attack I will have a large portion of my army hitting the town hall and more then half the time they will all die even with using a freeze or two on it and when I’m being attacked it’s seems like they have no problem even though my weapon is maxed on the town hall I loved the game I could be on it all day but no longer fell the same way due to all the issues I have said I don’t nearly play as much as I did before th13

So I’ve been playing for a few days now and I know, there’s more to the gameplay so why write a review if I’ve only played the beginning. Well it’s really just to point out this huge flaw in early game battles. I went to bed and woke up to my town destroyed, normal until I see how he did it. His clan donated him 2 level 7 balloons and cleaned house with me. Easily. Losing everything doesn’t matter, that can be made back. But the fact that anyone can donate these high level troops to low level players, it’s unfair. That level should be for new players to learn the game together, not get donated strong asf troops just to trophie farm everyone else at that level. All I’m saying is I recommend making it so that if you’re donating troops to another player you shouldn’t be able to donate troops higher than that persons troops. If I just unlocked level 1 balloons I shouldn’t be able to ask my buddy in clan chat to give me some level 6’s so I can clean sweep my competitors at less than 400 trophies. Put a cap on it or something because I’m tired of waking up to my stuff being gone because the guy that attacked me has friends in high places. 2 level 6 balloons and 20 archers, that’s unfair for a TH 3 to have.

reviews.t: Join my clan FNAF3 (also some feedback abt the game)
reviews.x: Ok so I’m like in love with this game right now. I love all the new features and stuff but there’s one thing that I don’t understand. Why can the builder builder go help the home base builders but the home base builders can’t go help the builder base out you know? But I still give this game 5/5 because I’m ADDICTEDDDDDDDD!!! Some of the things that I look forward to in future updates tho is like stacking walls so the air troops have to break the walls to get through them. Also, unlocking a secret area when you reach like level 175 like a secret loot mine. So like you go through the path/tunnel but you have to fight your way through a random max level troop to get through and once you’re through you can spend any amount of gems to get gold, elixer, or dark elixer. I just think that it’ll be an easier way to farm resources. But here’s the catch, you can only farm up to 5 million of all the loot combined, and you have to fight your way back to your village (fighting another max level troop) to be able to keep your loot. And you can only use the tunnel once every week. So it’ll be like use it sparingly. Oh and another thing is that I feel like the game should add is giving like 3 starter base designs to choose from for every Town Hall level (optional to choose from) because for me it’s really hard to come up with a base design. Like I just want to be able to copy and paste one and it’ll be a whole lot easier. (I ALSO MISS GLOBAL) But on the other hand, I really don’t like how if I have the game already opened and I click back in, it says ‘try again’ every. single. time. Also I hate how you have to spend gems to change your name, like I feel like we should be able to change our name for free always, but only like once every 30 days. Like it just makes me so mad but I keep my composure and still play the game because as I said, I’m in LOVEEEEEEEE.

This game is a great to play if your willing to spend the time and effort to make yourself "good". I personally have been playing this game for around 7 years and found it to be addicting, with the constant updates the game does not seem to end. A change I would say that needs to be updated that I found to be annoying is the loss of connection ruining attacks whether that be in war or through a regular attack. For example, I recently just went to attack in war and as soon as I clicked the base it gave me the WiFi symbol. I didn’t even place a troop or spell NOTHING and it counted as an attack and as a 0% this happens to me and known others multiple times and while it is in our position to go somewhere with good connection it should not be inflicting this much damage into the game. Literally just make it so when you lose connection your attack doesn’t count and is erased because if this continues to happen I’m just completely done playing the game it’s getting ridiculous at this point. PLEASE AND THANK YOU.

First of all this is a great game and I really like playing it. Here is an issue I have though. So my friend is a town hall 7 right and he’s trying to get barbarian king like any other player needs to do to get to town hall 8. The only problem was he couldn’t play a lot and as soon as he had around 9,000 dark elixir he couldn’t play for a few weeks. When he finally got back on, he discovered all his dark elixir had been stolen because around 20 people had raided his base, and he had to save up dark elixir all over again. So I am asking that you increase the amount of resources in loot carts because when someone takes 100,000 gold from me I only get 8,00 back so please fix that. Another thing I am seeing is that people are getting banned while trying to recover their account. I think supercell should just put in the time to help people recover their bases instead of banning people just because they don’t think the account is actually theirs. If I had to choose between which issue you should fix first I think you should fix the account recovering one first.

This game is probably one of my favorite games ever. It makes me want to keep playing and I think that the way it was made makes it really addictive and really enjoyable. You can play with your friends in your clan or meet new people from all over the world. You can also rush your base or just choose to take your time and max it out. The only problem that I have with it and it’s not even a really big problem but once you move on with the game and get better, the game gets way more slower like on TH13 upgrading archers to max takes like 11 days for the final upgrade whereas on the first upgrade it took like 15 minutes mabey less which seems so short of a time. Over all, this game is so well made and will go down in history as one of the best games ever. Thank you creators for making a game that is so enjoyable and thrilling and keep up the updates I love them.

reviews.t: Things like walls are kinda expensive
reviews.x: I’ve played the game for a VERY LONG TIME ( since 2012 ) and there were many updates here and there, But global chat going of all things man? I am a pretty rushed th12, and maxed th9s are better than me! Here are a few requests tho. 1) Pls add global chat again. 2) Make walls cheaper. 3) Training time for E Dragon to Be faster. 4) Suggestion for th14: Giga xbow, giga mortar, giga bombs (explodes 5 bombs per 3 seconds), and giga cannon. 5) An extra defense, like another archer tower, cannon, Inferno tower, or wizard tower. Also the walls should be cheaper like a lvl 7 costs 250k! Upgrading 8 of those can upgrade an archer tower lvl 10-lvl 11! Also pls make the mortar and wizard tower a little cheaper, like a 15% reduce cost on upgrades. I love the practice, single player, versus, challenging, friendly wars, wars, and multiplayer. but can the time limit boost up to 4 minutes? Also I would love to see that the upgrades on troop costs change. Overall I LOVE the game. If there was a 6 star I’d rate it that. But I can’t so.... 5 Stars!!!

I always try to act excited about this game, but the truth is, it’s kinda boring. But just because of one aspect, waiting for things to upgrade or be built. The troops are costly and it takes so long to even wait for them to be done. And I think the upgrade costs are fine, except it takes so long for them to be done upgrading. Even upgrading troops takes time! This stuff makes the game boring and hard to progress. And there’s also that stress of having to deal with the other village over seas too. Which, only has one builder, which makes it even harder to progress there. It’s like the game is now stressful rather than fun. I actually prefer Gods of Olympus more than this. Yes, a game which is way less popular and never had been as popular as this game I prefer more. Why? Because there is no waiting for things to be built, or upgraded. You can progress fast which makes it fun, but not too fast of course. The only thing you ever have to wait for in that game is for the nectar to fill up.(The “energy” which allows you to battle, -1,000 nectar for 1 battle, adds 1 nectar about every 2 seconds or so.) And you don’t need to spend any nectar for the story mode in Gods of Olympus, so you can just play that and get up the the next level. And once you are at the next level, it fills up your nectar, enabling you to battle 4 more times. But I can see why this game had a golden age, 2013. It was in a time when mobile games weren’t that advanced, with a very much smaller range of types of games to play than today. Then this one came in and changed the game. But now it’s comparable to a normal mobile game, because other and newer games started to be better. So if you want to become like that again, you really need to not just meet, but beat the best games standards. Which is hard this day and age. And not add ANOTHER village to worry about and keep those long waiting times.

Out of there’re this game has been up and made prices fair for gems and all that. The new feature of paying for a membership to get quadruple the amount of supplies and perks doesn’t seem good for other players that want to get to the same level but without needing to pay. We can still play but it will take way longer for us to get from townhall 10 to 11 without the membership. I never thought clash of clans would result to becoming a pay to win game but overall it’s still a fantastically good game if you’re into strategy and numbers. It’s a beautiful way to interact with people around the world to gain a common goal of earning loot to upgrade and max out your villages. It really makes you feel proud of your hard work! The time it takes to develop the high level buildings and defenses really makes the love and dedication for he game grow. I play it every time I take a break from homework and since training times at a high level take 20 minutes or more it works out perfectly if my screen time between assignments is only 3-4 minutes. Lower now because of the quick train feature. The new builder base village is supper cool and I love how you can’t get your loot stolen. The downside is you can’t get more then what the daily limit gets you but over all it’s smart and all it is is improving constantly and I love the constant improvement. With thousands of people playing and thousands of people of high level that just wit the game, there’s a bunch of loot on the elixir and gold generators I can just nab on the surrounding of the base. The max I’ve seen in a base with all its resources in the producing buildings is 690,000 regular each and 40,000 dark it’s just great. Really takes up time in he beginning but after a while it’s just dedication and I love the game. Practico y the only game on my phone I actively use besides Pokémon go.

reviews.t: Love the game but upgrade cost and times are CRAZY
reviews.x: I love the game and play it everyday at least 3-4 hrs a day, if I’m off work then some days most of the day. Would be nice to be able to have it changed to be a more playable game for hours at a time to keep people busy being able to do things in the game. I mean seriously if you were to make it a place for people to be able to play hours and hours at a time I’m sure the purchases would go up as well. Could be to your advantage and there for more money to make the game even better. Also the amount of coins and elixers it take for upgrades... once you start getting to th9-10 it’s gets very costly and I know your lowering the cost a little in the spring update but I still feel some of it is still very expensive. All in all I love it just wish some of this would be addressed so people could enjoy the game for longer time. I have clan mates that won’t even play if they have troops or hero’s upgrading and I hate it cause it’s affects our clan and donations also clan game help.. Thanks for the game hope to hear something from you all on these issues.

I played for years. From 7 till I was about 11 or 12. I stopped playing out of boredom and moved on to instagram and other social networks. Nothing was wrong with the game, I just exceeded my limit. I tried getting back on a year and a half ago and realized there was something new called a Supercell ID. I didn’t have a supercell ID so I emailed support and after a week of emailing back and forth, I was given my account back. I was happy and I played for a few weeks. I soon got a new phone and completely forgot about it once again. Now, I tried logging into my account with my Supercell ID only to find that I have been permanently banned. I’ve contacted support many many times. Probably around 10 times. It’s now automated support so they just tell me that my request may or may not even be viewed. I am very frustrated with this. I can’t find any other way to contact them. The last thing I noticed, global chats are gone?? That was the main source of entertainment and they’re gone. Dumb decision on that. Everything else seems the same and just as fun as it’s always been. Only now, I don’t have my account and with the lack of customer service I’ll probably never get it back.

reviews.t: A great game but just a few flaws
reviews.x: I think that clash of clans is a excellent game but there just one serious problem recruiting. When we had global chat we could of talked to players and convince them to join our clan and now you can’t do that you either get lucky or you go on a another website and advertise there and still it takes a while especially if your a newer clan with just yourself because most people like me are going to join the bigger clans the clans with a lot people and not give the clans with 10 members or less much thought but when global chat was a thing lower level clans could convince people to join them because they were saying the benefits of joining and why there clan was great and when global chat was a thing I gave these lower level clans a chance but now it’s harder to give them a chance because all you get to see is the description and some clans you can’t even find.I understand why you removed global chat but you should make it so you can disable it or enable it. It’s not the best system but I’m sure you could make it work. I hope you can take my idea into consideration.

There can be slight improvements, however, it still is my favorite mobile game out there. I have been trying to find a fun mobile game that is free to play and is an actual good game. A lot of people say that it is extremely pay to win. Part of that is true but if you are strategic with your upgrades and attacks, you can get just as far as someone who blows hundreds of dollars into the game. Town hall 9 is a hard time where lots of players quit or rush because there are so many upgrades. 50 hero upgrades AND two levels of walls is ridiculous. You find yourself raiding without heroes but still trying to get dark elixir and it makes the game a lot harder. But this is a great town hall also because it puts people up to a test to see if they really want to keep progressing or just give up. One thing that is awesome that you are doing is making the hero and wall upgrades cheaper, mainly at town hall 9. I am seriously looking forward to the next update and hoping it will be before the season ends.

The game is wonderful with all sort of things to do and how you think and strategize like building a base and attacking in battles or clan wars. It’s a very addicting game. The problem comes when I build a base. When I was building a base I noticed a wall piece was missing so I tried placing a wall to correct it but it didn’t allow me, so I thought it was probably just a glitch, so I pressed finish later thinking it was gonna fix it only to have my base that I put thought, time and effort get completely erased. I would’ve given this game 5 star but come on how is that just gonna happen I wasted an hour making and perfecting a base, but because I tried to fix a glitch in game, this ruined the whole fun out of it. Seriously, this has happen 15 times from what I have counted and because get more thing as you upgrade your town hall and earn more stuff it makes it that more annoying and obnoxious to have to do it again. At this point it kind of makes it impossible for me to save a base without it erasing for whatever reason.

I’ve played this game since it came out and well I’ve played and restarted, and have different accounts and needless to say I can’t get over the game it’s so much fun and addictive to play! With every update the game improves and now clans are being improved with each update means it’s gonna be fun for clans who are struggling for clan members to join which has been an issue for a long time. Now I have one question since I’ve talked good about the game what happened to global chat? Is it for certain platforms or devices what the heck’s going on? Ik it’s not a bug because it would’ve been fixed but if one of the developers or someone explain what happened to it I’d be happy to understand why it’s happened. Finally keep up the amazing work you guys are doing. You guys the creators of this fine game have made the game more enjoyable with each new update and your listening to the community! 5/5 all the way baby!!!!

I love this game its absolutely amazing. I have been playing for 3 years and I’m getting into it a lot. However there has been one change that I don’t like. First of all I got upset when I found out there was no clan chat because I deleted the game and then got it back without even knowing there were going to take off the global chat. That’s the only fun thing I can do when nobody is active in my clan because on the global chat there were active people. Also when you are looking for a clan you don’t know if the recommended ones are active, donate, or even speak your language so the global chat just gives you a huge head start on a clan. Also if there are anyone who need a clan on the global chat is way easier because now there is a “ find members” button which doesn’t help because they aren’t even active, even though they might use the active daily badge. But I do like that feature were you can put badges on your profile to describe you. SO JUST BRING BACK GLOBAL CHAT.

Okay, I’ve been playing for a long time. I’ve spent years trying to get my base to the top. I’ve seen so many changes to the game some for the better. These recent changes have left a bad taste in my mouth. First the battle pass came out, now I am in no way opposed to this. I’ve never bought it simply because it took the aspect of grinding out of the game. Now all you have to do is buy the battle pass do a couple raids or gem your way to the end. I honestly believe that this took the fun, creative and originality out of the game. Saving gems and grinding to get enough loot for that upgrade has turned into just buy and get to max. My major problem is the global chat being removed. Global chat made this game clash of clans. It is the root of the game, we need it back. Finding clans and meeting people has gotten so hard now. You have no clue of what you’re getting into when you join a clan. Overall the game is amazing but I’ve gone from hours to just a couple minutes a day. The game is just too paid to win nowadays. In my opinion the game is too easy.

I have been playing since September 2014, and the game use to be great. Now it is good; except, everything takes almost three times as long to acquire, and the only people left playing are also from the beginning of the game. Everyone is matchmade with the top %35, even if you’re in silver or bronze. The community deranks purposely. They had to remove the global chat even, due to it being so common. They added Dark Elixir, and other new currencies too. Unfortunately there are only one way to gain these resources, unless you’re often attacking and playing aggressively, but that costs all your regular elixir to train armies, and you don’t gain an even amount when it is all done, usually your army is worth more than the loot. Upgrades for some of these new “resources” are outrageously priced. Anywhere from 30,000 dark elixir for level 2 up to 140,000 for level 8. They’re so many things to pay for, when you only gain 200 elixir an hour, and every upgrade is this cost or greater. Everyone is broke, because we are being farmed by the top %35 of players. Data publicly available from Tencent games shows that fewer and fewer people are playing this game, while those of us who do, are left in the dust. I would have use to recommend this game to everyone, but until they fix the games core problems, it’ll never be good for anyone.

reviews.t: You need to fix this ASAP, however...
reviews.x: I was attacking in a clan war, when all of the sudden, it decided to not count any of my attack. It showed up as a slow internet connection icon in the middle of the screen, it let me finish the battle(the icon was present throughout the whole attack) and I got a 3 star, and screenshot it. Then it proceeds to say internet connection failed and I needed to restart(note I am using data and have been playing the game for 30 minutes before this point). So I wasted an attack, and while My screenshot shows a perfect 3 star, it counted as 14 percent in the war. Not only this, but I was talking with another clan member, and it happens to them too, I have put up with this issue for far too long(since I started). I have played it on an older device and it seems to do it more often. Maybe it’s my phones age, however I promise it isn’t an internet issue. Please fix. Other than that it is a very fun game, and I enjoy playing it. I have been playing since 2016, haven’t regretted any point of it. Just a tad bummed that my 3 star didn’t count. I will give it a 5 star when the bug is fixed, thanks.

I put five stars in order for people to see this. The new update is garbage. The new recruiting system for clans is the worst thing I’ve ever seen. It recommendations people who have the clan invite option on but all the players that they have on the recruit list are in clans. What is the point of implementing a recruiting system, when 90% of the players listed are in clans. I’m not sure what supercell was thinking when creating this update cause you guys definitely did not do anything special with it. You should really bring back global it was one of my favorite parts of the game. If you’re worried about the bullying that goes on in global, it doesn’t really matter, bullying happens in games regardless you can’t really avoid it. Also in global chats I noticed that people who got bullied were backed up by others and often new relationships would be formed due to global chat. Please fire the individual who induced the idea of this recruiting system.

reviews.t: Love this game but GLOBAL CHAT BACK PLZ
reviews.x: Okay I’ve been playing this game for what, around 8 years now and throughout that time I’ve been in love with this game. It was a big part of my childhood and love to death. I’ve been through multiple accounts cuz I was too young to have Facebook and link it up to my first acc back at the time but that’s besides the point rn. I’m pretty sure the entire fan base of this game has been asking for this but PLEASE PUT BACK THE GLOBAL CHAT IJ THIS GAME. This is the only mistake in the game and if u fix it it would be awesome. The fact you t able to interact with so many people around the world playing this game,(I mean some may be toxic), but u get to have sum advice, talk to people about clans and stuff to see which one is the most alive and supportive clan. That was a big aspect that made most of the communtity, no the game itself. So plz put it back. It might not be as gud as it was back den but PLEAAAAASE SUPER CELL PUT IT BACK.

reviews.t: The Mustached Barbarians whom I Love
reviews.x: This game got me through a lot of hard times. And by a lot, I mean A LOT. It even started becoming somewhat of an obsession. Ah, who am I kidding. It’s my life. It started small. I got a bit bored so I’d indulge myself in those lovely mustached barbarians. Then it got a bit worse; I would get on COC mid conversation. My wife would be talking about the latest Dance Moms episode when I’d whip out the ole COC right in front of her. It started quite a few arguments. The obsession quickly inclined over the course of a few weeks. Anytime some minor inconvenience or any single bit of boredom would strike, I’d pull out my one and only known relief: COC and play with it for a while. My wife got to the point where she couldn’t stand it anymore and told me to get rid of COC immediately or she’d leave me. I finally got to my senses and watched as this inconvenience of mine finally was gotten rid of. It’s just me and Clash against the world now!

This game was amazing for the first 2 years I played it. Everything flowed smoothly, I was getting ready to Upgrade to Th10, I was happy overall with the game. Than our WiFi got cut. For about 3 weeks I couldn’t even touch the game. I thought, maybe the less attacks I make, the less I have to defend. A system like that would be more fair. But no. When I come back to the game, I had lost 400-ish trophies, I was kicked out of my clan for inactivity, my loot pool I had collected for Th10 was like almost gone, and my base was falling apart. Basically what I’m trying to get at, is that unless you either have lots of money to waste on gems, or you have inexplicable amounts of leftover time to play, this game is not worth it. I realized after I stopped playing this game how much time I had spent playing this game constantly. It’s addictive (and that’s bad) and it’s not worth your time or energy. Maybe if Supercell could for once not make a game completely fixated on making you play 24/7, I’d play their games. Please, if a dev sees this, at least consider making the game more fair for people who have lives, and don’t want to waste money. I get it’s to make a profit, but you’ve already got plenty of that.

This game is great. Lots of fun. But you guys still should put some more work into ideas. I know you Supercell guys are super smart and fun but this game just isn’t meeting the standards in some parts. I think that some ideas have been missed. One the grand warden. Cool abilities but just not cool enough. What about “race against the clock?” Every 5 levels the grand warden can rewind the time by 5 seconds. That’s pretty cool right? Another one, Archer queen. What about “x-bow mania?” The queen should be able to shoot much faster but loses much of her attack damage. This is very good for cleanup. Every 10 levels she goes an extra times faster. Start at level 10-2x faster at 20% damage for 5 seconds. Every 10 levels increase the times by 1 while also increasing the damage per second by 1. Also it would be nice to have a regular “warden as a troop.” Since these guys are the “smart wizards” maybe they should be shielded from splash or single targets or “ you get the idea.” Other than that this game is the best game ever. These are just some ideas. If you don’t like you don’t have to even remember them. But just take a peak at the complicated stuff about this. Like coding and that stuff. Thanks so much for reading and for a really fantastic game!!

Two years ago I was in the darkest time of my life. I was searching for a purpose in something, but nothing worked. Not school, not drugs, not my girlfriend; I even did alcohol, but that just left me feeling even more lonely. After that I thought I would branch out, so I got involved in a Jamaican dog fighting circle, but I soon learned that that was bad news. I was lost. But it was in this pit of despair that I discovered the thing that changed my life forever. I downloaded Clash of Clans. At first, I was a casual Clasher. But as time went on, COC began to take on a deeper meaning. A raid at 11 pm on a Friday night meant something completely different than a raid at 9:30 on a Tuesday morning. It became something special, something meaningful. Clash of Clans transformed my life. It taught me what it meant to be a father, how to take out a bank loan, even how to talk to people without violently vomiting. I would not be the man I am today if it wasn’t for COC. Now to you out there, reading this review, thinking to yourself, “How could this stupid app ever be useful?” Give it a try. I beg of you, take a chance. You won’t regret it. Thank you, God Bless You

I’ve played this game since it first came out. It used to be great. However, slowly but surely they have coded troops and heroes to be more and more dumb with each update, to the point where they will walk right by a town hall even though it’s the closest object to destroy. The same goes for the heavier defenses as well, like the eagle artillery. Also, the latest legends league update has made the game useless unless you can attack eight times everyday, but if you wanted to attack more in a day you can’t. So, there’s no happy medium. It’d be better the way it was even though then you’d wait for a matchup up to an hour at a time. Now the game is rigged for big spenders and designed to cheat you in war, global, clan war league, and builder base attacks. In summary, if you have lots of disposable income each month and like being cheated every time you attack, then this is the game for you! Otherwise, I’d play real games on PlayStation or Xbox that are designed for the primary purpose of gaming. I stopped playing briefly once before and this time is for good. Maybe I’ve just been playing too long...or maybe they are actually ruining the game with each update. I don’t spend very much on the game either...

This game is probably the star game on every mobile device, some people say that walls are too expensive, and it’s a pay to win. These are the people that don’t really know how to play. If your a th9 and need to upgrade your walls? There is a season bank or clan war loot, or you can spend some CWL trophies and get tons of gold and elixer. I’ve played this game for a long time and it is genuinely the jewel of my iPhone. Clash royal is fun sure, but every other game is nothing in comparison to this game. If you need to transfer your acc then just connect your account to supercell when you first start the game, or as soon as possible. I’ve read some complaints about the global chat. The global chat was really just a chat with twenty other people and about 99% of the time there was some perverted freak to come over and ruin the whole mechanism of the chat. Now for my review. This game is ad-free, one of my favorite factors about this game. It is a game you can grind on for a long time. Full of epic battles and just full of cool things. I would give it 10/5 if I could. Joining a clan can be difficult sometimes, but a good idea would be creating a clan with your friends and working your way up. This is one of the best OG games out there For new players I would suggest speeding up to th7 and then starting to max out your upgrades. Joining a good clan with your friends and/or making your own. Also when your still low level make sure to upgrade your clan castle for donations. They will win the battle for you if you need it and protect your village from enemies. (Their kind of overpowered)

In the game you have to attack people and to get the people to attack you need elixer. In the game the better characters you unlock it costs more elixer so you need to be careful not to use all of your elixer because you need elixer to build buildings. There is also gold which you need very much. When attacking if you think the person is too good or just dosent give enough trophies you can skip them with gold. You also need it to build buildings and upgrade your town hall. While doing all of this you need to defend your base so you need to plan out traps find weak points in your base and place traps there. You need to plan out attack building and you need to plan out your walls to have the most defended base. If another player attacks you and gets at least 1 star you lose points. If they don’t you earn trophies. You need to keep the town hall safe because if they destroy that it’s a automactic win and they get a start. So I really like this game hope you do too.

reviews.t: Amazing game, but some things could be improved
reviews.x: I love this game, it's one of my favorite games, I love almost everything on this game, but there are a few things that could be improved. For one, in donating you either spend a lot of gems or mess up your troop training. I always use quick train, and if I donate troops from my camps, it messes up my whole entire quick train, and I don't want to spend all my gems just to give someone a couple troops. I think there needs to be a separate army camp that has a barracks attached to it, and you can train troops to fill that army camp, you also can't use the troops from that army camp to attack, you can only use those troops to donate, the barracks attached to the camp is always at the same level as your highest leveled barracks you have. I also think that when you invite people to your clan, you should be able to send them a message, and they can see the values of your clan, if they just see, “you’ve been invited to...” they won’t know the values of your clan. I hope you can take these suggestions into consideration. Thank you.

reviews.t: Much more accessible and fair than it used to be years ago
reviews.x: Pros: This is overall a very good mobile game out of the bunch, with a unique art style and focus on troop deployment strategy and using the unique traits of your troops, and spells to adapt and win against “expected” base layouts, it’s easy to play but hard to master CONS: Not too many, but a few notable ones: This game is still very time expensive (Not nearly as bad as it was years ago) , it gets to a point where at town hall 9 you play the game for a while to gain resources to max out what available builders you have open for upgrades, and then to stop playing for a week or two. Matchmaking in the home village is hard to adapt your army to when the army you make is geared towards certain base layouts, there is always the chance your army will get countered and absolutely destroyed by matchmaking, it is impossible to make a one size fits all army for obvious reasons. Sometimes the game will not give you a break. It is a good game to play every now and then when bored, because of pretty decent gameplay elements for a mobile game.

I last posted about how horrible E.d. is and now I played the game some more, I have learned to deal with them. It still blows me away that it will 1 shot my queen if I don’t use the ability the moment it gets close. On top of that I would need to waste a rage and wizards just to kill it. I know I’m finding more things to rant about but now that I have knowledge of luring cc troops and how important it is, I do it every attack now. I used to just never care at all about it and would get destroyed by some strong air troop in their cc. (sometimes) I find it harder to come across E.d. when just solo farming. I still recommend that people just use regular dragons in cc th10 and below. I feel there was a reason that E.d. should be exclusive to th11 and up. (because your more well equipped to deal with this troop). That being said, i still love this game no matter how broken some things may be, this game will always be my favorite game to just pick up and play as far as mobile gaming is concerned. I totally agree with longer building times than other games because you can’t just get everything you want really fast. It actually feels like a massive progression milestone once you finally get that upgrade that took like a week. A longer game is what I would choose, not a short and dull experience that other games have to offer. I do feel that the artwork contributes to my love for the game. Artwork in this game is so underrated and should really be acknowledged. I think my love also comes from the fact that you can just brainlessly spam a single type of army over and over and get better results each time you practice more with it. Like sports.

reviews.t: Was a great game. Customer support is the worst.
reviews.x: Years ago I religiously played this game. It was a fantastic game and even spent a few $100 on it. After deciding to take a break almost 4 years now. I have lost access to the email address associated with my account and given the lengthy time of break don’t remember much of my info except I was a TH 9 almost 10 and this is a little after they released the witches. After trying to regain access into my account I have been denied because of the lack of information I can provide. However, I do have the old email name, and it still should be linked to my current account name. I would have at least thought maybe one could recover using the old email, change the email address to my new one in order to try and gain access that way. The response I was given: we have provided you with our answer to this and will no longer be answering questions concerning this issue. Maybe later you can come back to us with a different problem. Absolutely trash. That’s the worst customer service I’ve honestly ever heard of. 10 out of 10 would have rejoined to play. But, never mind now. ✌️

Yes, it’s about global chat. Global is a huge part of why people loved to play this game. It was fun to have conversations with people around with the world, recruit, see top clans, and just fun to pass time while your troops are cooking. If there was a “troll” or someone being completely inappropriate we had the option to mute them or you can just refresh the game and be in a whole new chat. It ridiculous that one of the most iconic features in the game has been removed. The new recruiting system (I’m sorry to who created it) but it’s absolutely garbage, does not work well and it’s just a waste of time to even look at it. I know many people who quit the game because of this drastic change. Many rewards have been given out I guess to numb the pain of us losing global but I would take global over those rewards. Just really disappointed with this update. I hope y’all actually LISTEN to the clash community (what is left of it) and bring back global chat and have someone police it. You can make the banned from global chat longer, which would lower the ignorance level. Wish I could rate this as -38, garbage. Have a nice one.

reviews.t: This game actually translates into real life
reviews.x: First let me say I started playing this when I was 8 and now I am 15 years old n a week I matured overtime in this game and in my life I am a clan leader of Semi Autimatic (Letter 4 letter) Meeting new people of all ages and all kinds WITH THE SAME INTEREST (Clash of clans) through a game is quite extraordinary. I have been a clan leader for 9 different clans in my 6 years of playing. That brings me to my title of this review. Learning to regulate All ages , ethnicities ,personalities was / is a challenge especially the fact you are not face to face with them . This showed the value to bark ordars while also taking in consideration of others . After learning things from people older and younger I have acquired an very unique talent for understanding and listening. I tend to be very commando and committed while also being the type of person to help the nobody //outcast//left out in my clan and in real life. Just the joy of seeing on a screen this: “wow thanks” or “Your the first person to...” “You actually made my day” even if some were half hearted idc . Still brought me joy. That being said I realized that it would be bring more joy if i did this in my own life as well. The RIDICULOUS upgrade taught me patience 😂 . This game starts out fun, but once you’ve played the game for years you start to get annoyed at little things in the game that would make all the different. The troop AI in this game is one of the worse things about the game. Most troops like to stop what they’re doing to try to attack smaller enemy’s leaving your army open to complete massacre. Also I can’t seem to understand the logic of how you get paired up in versus battles. I seem to always be battling someone with at least one level higher of a builder base. It’s a big disadvantage having 18% less troops than your enemy and lower leveled troops. The amount of time it takes to get something upgraded and how long it takes to get upgraded is ridicules. Supercell must only expect people who want to get real progress in the game will spend real money on their game to get that progress. It took probably 3-4 years to max out my TH9 and TH10 without giving supercell a dime. Now they’ve added 3 more townhalls. It’s going to likely take 10 years to finish it all legit now, so instead I’m likely going to sell my account

This is my all time favorite mobile game, but clan castle donations are broken. I know eventually you’ll be able to not get your army obliterated instantly by them when you get stronger but at town hall 3 to 10(I’m assuming since I’m only at TH9) you’d deploy 5 giants and a wall breaker feeling good and then all of a sudden 2 high leveled balloons, a valk, and a wizard jumps on you as that FRUSTRATING melody starts to destroy your speakers and you quickly tap that abort button and lose so many trophies that you cross into the dirt league. I wrote this review a while back, but today, I was attacking a base my army can handle, and balloons at the new level just jumped me. All my wizards and archers died and all I had was my archer queen, who barely scratched the polygonal paint of the balloons and got one shotted. The balloons then drifted over to my golem and quickly killed him and his golemites. Whenever I check to make sure there’s donated troops, there isn’t but when I have an army doing well… DANANANANA NANANANANA NA NA

I love clash of clans. Everything in it is so clever and everything. However. I took a star off because of this: global chat. You removed gobal chat. Today I found out and let me tell you a story. I was trying to find a new casual clan. I put in my outputs and such but in the end, i couldn’t find one. I ended up realizing that I couldn’t ask 50 people because global was gone so I can’t ask for advice. Never really felt the need to review an app before. But I thought I would share some ideas I have for the game. They need to implement a troop that goes directly to the town hall, it is the most frustrating thing in the game when you get 80% of a base but only get 1 star because your Pekas and hero’s go after elixir pumps and gold storages instead of what’s actually important in the attack....THE TOWN HALL. They also need to do something about the amount of time you have when you attack. 2 minutes and 30 seconds is great when you’re a beginner in the game for attacking, but after you pass champions III 2 minutes and 30 seconds is not enough time to get a full attack in at all. You can’t place all of your troops until you destroy the eagle artillery, which takes about half you’re attack to complete. And when you finally do drop all of your tools, you have about 1 minute to clear the base. I think after you reach champions III or crystal I you should get a time increase on your attacks to 3 minutes and 30 seconds, to give us time to actually attack these massive basses. Thank you

I’ve been playing this game for years... and there is a lot that has changed.. I think the worst part that has changed is the global chat. That was prob the best part. You got to talk to all kinds of people. Talk about their clans and how things ran in them. But now you just have to guess and pick a clan. Don’t know if they speak your language or around your age. If they talk a certain way in their. Who knows?? You just pick one and go with it and keep jumping till you find something. Then the time wait on stuff is crazy. The best part is the new challenges you can do to earn rewards. Since everyone is most likely broke as mess since everything costs sooooo much. I’ve even spent like $5 on this game and that barely put a dent in what I needed to upgrade. It is a fun game to play and talk to people in but that part is cut out for some reason.. literally the best part. It made clan finding easy! Also I don’t really care for the other castle thing over the sea.. a lot of people don’t care for it since they are grinding their main base all the time. It was way better when it was simple. Just a base, clan, clan wars, clan chat, and global chat. But the loot after you get raided is nice! Really like that feature! The others people don’t really do except clan games. Great rewards in that! That’s it for right now I think. Well time to go hop in and out of clans all day to find a decent one I fit into and like 😒

So I’ve been playing Clash for a number of years now, almost since the beginning, and the game has come a long way. Love the community and the moderators/programmers. But if I could make one simple suggestion to improve the donations system it would be to add donation receipts. All too often players receive and or donate wrong troops and spells, and although this may not seem like a big issue it becomes increasingly important at higher levels and with more competitive players. It’s great to get a little pop-up notification letting you know who donated what, but it could be improved. By simply adding a donation list that states who donated what the last few times in the Clan Castle information page it would deter players who continuously choose to donate wrong troops/spells. Knowing there is a list recording donations, players could be better held accountable for their wrong donations. When taken into consideration that at higher levels/TH every single attack counts and even more so in wars, and that Clan Castle troops are part of attack strategies, you can then understand how wrong troops effectively sabotage these attack strategies. I hope to see some improvement of the donations system sometime soon.

reviews.t: Love this game!!! But Global come back please.

I met someone that’s I’ve known for over a year now, and now he’s one of my really good friends. I love everything to do with this game, but what happened to the global chat? Not that I ever used it, but where’d it go? I like that you can now use tags and stuff to show other people what kind of player you are. It really helps find the perfect clan. I’ve been in my clan for over 5 years, but some we’ve found some people that hadn’t had a clan, but where really good. They’re awesome people. Thanks SuperCell!!! Love this game so much!! I love the fact that when people donate, it’s usually out of the goodness of their hearts. My clan has a rule that you have to get 10 donations per season, but most of my clan members have over 2,000. Again about the global chat, please bring it back. I’ve had a lot of people that joined our clan with the tag thing upset because they’re used to finding a clan in global, but not just randomly. There are jerks in global no doubt about it, but some people have found their forever clan from it too.

reviews.t: a Absolute Mobil Game Trend Setter
reviews.x: Clash of Clans is a game best played with friends. People will constantly say stuff like MicroTransactionMania but this just is not true. Yo can easily get gems in game, sure you might speed up the process with MicroTransactions but I never felt like they were a huge problem. The biggest problem this game has is what I call the silver crisis, this happens around silver league 3. At this period you hit a natural road block at which many people seem to quit. This road block being that once at silver 3 you will encounter lots of people with higher skill than you. This will lead to you attacking much higher bases than yourself and failing some people do this cycle of over confidence and failing will lead to some players to quit the game. There is also a issue with the walls being over priced playing some of the top single player missions and getting millions of gold will only allow you to upgrade a couple walls to level 12! And if your wondering at the time of needing to upgrade walls to level 12 you will have around 250+ walls! Another thing great about this game is the fact that it’s free game. It’s also been a around since 2012 and right now it’s November 2019 and there are still 100 million players that get on a day. This game is the best Mobil game in history.

reviews.t: Clan recruitment system is complete trash
reviews.x: This is my favorite game but the devs new what they were doing when they took away global and replaced it with the system we have now to recruit and it’s complete trash.. why can’t they make it so instead the people that pop up are not in a clan ? What is the point of trying to recruit when they’re most likely already in a lvl10+ clan? No one good is going to want to join my lvl5 clan, I can’t find NO ONE worth inviting and if I do like I said they’re either already in a high lvl clan or their inbox is full. It’s ridiculous that they thought that it would work.. I hope they solve this problem before th13 or the next big update because it’s honestly sad and I personally think it’s making the game worse off. Just bring back global or do something that actually helps us. The labels are honestly another bad choice bc anyone can just chose the label veteran or trophy pushing and not even be pushing trophies that high? Labels should actually matter but they don’t... #bringbackglobal let’s make it happen people

reviews.t: Great game, but global should be back
reviews.x: Hey there! I played this game in 2015 and was at th9 but I lose everything when I got a new phone in 2017. Boo hoo right? Well I came back 2 months ago on a new account, just before Global was Scheduled to be removed from clash. Now I know I have been inactive for 2 years but I remember vividly that global was a great place to be. Honestly there weren’t that many scammers when I played, and parents should be more careful with their kids if their kids are going to random websites. They shouldn’t ruin it for us older guys. Global was an easy way to recruit and an easy way to make friends. ALSO this is very important, maybe try to isolate higher th levels from attacking lower levels. I am currently th6 (going into th7 as I write this) and It was extremely difficult to get loot when you are being absolutely rekt by dragons. And you can’t really get revenge against those people because you are stuck with giants and balloons that get mowed down by their higher tier defenses. Great game, bring back global pls, and isolate th levels to each other. Thank you.

reviews.t: Global Chat Gone and Removal of Inactive Clan Leaders
reviews.x: Whereas I may understand that inactive leaders would appear a nuisance. This wasn’t a clan that was build by a few through the whole time. Members have come and gone and not one of the originals still exist besides myself. I have a level 10 clan I had to constantly search through global chat (which is also now gone) to promote a level 1-2 clan constantly and then get the momentum to keep pushing clan wars but losing so many and a lot of battles from AFK new members or those not quite accustomed to the game. I watched battle after battle and went relentlessly to get to clan level 10. I went AFK for awhile pursuing work interest working long hours just to come back to find it exchanged hands. I will more than likely not be able to receive back from member (will try but sure will be kicked as that’s just how it works), and I am sitting here wondering what they were thinking. It’s sad they have a stay and play or get out mentality. It’s a shame and I should have just sold the account if that was the case cause I wasted so much time and after reaching out to Supercell their response is “that’s how it’s programmed they have no control”. I’m sure they created a program they have no control over...makes perfect sense. My notice was an in-game/inbox message to someone not playing...again...perfect sense. Sad. I spent 3 years constantly playing and around 4 years altogether, wasted money, and time. Good luck in your future endeavors Super Cell. Wish you continued success with your business model, but your practices are honestly very poor and quite frankly unfair. I don’t know how long you may last under your new direction, but though I am just one person, I hope you understand this is not how you successfully operate a buisness. Cheers.

When I downloaded Clash of Clans, I already had Clash Royale. So as you can imagine, I was a bit disappointed when I saw the troops. I mean, there are so many characters that I would love to see in Clash of Clans, like Mini Pekka, Knight, and the prince. (If you read my review on Clash Royale, you’ll know I’m not a big fan of the prince, so I’m kind of only saying that so the dark prince can go in the builder barracks). I also recommend changing the builder barracks a bit. Like the goblin can be the dart goblin, the barbarian can be the elite barbarian, the baby dragon can be the inferno dragon, and the minion can be mega minion instead of well... beta minion? Also, if Supercell takes my advice, they can make the prince the dark prince ( Because I extremely dislike the prince, and I would explode if I saw him on his own), and the knight the mega knight. But Clash of Clans is overall a really fun game, aside from a few troop annoyances. Thank you for reading!

Supercell has recently released some patch notes saying global chat is going to be removed for good. I have always believed global chat has not only been a good addition to the game but has been an outlet where you can talk to anyone who you have something in common with. Global has been here since the beginning and I believe we shouldn't just abandon it! They have stated its to help prevent fraud and spam, while some of this may be true I personally haven't encountered any of this and i have been playing the game for give or take 5 years. I believe they are taking it away because they don't want to dedicate the time and resources to it anymore which is understandable but I don't agree with it. I personally always loved the ability to talk in global whenever my clan was asleep, or I wanted to expose myself to more people and core clans. I have even met people in global that soon became friends in real life. No global would really bring boredness to the game. Why not just have both the recruiting system and global at the same time? I hope many of you agree and have had similar experiences and will spread this around and do everything to get Supercell's attention to show we are not ok with this!
