I have been playing this game for a very long time, 5+ years to be exact. I like the main game a lot. The builder base is a joke. I only up leveled & continue to play in the Builder Base because of the gem mine. Once I got my gem mine updated, I pretty much didn’t play the Builder Base, unless I was waiting for troops to hatch from my main base. Which, was practically every single day lol. I have always run the highest level Pekka in one army camp, with one army camp dedicated to wall breakers, my Battle Machine, and all the rest Night Witches. I 100% any and all bases I battle against at will because after I win three matches & collect all the goodies, I THEN PURPOSEFULLY LOSE THREE MATCHES, so I don’t get my guts stomped out in the next round of “Versus Battle” play. When I first got serious about these battles, I kept my trophies at around 1,000 - by winning three, then losing three matches on purpose. Now I’m up to about 2,500 trophies. I do the exact same thing. Why? Because it is very easy to get overpowered by going up just slightly in trophy rankings. So, I just run the same army over & over again and I keep winning at will & losing at will as well. But..... I have never picked up my phone to play COC & thought: “Gee golly, I just can’t wait to go battle in my Builder Base!” Never. Not even once. The combination of troops I described above has very rarely ever netted me anything other than 100%’s, at the level I am playing in, at that time. My air defenses have been at 100% immediately following any update. I have no issue dispatching any and all air troops sent to attack my base. As long as I keep my trophies in check, I can 100% any base, collect the three win bonus loot, & then intentionally lose three matches & I'm right back to where I was when I started, when it comes to match trophies. Then I just sit back & wait for the next round of battles & do it all over again. It’s bloody boring as all Hell waiting all day just to collect a few gems....lol!

reviews.t: October 2019 update is discouraging and came with a major bug
reviews.x: The most recent update in Oct 2019 didn’t feel good. Clash feels a little more empty now that global is gone. I feel like this update decreased the number of active clashers. Global was also a major part of the social aspect of the game. The game feels different in an uncomfortable way now that the clan and player profiles are funky. The profiles need to be changed to a more comfortable layout. The game doesn’t seem as fun as it used to be. I continue to play because of the amount of time I’ve had clash for. I got coc back in 2013. I reset my account 2 years ago and now I’m nearly maxed th10. Also a major bug exists in the game after this update. Achievements shown when you look at other people’s profile are shown completed when the stats don’t match what the Achievement is. I can prove this with my 2 accounts when I look at my mini accounts profile. This is 100% legit and exists in the game as I type. Please investigate this.

reviews.t: I wish I could give it 5 stars
reviews.x: I love this game. I’ve been playing for a little while now and is town hall 9. One big flaw about this game is that yes, it’s extremely balanced in town hall 6 and up, but it’s super slow and hard to grind trophies in lower town halls. There really aren’t any amazing spells at town hall 5 and even though there’s the heal spell, it’s just not that worth it considering the amount of elixir it cost and how much resources you need at low town halls. The trophie system is also super uneven at these town halls because, I’m on town hall 4 on my second account and I’m trying to push to 1250 trophies so I can get the achievement. But it only gives me 15-17 trophies for town hall 4-5 with about the same defense level as I do so it would be “even” but if it’s like a max town hall 5 or town hall six, that’s the only time I can get decent trophies like I do in nearly every game on my town hall 9 account. It’s super hard to get good trophies unless you have good clan castle troops. Giants get destroyed by wizard towers and mortars at low levels. Balloons get nearly 1 shoted at low levels. There aren’t any spells to play around with at these town halls so it’s basically you place your troops in your order and hope they don’t die

I am one of the people who started this game early, so I made my first account, I got to Town Hall 9 over the course of a few years. Then my phone breaks, it is not backed up on Game Center (I don’t know why it wasn’t). So I got a new phone, and tried getting it back once a few months ago, then stopped because I decided it wasn’t worth the attempt. Now I finally try to get my account back, since it has been a few years, and obviously since you can’t remember all information accurately, I got some information wrong, and I wanted to try again. The catch is that I log on today to find myself permanently banned for phishing, which if you don’t know means that I am trying to pose as the some random person and trying to steal the account. I just wanted to get back into a game I played a while ago, now I lost my new account as well in the process. Supercell has many many problems, to their lack of legitimate help and support, their strong abuse of power, and their carelessness when it comes to actual problems. I would never get this game again, and I strongly suggest that anyone playing, should watch out, because if you do something wrong, Supercell is coming full force at you, like a meteor on a collision course to earth, their is no stopping them.

Which makes me wonder if it’s supposed to be like that for some reason, but if that’s the case, I don’t know what that feature is for and it just makes things horrible. Because it looks like that’s the system. Please, please notice this and update this. If you read this, thank you, goodbye.#fixmatchmaking

The new hero design aren’t exactly what I’d expect to be in coc. I mean I get that they’re supposed to look better because they’re 3D models, but they honestly just don’t look good. I’m not trying to hate on supercell by any means, I’m just trying to give some honest feedback. I know plenty of companies want to improve in terms of graphics gameplay and money; but sometimes improving doesn’t mean change. An example would be the change from 2D pixelated sprites to full on 3D models in Pokémon games. Yes the 3D models are better graphically, but are they better then the 2D sprite? Well not in MY opinion, and that’s because I think that the old art style has a nice nostalgic charm to it, and of course it looks good. Anyway point is that the sprites for the Heroes were original and good/better then the 3D models in my opinion. Of course not everybody will think that, which is ok everyone is entitled to their own opinion. Although I’ve noticed MOST people not being to fond of the new models. Either way it’s all up to you Supercell.

In Clash of Clans, there are some haters of the game mainly because of the AI or the upgrade time, and some even hate the game just because of wall prices. I’m the leader of a level 11 clan, and I’ve played the game for almost 5 years. I love everything about this game, and have two accounts, a max th11 going to 12 right now, and a th9 that I’m playing on for fun. A solution to the AI being annoying sometimes, like your queen going for a random storage while a single inferno is right next to her, is to funnel. I used to be horrible at funneling, and I could never understand why my troops wouldn’t go into the core of the base. Once you learn how to funnel effectively, getting those precious stars and loot will be much easier. The next point is about upgrade time and wall prices. Sure, not everybody loves the time it takes to upgrade an inferno tower, but that’s the reason why you want to log on everyday. Finally, the wall prices I won’t rant on much because the argument over the walls is a two sided thing. Remember, though, that they’ve already been halved, which is good since I hated having to spend 1mil on a single lvl 8 to 9 wall. Thanks for reading my review!

reviews.t: Broken meta filled with game exploits
reviews.x: Supercell has officially broken clash of clans meta. Clan war leagues was introduced as a new type of week long war that would pit players against more even matchups and in doing so make the game fun and fair to play for everyone. Months later we are finding out that is as unfair as ever. Players exploit the games war matchmaking system by obtaining the highest level TH, then only upgrading critical defenses (inferno, crossbows, EA.. etc) and their armies. This confuses supercells matchup algorithm. Basically they are keeping their war weight down so they are matched against players at a lower townhall that can be easily squashed with their max level armies and can’t compete against their maxed level critical defenses. Defense and army levels unobtainable by the lower level TH victims of their game exploits. When confronted with this fact, supercell employees claim playing this way does not violate their terms of use. So basically they are condoning this unfair way of playing. Possibly an attempt at an aggravation factor to pressure fair players into buying gems. Unfortunately, I am considering quitting the game after 5+ years of playing because of all the horrible updates like this geared towards favoring pay to win game exploiters and frustrating game mechanics fueled by greed.

I’ve been playing clash of clans for some time and I am a town hall 9 in masters 2 but I’ve been losing lots of trophies to the electric dragon. I think it’s kinda ridiculous to have something that overpowered to be in your clan castle. Like at least make it so the electro dragon can’t be in the clan castle because it’s absurd how many trophies I’ve lost to this one troop. And also it shouldn’t be possible for town hall 10s to attack town hall 9s in master league. Especially because town hall 9’s rarely find others that are also town hall 9’s to attack. If a town hall 10 attacks a town hall 9 it is literally impossible for any town hall 9 defense to defend against 31 miners with cloning potions and heal spells. This also includes having your base sometimes being attacked with a siege machine which is ridiculous how you are even able to hold that thing in your clan castle. In conclusion please make it so that electro dragons can’t be held in clan castles or at least make them take up more space so only town hall 10s can get them. And make it so town hall 10s can’t attack town hall 9s it’s really unfair. I hope one of your producers see this and make a change to this because this is one of the reasons why the game isn’t fun to play for me anymore.

I love this game! I have played it for about 5-6 years. I love it. I remember when th10 was impossible. Now I’m th10 and wonder what was the fuss about? I think there is a couple of fixes that would help. Here is one of them. I think there should be an update where your clan and 8 other clans similar to yours combine. You would still be leader of your own clan but all the non leaders vote for a leader out of all the 9 leaders to kind of run them all in a way. They can’t do anything major like kick someone out of another clan unless permission by the leader. Unless they break a rule. There should be another war where it is every other month, right after CWL. The ‘president of the clans’ can select 100 members from any clan to participate. Every year, they can vote on a new president. I know it sounds stupid but think how cool it would be to team up with other clans for wars. It could be called whatever supercell wants. But I’ve always wanted to combine with clans without leaving my clan and giving up leader. Also, you could donate and receive troops from the other clans, and could have a group chat with all 9 clans. This would make the game so much better and I think other people would say the same.

reviews.t: Have played for a couple years
reviews.x: I’ve been playing this game for years. I can’t stay away from it. It hits dry repetitive phases but something will get updated and that love to grind comes rushing back in. Right away you should know this isn’t a game you can just get on whenever and progress. You do have to get on every day or two to progress. I feel like that’s why most people quit. They get through the first few town halls thinking it’s easy and then get frustrated when you have to start saving for upgrades. So if you like a challenge this game is for you. There’s just so many things you can do, attack strategies to learn, base load outs to create. Endless possibilities. The only complaint I have is builder base. I feel like it was unnecessary. I only really use it for the gem mine. The fact that you can’t get loot every time you raid keeps me away. Hopefully Otto getting added will help me get back into it. For that extra builder I mean. Also maybe not have builder wack on a glass storage container with a hammer?😂 lol anyway thanks for the memories supercell and happy clashing.

I have played this game 2 separate times first reaching max th7 second reaching max th8 I lost access to my th7 over a year and a half ago after switching iPhones and I emailed supercell about it yesterday. Worst mistake ever!! I didn’t have the ability to access the Apple ID for purchases or the Game Center to log in all I had was the player id and because they need the other info to correctly identify that it’s you it was incorrectly thought that I was account phishing I am now permanently banned on my max th8 account and don’t have access to my max th7 I am very upset because I absolutely love the game but I don’t want to spend the time or money on the game unless I can get my account back (max th8) I clearly cannot access my th7 but I have all the information for the th8 but.. what’s worse, the supercell customer service I understand that they are working on new Ames but when I try to contact you all I recieve are the same robot responses “hi how can I help you) then it gives different option of what happened so I click other but when I explain what happened it say “we have information that shows you went against terms of service and your account is now banned” I need help ASAP or I will not be playing the game anymore -a very upset customer

reviews.t: Great game just a couple problems
reviews.x: I love the game! It’s way better than most builder that just beg for money constantly. I love that things aren’t really overpriced and you often get tons of resources. Just a couple problems; One, It’s a bit unfair the way I attack other villages, I have a level 4 town hall so I’m not all that experienced but whenever I attack another village I face someone about 5x as strong as me. For example I attacked a village with about 20 archers 20 barbarians 5 giants and a couple of wall breakers, then all of a sudden 5 valkyries come from the clan castle and wreck my entire army I waited like 20 minutes to train. I know you can send reinforcements to defend your village but I think sending troops about 10x as powerful as yours is a bit ridiculous. I always need to scout out 5 or 6 villages to find one I can actually win against wasting time and coins. Plus after I raid a village I get a very small amount of resources. Just plz make the raiding system a bit better thx.

reviews.t: Great Game a recommendation for heroes
reviews.x: Dear COC Team (If you read this) For heroes I think there should be an option to upgrade a hero more than one level at a time. For example, the ability to upgrade five levels at a time (5 should be the maximum) for the same price and upgrade time as the 5 levels would normally be. The only addition is that the builder won’t stop working. This feature should be added FOR JUST HEROES it would be cool, especially on higher levels when heroes only improve slightly between upgrades and they can usually be a pain to upgrade along side a growing base. This could inspire people to actually upgrade there heroes. This would be helpful and wouldn’t be an unfair advantage. If you test the feature and feel it is unfair maybe to multi-level upgrade your heroes the cost should be higher for each level you stack to the upgrade, this is additional to the prices for all the levels you are upgrading at once. Thank you.

Ok, so first of all, I’d like to say it’s really good. A few tips and suggestions: Be smart about attacking. I used one type of troop, usually Barbarians or Balloons, but it didn’t work. You have to use all troops to the best of their ability to 3-star a base. For builder base, just fix the Crusher, it’s too OP. Maybe add versus battles for main Village? I don’t know. Joining a clan is important. I am a Town Hall 6 but I’m active in Clan Wars and I can do a lot. The wall cost... well yeah, it’s freaking expensive. I am frequently at only a few thousand gold because I try to max it out but it’s fine. It makes you take time instead of pushing. I also like the non-pusher update. Clan War leagues are great. Spells in my opinion are overpriced, but it’s not too bad. Also I think the builder base battles should be matched based on Builder Barracks level, not town hall. It’s not uncommon for me to get a nice 2 star, say 53% but them I’m getting 3 starred by guys with baby dragons and stuff. It’s has problems but overall it’s a great game.

This game is great in tons of ways. ZERO ads, and the extra builder pack are never jammed into your face unlike other games, and very fun gameplay as well as tons and tons of content. Happy 7th anniversary and I would love it if Clash of Clans made it all the way to 10 years of clashing, just like Minecraft’s 10 years of crafting. As for feedback I suggest a bit more RNG in gameplay but as it is a strategy game this should not go too far. That was, you have a bit of anxiety for what could happen, yet you can control most of it so you get expected results. One example would be allowing for a 10% chance of a time limit to something, like building, of changing. As for a good change or a bad change, it would be random. This can cause for a 10 hour project to either change to 10.5 hours, 9.5 hours, or not change at all. Once again I love this game and I think this feedback will only prove it more as a the game evolves!

reviews.t: Don’t ask to delete your account
reviews.x: The reason I give it a one star is because it has been EXTREMELY frustrating. I say this because the last time i played was about a year ago and i wanted to delete my account. So since I linked my account there was no way to do that, so I ask supercell. At first I get there robot that asks if I want to restore my account and I tell it I want to delete my account and it asks questions about my previous account? Ok but then I get a real person after 3 days and then they ask am I sure i want to delete my account for 2 days. But by now I didn’t talk for about 3 days and they closed the chat, so I had to wait another few days with the robot and another person. Finally though when they realize that I actually want to delete my account it asks two weeks. Now I do understand the wait period, so if you wanted to you could ask to have your base back. Now I wait the two weeks. So two weeks pass and I log on and I get a message “your account will be deleted soon.” So I wait so I come back on a week later and it STILL tells me my account will be deleted soon so I wait again about a month has passed since I asked for my account to be deleted and they still haven’t gotten to ACTUALLY deleting it and I have tried deleting the app and redone loading but I didn’t work. I don’t know what to do but I am VERY annoyed. Thanks for reading

I don’t typically leave reviews. I use to play this game alone time ago and got to townhall 8. I lost all my progress because my device was broken and i didnt have the game backed up. I got back into it 6 months ago and I absolutely love it! All the new changes is what brought me back! It is so much fun! I use to feel like i had to spend money to get anywhere but now there are so many cool perks to speed things up and with the builder hall on the side you always have something to do! I pay for the season pass and the $4.99 a month is soooo worth it! It speeds things up so fast and you get so many perks! I dont like spending money on apps but this is %100 acceptable and worth it! I feel like before all this new stuff clash was kind of dying out and then boom!!! Blew my mind. This game is definitely going to be around alooong time if not forever! If you dont know if you should get back into it because your returning or a new player, do it! Its not too late! Once you get started you will have a blast! And I recommend getting in a clan or starting one! It also enhances the experience with so many perks and extra troops! This game is putting my iphone xs max to good use! LOOOVE IT!!! Cant say it enough..

This almost can’t get better, but I do have a few suggestions. It would be cool if there were weekly events, where instead of attacking bases, you 1v1 players with your troops. Also, it would be cool if you upgrade a tower like a wizard tower or an archer tower, it will spawn the troops to help defend your base once destroyed. It would also be cool to have a guard post in the main base, except you can choose what is in it. Another thing that would be cool is if there was a fourth hero, which would be something i call “master troop”. I got this idea from a clash-a-rama episode. There was this character named Jenny the Archer, and it would be cool if players could have a troop like that. Maybe you can get it with a special type of research factory. You research a single troop, and it might take a couple of days, and after that it breaks down but you now have a special troop of your choice. A wizard, an archer, a healer, a pekka, a minion, a Valkyrie, anything the player wants. No matter what you choose, they all have the same strength. I was thinking the wizard would have a special ability where if he is being attacked by a wizard tower, he stops what he is doing and basically catches or absorbs the fireballs, and either heals and gets a shield or he makes a massive fireball that does massive damage to the wizard tower and anything within 3 tiles. Also for the pekka, his special ability could be “sword smash” where he charges up and instantly destroys a single target. For archer it could be “snipe” where she could snipe and instantly destroy donated troops from the enemy. Healer could make any troop within a couple of tiles invincible, like the warden. Minion’s special ability would be revenge, where if a building killed over 15 minions, it will long shot and instantly destroy its target. Valkyrie could get an ax throw. It would be cool if you add this, and I guess this is all I can think of. Great game overall!

I have been clashing since 2013, downloading shortly after the games release. I have not been a consistent or active clasher during that entire period, but I haven’t taken longer than a year away from the game. I wash a badly rushed like level 50 or 60 TH 9 long ago and molded my base to a maxed level 170 TH 11 today. Clan War leagues, magic items, season pass, and clan games have all revolutionized clash! I now have three active accounts and play many times a day. With the addition of the season pass, you get a ridiculous amount of goods for a cheap price, so that is ALL the money you should have to spend on the game now. Which is NICE because back when clan wars were the only thing out, I would dump loads of money into the game (yeah I was young and not very money wise). I love this game more than any console or pc game I have ever played. I have never continually played a game for so long. Clash of Clans is a true masterpiece and I am excited to see what the future holds for the clash community. Thank you, Supercell. Clash on!!

reviews.t: I would give it 5 stars but no I have one problem

Boy was I wrong... There was a charge on my credit card for the price of a gold pass (for the month of July) that I DID NOT make, not only did I not make it, but the gold pass was not credited/placed on my account (online clan) either. Bottom line, BEWARE OF YOUR CREDIT CARD on your account. Trust me when I tell you. I had mine to the point that I had to confirm each transaction before any purchase were finalized and this one went through somehow... This developers might want to check their customer service/support, especially when they have an issue such as this one... definitely a 1 star rating, due to the lack of customer service and the lack of know how on how to fix this situation (which is easy, uh, let’s see receipt of purchase... oh good account credited... duh!)

If you do your best and raise your trophies with more than that determined as daily raise amount, they will let you down as matching too much stronger opponents than yours. The game is one of the most fun games I’ve played and it’s amazing just 2 things bother me when I go out to find some one to attacking they usually have like 10,000 gold and elixir put out but last night I got attack and lost 164,249 gold and 54,673 and that was all my gold and elixir the 2nd reason is how long it takes to build things I feel like builders should be able to be upgraded so it doesn’t take as long. Oh and I think that healers are annoying cause I got raided with a lot of giants and 2 healers and they should have died but was healed every second so they had full health the whole time so that’s it

reviews.t: I have been playing this game FOREVER and I absolutely LOVE it!!!
reviews.x: Omg this is like one of the only games that I consistently play and have a good time with it. It’s not like all the other games that you just ”build an empire,” this is a game where you have clans, wars, clan games, have another builder base that you can work on AND build attack and defend against other players! My whole family has been playing this game for a really long time and we have always loved it! I know a lot of people who don’t like the builder base, but I think it is VERY fun because when you are waiting for your army to train in the other base. I wish the builder base wall were different though because I always have too much or too less and I alway have a gap. If this is changeable that would be AWESOME!! But I understand that everyone would have to change their base and that would cause lots of bad stuff. I also love this game because it is a way to connect with family and friends through a game and you can talk about who’s going to attack number... in war and what troops you want to give! The list can go on and on. I did find a bug tho. When you are in the regular base and you are training troops and you pick up a troop category it isn’t on where your finger is. Another thing that is SOOO annoying is that when ever you are in the building section, and you go up and down it moves too far and it makes it so I can’t see them as well. I really hope this gets changed. Thank you for reading this and I LOVE this game!!!

I’ve been playing this game since like 2014 and I haven’t seen it getting old yet! I’m currently a TH8 and have lost 2 high level accounts and I started back from scratch. Not a problem by me. Most of the time, I absolutely despise micro transactions in every game nowadays, but this is probably the only game that I’m absolutely ok with the micro transactions! It doesn’t give you an unfair advantage against opponents. You’ll end up facing harder opponents as you progress into this game. Clan War League was such an amazing addition into this game. It’s helps out so much getting quest points to boost your account. Supercell has done a great job with this game in the past year. I definitely recommend this game to absolutely everyone! It’s very enjoyable to get better, play with friends, and have fun! This game is gonna continue to get better. This is the only Supercell game that I enjoy. Clash Royale is an unbalanced mess, Boom Beach is fine, Hay Day is good as well, and Brawl Stars gets pretty boring pretty quick. I’ve had this TH8 account for like a month, and have yet to get bored with it.

reviews.t: LONG TIME NO SEE MY FRIEND :D

Though I don’t want to ask for much but with the new social it would be nice if we can private message friends and also maybe add a day and night system to Clash of Clans to capture real life time. That’s all hope it’s not too much and I doubt anybody would read this but thank you SuperCell you made my childhood :) Sincerely Your Friend - Dutch <3

This is a great game I love it the only thing I would change is how leagues work i am a th5 in silver league 1 and it took me a while to get all the trophies but I hate it that higher th’s than me can take so many of my trophies it’s just not fair it took me a while to get all the trophies I have and the fact that a town hall 7 can take 33 trophies from a little th5 they are much better than me have more troops and better troops and all I have is a base that they can take out so easily and take basically all my trophies when I can’t do anything about it they are much better, all I’m trying to say is have a limit to how th leagues work like yknow th7 and 8 can be in silver league but just make it so they can attack each other not town halls that are much lower than them so th5s and 6 can attack each other that’s the way it should work that’s all I’m trying to say anyways I hope you read this and implement it into the game, Thank You

reviews.t: Played since 2014. Great game but someMAJOR issues.
reviews.x: This is by far one of my all time favorite games. Mostly everything they have ever done to the game is well thought out. However there are issues.1. The walls are too expensive for what they do. Nowadays everyone uses balloons, electro dragons, baby dragons, and miners. Walls do nothing against these troops. NOTHING! So I just don’t understand why they cost so much. I understand that there is a 20% off builders that can be earned through the season pass but upgrading walls should be able to be accomplished without spending 5 dollars every month.2. There is basically nothing you can do against miners. The best weapon in my base is the giant bombs against them. They either need nerfed or there needs to be some sort of weapon against them. 3. There needs to be more builders. The new Otto thing that was added is cool but this can only be earned from doing outrageous amounts of work in a separate village. One that I have no interest in whatsoever. There should be the option to buy more than 5 builders in the home village that I would gladly buy with gems that I have earned through achievements and clearing obstacles. That is all. These issues are a simple fix and would make the community as a whole a lot happier thank you.

It was a warm July day in Southwestern Quebec, and I was going on a hike with my grandfather and brother. I was excited to explore the outdoors and get some exercise , but I missed my Clash. I wanted to update my Wizard tower to level 6. I brought my phone along in search of Rogers cell service so I could view my little village. As we listened to my grandfather, we became more and more lost until we had no idea where we were. We hiked in search of other route makers; we became more lost. Suddenly, I took out my phone. My slick little iPhone 4. The black one. I opened the compass app and a look of relief shot across my grandfather’s face. Maybe, just maybe, we wouldn’t have to sleep under a tree for the next week, eating my younger brother. We followed the compass, traveling southeast until we found familiar territory about a half hour later. If Clash of Clans was not on my phone, my little brother would have been breakfast.

So yes, I’m a gamer and seeing this game just gets you hooked and people could go on and on about this game and how it can be improved and why they like it. But with all these updates, how can people just starting the game keep up with the updates that were there for years such as a TH1 trying to become a TH5 in a month or so without using gems and lots of time? So what I’m saying is, as you progress through the game, thinks should be cheaper and less time, Tesla’s in builder and home village should be reduced and same and everything should be equivalent to the other. And not just that, things like the decorations should also get things added weekly or monthly with new things and should be obtainable through many ways just like challenges. And as you guys continue the Season pass, the skins should be a little easier to get and if you do manage to obtain them, equipping the skin should also change the hero’s throne/building to match the skin. And lastly, their should also be a new thing called backgrounds where you can obtain them through the Season pass *along with the skins* and have them forever. It should be based on certain things. Thank you for listening and making it possible to have fun, Your COC gaming kid

This game is amazing and I love it in every single way. I just recently upgraded to town hall six and it has been awesome making a new base with new defenses. The builder base is awesome in the same way with me being a builder base four. There is only one very very minor thing I would like to see. I run a clan with a few of my friends and it’s going great. But recently I noticed that I lost a defense by a very slim margin. So I checked the replay and my clan castle had been filled with barbarians. Now in my clan you have to give what is asked for in the request or you don’t give that person troops. This was stated in the clan description under RULES so no one could miss It. So I immediately knew that someone was trolling and needed to be kicked from the clan. Now I know that some script comes up on your screen when someone donates to you but I was offline when he donated to me. I would like to be able to see a like donating record for each person in the clan that would show you what they donated, who they donated to, when they donated, and what the request was.

So I’ve been playing Clash Of Clans for 2 years. I’m currently a new TH9. I love the game and it never gets old, but their are some problems that just makes it not as fun. So the first problem the goblin bases. I’ve been stuck on a goblin base that has all maxed th10 defences and more than a normal base would have. How is this fair for people? The second problem is the time it takes to build. For a max TH9 air defence is takes 3 days and 3,000,000 gold. The Town Halls take weeks to upgrade, and everything makes the game “slow”. My last problem is clans. To be able to join a clan you have to have a certain amount of trophies. Even if u have that amount if their in CWL you can’t join unless you have the clan leagues trophie amount. I get that this prevents low level people from joining the clan but this affects the members and who is in the war. Some clans might only have 20 players and some be Bronze III or silver II. Those players are generally way to low level to be good at war. I feel like you shouldn’t have to buy a clan castle, and you should earn it by getting the Gold III.

reviews.t: My favorite game. But I don’t understand...
reviews.x: I have been playing Clash of Clans on many different accounts ever since it first came out. I remember when the barbarian king and archer queen came out. I also remember when Town hall 10 came out, I was the ones who rushed my base to it 😂. And now with Clan wars and clan war leagues and even clan games all those updates have changed the game for the better. But one thing I still don’t understand is why is it when you donate to your clan members during a war of any kind those donations are not counted toward how much you’ve donated already? I ALWAYS fill my entire clan’s clan castles during a war and I hate not watching my donations box go up? Especially when I use Tons of gems to do so. I think if you guys would just change that little thing it would make for a better player experience overall and wouldn’t take away from the fun in the slightest respects. Thanks

I love the game I used to play a couple years ago. Then one day my friend was playing I decided to start playing again I got back on the grind and I couldn’t be happier with the game and I also got my other account back. I was actively paying on both accounts then they made supercell Id. I logged in on my main account it was working then I tried to go back to my other account and I couldn’t because I was logged In on the supercell id and I didn’t think much of it because I still had my iPad with it then I went on playing then I asked my friend to join my clan but he didn’t have his phone so I said you can use mine and gave him it to sign in so I logged out of my supercell id and he logged in with his so now my account was locked to his id. And today I tried one again to log on to my other account but I logged out of the supercell id and I can now not get on either account. I have spent about $50 on a game I like I’d like to have my accounts back.

This is the most used app I have. But I have two improvements, like being able to buy trees and rocks and such or my favorite one, naval warfare. You have introduced ships to us with the builder hall update and in a Clash-a-Rama episode. But I’m talking like firing goblins from the port goblin cannon onto a ship full of Barbarians. Now you can imagine the rest, but it will be set up like this. There is a shipyard at the top of the shore. You have to be level 5 Town Hall for it, because you introduced sailing at Town Hall 4. Fight against other players will be like clash royal. Except the person who loses all of their ships first loses, and the winner gets all the other persons gold and gunpowder. Now let’s talk about gunpowder. This resource takes elixirs place in naval warfare. You collect it with mines. Back to the ships. After fighting both players have to repair their ships, except the losing player has to pay more. Oh I forgot, you have to buy ships. Each ship has a capacity, so a small goblin ship lvl 1 might have a capacity of 2, but a giant wizard ship level 7 might have a capacity of 10. There could be a ship for each troop and you can upgrade the ships, once a ship is level 4 you can combine it with another ship. To get in my example a giant wizard ship, not giant wizard, giants and wizards. Each ship might have different properties, like a giant ship has giant cannons, no the the defense in builder base, instead of the long range goblin cannon of a goblin ship. This was based on a dream.

This game, it’s only there for those that don’t work. First, you produce about 1/2 of the resources you loose when you’re raided. That forces you to be on the game because you’re not allowed to be raided if you’re on. If you spend money, real money, everything is so ridiculously over priced in gems that it isn’t even worth it. This game guzzled about $4.5k “which I’m embarrassed to say” out of my pocket and I’m still 1/2 of the way there. They get you at first. You can fly through the upgrades and levels like a mudslide. But then you hit that ridiculous cost wall that not even the most experienced rock climber could tackle. WHAT BOTHERS ME? These people make millions, they have a good system of wars and entertainment...why do you have to lose all your resources when raided? Why do you produce less than what you lose? Shouldn’t there be a cap instead of a percentage that you loose on resources when raided? I have stopped paying 3 years ago. Since I’ve stopped, I’ve only been able to level up my queen 2 times in these last 3 years and it was using the little gems they give you once every Super Snow Moon. Rarer than a Red Moon. I’m so disappointed. Could’ve bought a decent car with the money I spent here...

I’ve had this game since spells costed coins on my old account but this has came a long way from hogs to town halls to another base and with that base there should be a builder war. The way it should be done is that there are 10 v 10 and the people must attack there mirror and the player with most stars or percentage wins and that win goes to the win count which is he star count in regular wars and secondly thanks for decreasing time and cost that made it much easier to upgrade and fair to make it a need to raid. The season challenges are fun but add a bit to cost for try hard s bc if war cwl clan games other events it just is so costly during those things I think that this game hasn’t even scratched the surface with its potential in a good way. One thing I need to say that a lot of people I know complain about is golems being so weak that the walls are the worst thing to deal with. And I know that I can use a jump spell and I do but it’s to get to the core and destroy the th. I’m asking to buff the damage of golems only on walls like a x2 damage on walls or something. Thanks for reading my review supercell if you did

I first started playing this game in around 2014 when I was still in elementary school, and on and off over the past 5 years I’ve played. This game was so fun and addictive that back in the beginning I also made a second account to play along with my main. Around 3 years ago I stopped playing as it became boring. But recently I’ve become addicted to playing this game again, and when I redownloaded the village that it used was my main much higher th. And after playing again for around a month I decided I wanted to try to get back my other village. At first it was a struggle as I didn’t know the information for it as I created it before supercell ids and hadn’t played since they were added. The support team was very helpful in regaining control of my account that laid dormant for years. They were very nice and easy to work with, as I hadn’t used the account since middle school and am now in 11th grade the information they asked to verify was a bit fuzzy. But with their help I got the village back and am now very satisfied and even created another village to play. Definitely will not stop playing anytime soon.

I am an avid player and love the game. You all have done so much good for this game over the years and have created something special. But PLEASE GET RID OF THE 24 HOUR WAIT PERIOD FOR IN CLAN CHALLENGES!!!! Part of being in an active clan should be the ability to challenge and critique your clan mates bases. To me, and the 30 some other members of my extremely active clan, the ability to attack and defend against others in your clan is how you get better at the game. I understand that this method of attacking doesn’t generate revenue for y’all, the developers. But taking away the 24 hour wait period after you’ve changed even one piece of wall in your base won’t change any revenue stream. Please oh please get rid of that wait period!!!! Also new idea!!!! Allow multiple builders to be put to work on a single building. This will reduce the speed of upgrade and building. Allocating multiple builders to one building would make this game more enjoyable and one would be able to get a building done in time for war. 2 builders on a building wouldn’t need to be 2 times as fast but it should be close.

Overall, this is a really good and fun game. However, the connection lost is an issue. For example, I am in the middle of a battle at 93 percent, and my phone switches from 3G to LTE and I get the connection lost screen. Then, considering I have better connection then before, the game loads up a lot faster and I see that I am missing 23 trophies and the 300,000 elixir and gold I just had stolen. So, I check the battle log and it shows me losing the battle (scoring a 37 percent) and only gaining 3,000 of gold and elixir. So, I have lost 23 trophies, 300,00 gold and elixir, and another 100,000 elixir that it cost me to train my troops. And, this is all because my phone got BETTER connection. It is really irritating knowing that I won a battle, but since my phone got better connection, I lose it. But still, I really enjoy playing this game and have for a good deal of time. I hope that you guys at Supercell will read this and try to fix the problem, or at least tell me why it happens so that I can understand. Thank you for taking the time to read this. Have a good day!

reviews.t: Game is decent, Supercell support is horrible
reviews.x: I don’t want to incorrectly rate the game, as it is fun to play. However, I feel Supercell should be involved in this rating as well. Their support system is HORRIBLE. My friend tried to recover an account that had been dormant for 8 months or so. Upon trying to enter his information he was banned for phishing. Therefore, he emailed Supercell support, who only responded around 4 am. Despite this they always told him to produce an ‘in-game ticket.’ However, it was literally impossible to get into the game to do this because he was banned. At one point he was even able to get into the game, submit the ticket and was banned again. Therefore, I contacted them on his behalf, simply asking what he could do. They recommended he get into another device. Therefore, on my device (the only one we had) he tried again to submit a ticket, including a special referral number one of these “support agents” provided, and my account was banned as well before anyone even responded. Supercell is crazy about instabanning you for trying to recover an account. They have horrible customer service. The “agents” try to answer your question in one message and will end the chat after, and you can be waiting for hours to even hear a response in the first place. Overall this has been a ridiculous experience and I hope this turns some people away from this company.

Clash of Clans is a unique, awesome, intriguing, and super fun game. I started playing it in the early days of its release. I’ve never stopped since. While this may sound like addiction, it’s not. I did not play daily and every hour of the day like streamers and others play Fortnite or Apex Legends 24/7. Now let me get into the specifics for what make it such a good game. The graphics are phenomenal. You may not get a super close view or a 3D simulation or something like that, you get great animations and phenomenal graphics. The social perspective of things is smooth and successful. People make friends, hang out, and it’s fun to talk on the chat with others. I personally enjoy it very much. The content and idea of the game is clever, smart, and awesome. It is fun to work to get your Town Hall up and upgrade all of your base. I really enjoy it (probably more than Fortnite). The clans are also very fun. I enjoy it to fight other clans and battle. The competition levels are high and fun. Also as a little perk, the music is really catchy. Overall, it’s a super fun game and I recommend playing it (even though not a lot of people play it anymore). -HugHead

So I’ve been playing COC for the past 5+ years. I’ve never wrote a review because I never had anything great to say because like anything there could be a few fixes but nothing bad to say because the game had always been great but now I got something bad to say. It seems that when you get to Legend level The COC team wants you to pay them money. How so? Well, when your in legend expect to wait a good 10-30 minutes, and if you happen to wait those 30 minutes while your guard is about to expire and your village goes into “break” mode then consider yourself SOL. As soon as the game kicks you out guess what... you get attacked and all the hard work you put in to get a few trophy’s just went down the drain since the player that just attacked you hit you for 20+ trophies. So I contacted the COC team with my concern and their response is what really surprised me. The associate that responded suggested that most players in the top league basically spend money and buy shields. To me that sounds reducidlas. So what their saying that out if the millions of players on COC I can’t find a decent attack because their all buying shields. This is crazy COC team, I’ve been a loyal fan for years but this has me wondering why I’ve spent the last 5 years on your game. I hope you fixed this...

So i notice that the bat spell is extremely op and it takes like 0 seconds for a swarm of bats to destroy any building so the idea is a new buiding that takes a 2x2 tile space that, just like the air sweeper but in a round target area, sends amd expansive wave in a circle radius that essentially knocks back the bats by just like 1 or 2 tiles but the difference is that this wave of air will be composed of a gas or something flammable that damages the swarms of bats all at the same time, burning not only the bats but also any other incredibly fast air unit. Also the second idea is that archer towers need to be stronger, so why not (in the higher levels of the building) make those 2-3 archers shoot individual targets and not just one at a time, it only makes sense to have this already high number of archers deal more damage by hitting different targets individually. if you dont like this idea, i think it would be better and would make more sense if the walls in the game actually acted like such, by this i mean, wizards and other projectile throwing or shooting troops cant really reach defenses next to walls in front of them, they would need to break the wall to get to an (example) air defense or cannon. Or maybe there should be a feature that maybe adds height to the walls so troops that fire projectiles have a hard time trying to take the building down, maybe the troop levels should increase their ability to hit those targets on the other side of the wall. By the way the Cantina idea is an exellent idea as well.

reviews.t: Story about how I got wrongfully banned...
reviews.x: My friend recently tried to get me back into my this game after a bout a year of not playing it. On attempt to get back into my account I realize it signs me into a account from my old IPod. I then search my account to make sure it still exists. To this point I have found no way to get back into my account. So I message support (after checking help and support) and wait for a response. Finally support gets back to me and asks me for information about my account to verify that I am really trying to get back into MY account. This questions consist of all things I can answer truthfully. Then it comes to when I created the account. They asked for “month/year.” I am a high school student so I am often busy and lose track of time. I know the year I created the account but not the month. They repeatedly ask the same question over and over again and I continue to respond with “2018.” This answer is not a wrong answer because they put month “/“ year. The / indicates that it is an “or” question. After 4-5 times of answering this question with “2018”, I open the app and find a message that says I’m “banned permanently for Account phishing attempt/s.” I got banned from Clash Of Clans for trying to get back into MY account. Supercell this is not cool.

reviews.t: Sieges need to move to th11
reviews.x: SPC, it’s Tuttle. Love the game. By far the best mobile game ever made. Completely enjoying the pass, and it’s the first time I’ve even spent money on the game and it’s worth every penny. However, I have one complaint. My clan has bout 3 th 12’s, that number is fluctuating consistently, but it’s around that number most of the time. All 3 with an ordinary working life that don’t have time to get on and donate a couple sieges. However, we do have a great number of Th 11’s. I’m not sure if our clan is part of a small pool with this problem or if there are more. It’d be really convenient to have lvl 1 siege factory at th 11. Since th12’s are so sought after and hard to come by it’d make it convenient for the clan. Most of the time I see th12’s they are in a clan. I know the simple answer is to just upgrade to Th 12, but a lot of us are just a th 10 or 11 still upgrading defenses and walls and heroes and they don’t want to rush there way to th12. Well anyways, hope you see this and consider it. -Tuttle

reviews.t: Game doesn’t make me moist no mo
reviews.x: Let me first start off by first starting off that I am a well versed Clash of Clans gamer who is well versed in all aspects of Clash of Clans. In order to succeed in this game you have to play it and put forth the effort to succeed in the game. The game has had many changes over the years that change various styles of gameplay which will change again. So, be prepared to be unprepared as this game will continue to be modified as time goes on the game will be modified into something you will not be happy with. The game will be updated in hopes it can entice and lure you into spending real world money. Nothing in the game is concrete either. You can spend real money on something in the game, then when there’s an update in a few months, the changes could affect that very attribute you spent money on a few months earlier, making what purchase you made worthless. Lastly, my last final comment about the game is in regards to developer/end user (the gamer). If they tell you something in a blog or other form of media which they communicate their stuff and transmit it through the World Wide Web, to a location online allowing a general public audience, they do not care about any of your beautiful ideas and handsome thoughtful verbiage you may or may not use. Cheers!

Let’s start this off with Feb 2012 my start date. I have seen many changes and broken a minimum of 12 devices on this. Every iPhone from 3g to 6s has bounced across my floor. I rushed my 1st base to th9 as none of us knew better. It cost me 1000s to never catch the acct up, however I did reach 158th global for a short stint. My 2nd base (mini) was side action while waiting on bases to raid (clouding). I reached champ early years then titan and eventually legend. So what I am about to say you can take to the bank (or withdraw) you cannot and will not play top tier without spending heaps of cash just for resources. Anyone that tells you this you can is the 1st liar in clash you meet. I understand that dev and marketing and design have mouths to feed as well but gouging was pretty bad in the beginning, as was the cheating (super cell finally dropped the hammer on that somewhat) To shoe then this up, the trick to this game is to start and max upgrade every TH fully , forget cup count , league and all the other accolade. YOU WILL NEVER BE #1 , the top tier won’t allow it. Play at leisure, maybe buy a package offer here or there but don’t spend enough for a nice fishing boat like I have and many others that spent a ton more than me. My most enjoyment has come from my mini base with grand total of $15 and 5 years of making friends and killing time with it. It’s a max Th10 thats half way thru TH11 and I don’t have to sit here and average of 15hrs a day 7 days a week and plan my life around shields.

I love this game and I’ve been playing for 4 years now on different accounts for I give this game a 5 star because how much action and how much you can do like upgrading to attacking and getting new troops there is a few things I think you should add 1. Thank you if you add any of the things I suggest and maybe for any event you could add like Christmas you could add Santa hat on all of the troops or just to heroes thank you if you read the things that I would like to see added in the game I love this game it’s one of my favorites that’s why I give it a five star thank you Supercell

Ok so this is a pretty fun game gameplay wise. But it has a few kinks that need to be worked out. Supercell is a great game developer, but some parts of this game were just a mistake. My first reason is because it takes forever to upgrade your buildings. some take only 15-30 minutes, but others take HOURS even DAYS. My second issue is the Gems. If you want to have ANYTHING quicker then waiting a long time you have to earn or buy gems. I know that’s how free games make money, by selling in game currency for REAL money. It’s annoying, but gems can really get you out of a pinch. But I don’t think that it’s a good system. Gems also buy gold and elixir in the game. (Gold and elixir being the resources you use to build). My third reason being the amount of time it takes to train certain troops. And finally that you have to pay 500 gems to buy another builder!!!!!! You start off with 2 builders but have to buy the rest! But all criticism aside this is still a great game.

I have loved this game for years and still do!! I play it everyday and I will do for a long time. But there are still some flaws about it. BUILDER HUTS... I wish that you could be able to power up the builder huts so that you could get double the amount of builders but it would cost a bit more than powering up collectors. Or you could just make it so we can level them up to a max of like 2 or 3. ARMYS FIGHT BACK... I wish that when someone attacks you that 1/2 of your army would fight back, or even 1/4 if you will. It would make the game more of a challenge and you wouldn’t always lose so much trophies and gold/elixir/dark elixir. DARK ELIXIR AND COLLECTOR.... My one pet peeve about this game is how freaking hard it is to get the Dark Elixir! I wish that you could make it so that the Dark Elixir is much more easy to get. I am finding myself 9/10 times losing it then gaining it. I am always frustrated because it will take me 15 billion years to get the Barbarian king and eventually after that, the archer queen and Warden... It is a process that you need to fix!

reviews.t: Awesome. Requires patients , and strategy at higher levels
reviews.x: Great game. You can’t play this for a few months, this is a game you have to keep going. What I love about it most is that unlike other games all features are allowed without having to pay a dime, unless your impatient. Then you’ll spend real money. I haven’t spent a penny and have had years of fun, made friendships with my clan mates, teamwork, strategy, war, magic, and everything else combined. I highly recommend this game. At first attacks don’t require much strategy, but as you start hitting higher levels, your strategy and troop lineup and placement can make all the difference in the world. I absolutely love this game. You have no idea how many games I have downloaded and deleted out of getting bored. There have been times though where I have stopped playing for a couple months at a time, due mainly to time restraints, only to come back, pick up where I left off , and enjoy many new features. Each update brings new ideas. I love the clan league wars, the clan games, and most of all the potions and rewards that help you out tremendously. Remember at higher levels one building or troop upgrade may take you up to 15 days. I can iterate enough as to the level of patients required for this game. If you are impatient, it may not be the game for you. It’s like a police department. Everyone wants to be the detective or the sergeant, but you have to start from the bottom and work your way up. If I can give 1 million stars I would, but I’m only limited to 5 stars. Thank you supercell for creating this game and continuing to enhance and provide us players a better experience. By the way, I never write reviews unless a) the app really pisses me off, or b) I absolutely love it, and in this case the lather. Enjoy! (Mr. kharcuss- blue lives matter clan)

All the troops are awesome and very fun to use. It takes a long time to get good, but im more concerned about all the bots that come in your clan, give you a “free gems” link and leave. And then 1 minute later another one comes. This has been happening less lately since i have been fast enough to kick them or report them before they leave, and also ive been playing for 5 years, but other than those dumb bots its a great game. I play it about 6 times a day, 3 hours total but still only get around 500,000 gold and elixir each day. Since some of my upgrades cost 7 million gold, and i get about 250,000 gold taken from me every other night, it takes almost 3 weeks to get a single upgrade. Another thing i want to see change is the barbarian and archer queen costs. It makes sense because they are the best troop that they would cost the best currency, but the archer queen cost is straight up stupid. It costs 40,000 dark elixir to get archer queen, but 10,000 to upgrade her? Like seriously. Other than that, very addictive in a good way, and a fun way to spend some free time.

reviews.t: Great game, but fix the AI and the clan matchups
reviews.x: The game is great: fun, interactive, and more. But when I attack sometimes the Ai in the troops doesn’t make sense. It might just be part of the game, but the Ai should at least follow some common sense. For example, if there is a giant, and he is 5 tiles from an archer tower that is surrounded by walls, but 15 tiles away from another archer tower with no walls, the giant will go for the archer tower with no walls, regardless of wall level or archer tower level. If there is a closer object, those troops should target that object, such as in the giant example, where he should have targeted the archer tower with walls. Second of all, the clan matchups are not balanced. I am in a lvl 3 clan with decent players, but we only have around 5-7 players th 9 and above in wars. We get matched up with clans that are lvl 8-10, with almost all player having a th above 8. In the matchups, the war is already won, before anyone even battles. The wars usually end up either us demolishing the opposing team or vice versa. There was never in an inbetween where the players are tied in stars. My recommendation is to match up the clans based on a win-loss ratio. For example, a clan with 50% win rate might get paired up with a 45-55% win rate clan instead of a 30% or 85% win rate clan. Anyways, this is a great game, but some things can be really frustrating.

This game is very good but we need updates for the future. The 1st thing we need to have for the future would be another new island. The island would be a tropical clash island where there could be new troops and where you can attack by using search to find an opponent with gold from that base and defend your tropical base and the ship should have blue sails and is bigger than the master builders ship and you would still have gold and elixir and you would have an islander builder. There should also be a hero called the volcanic wizard for the tropical island clash base. You have to unlock it at town hall 6.The 2nd thing we need is a sea trader that would give you gold, elixir and dark elixir and would arrive to your village at town hall 6. The 3rd future idea would be a clash TV where you could watch someone attacking a base and it should also be seen in builder hall and your village. The final idea would be to add royal barracks and it can be unlocked in town hall 5 and it would have royal troops like the knight,prince,princess and more as well as the rascals. Hopefully you read this.

Okay let me get this straight, I have been constantly entertained by this game, as I have been playing it about 4 years now. The only problem I have with this game is with the clan wars, if you attack two players and get a star, you get the extra reward based on who you attacked. Well my problem is in the top right corner it will tell you that you have an extra bonus loot number and it will tell you that you will recieve the bonus loot from the two players you attacked, but when you get to collect it you only get one of the bonus extra loot, it really does go a long way if you are trying to upgrade your defenses and build your base to be better, If we could get this fixed I would be super happy about this game, but other than that I would highly recommend this game to patient players, it is really fun upgrading defenses, troops and attacking, it is entertaining to see your base develop over time as you begin upgrading stuff. If we could get this fixed Supercell, I would be Super Happy.:)

reviews.t: Great game! Just a few issues
reviews.x: I enjoy this game a lot since it really does give me a fun time and a good experience! Most the time I would build something new and find out what it does to use it effectively in defense. I also enjoy how some defenses have different effects on certain troops. Like how the Tesla does even more damage to a Pekka or that a goblin cannot trigger spring traps. It add a lot of strategy to the way you design your base! My only main issues I really have is even though that I do understand it’s supposed to be expensive to unlock new things a have to say that some things cost way to much gold or elixir. Like that the air sweeper costs 150,000 gold even though it doesn’t to much damage and only blows enemies back a certain amount. Maybe make it cost 80,000 or at the most 100,000? The other only main issue I have is that the order you unlock new troops in the barracks can be a little odd like that the giant comes before the goblin. I understand that the goblins really fast and aims for loot but the giant seems way better once you get him to a good level. However overall I give this game 5 stars! You deserve it!

Great game very great energy as long as you join the right clan the concept isn’t at all unique but the twist to the concept of a strategic base building game done by supercell make it unique within itself and that aspect draws my attention although the game is very fun and challenging in many forms it’s still proposes as a very time consuming game it is almost as if it too strongly encourages the spending factor to create in a sense a pay to win type of game but even then the ranking system makes for a good balance to counteract that point of focus I do in fact wish times for upgrades were shortened but it would not make the game a strive for success as much as it does the way it is approached now but overall this game is fun, delightful to play with friends, very very strategic, and also easy to use and I enjoy the gameplay despite the flaws but you know what good game doesn’t have its kinks to work out and supercell does a great job of listening and working on all problems to further increase the gameplay in itself!😇

reviews.t: Like it but don’t love it.
reviews.x: I have been playing this game for a while. I’m a max th10. Don’t really want to go to th11. But I feel like there could be some more features and updates to the game. For instance, let’s say if we’re offline and someone is attacking our village. I feel like if I catch the attack live that i should be able to use my hero’s special abilities even while the person is attacking. They are just sitting ducks at that point. Also, I see that the training time for most troops and spells have gone down a bit. But why are the upgrade cost still soo high and they take soo long to finish upgrading. I mean 1 million gold or elixir PER wall is kind of ridiculous in my opinion. Times that by however many walls your village has and it’s well over 100 million gold or elixir. Or when you upgrade a inferno tower or even troops can take upwards to 8-10 days!?? I could travel the world and back in less days. Overall I like the game but don’t love it. Maybe a few changes and updates will change my mind.

I’ve been playing this game for about 5 years, majority of the time I’ve been in the same clan which was like a family. Our co has been inactive for quite some time and more than half of our clan is full of inactive co because some guy joined and got co somehow and invited/promoted anyone and everyone. Long story short everyone who was once a family and left and gone there separate ways because super cell REFUSES to give someone else leader ship due to the fact that there are still co leaders in the clan who lime I said before are inactive. Even if we were a full clan we would only be able to do 15-15 wars due to the fact of inactivity. I have tried to message supercell a few times about this because I am the oldest member of the clan and would like all of our hard work to be for not. They will not help and I have had a few of the customer service representatives close the conversation before I even have a chance to talk to them about concerns and needs. All in all this isn't a bad game but you can tell the people who run it only care about you spending money on their game. You would be better off investing your time on literally any other game because in the end, whatever you’ve put into it, SuperCell doesn’t care.

reviews.t: After a long-time supporter, I think I need to call it quits
reviews.x: I’ve played for a long time, not a huge gamer, but this was my one addiction. Loved it throughout the years, but I felt strongly that I needed to stop due to the time it took away from other things. I kept saying, this is when I’m going to quit...and then it would prove to be an idle threat. Recently, the match making for multi-player takes forever...I don’t have that kind of time to dedicate to Super Cell getting their matching software together. This is probably the main reason why I am upset with the game. However, I’ve also noticed that someone who has higher XP and a more developed base, will smoke me on trophies, but when I 3 star a better base (and higher rated player) and I won’t get nearly the same amount of trophies. And the builder base matching is even worse. Ultimately, I do believe some of the theories on Super Cell rigging the software to keep you frustrated and desiring more. I only slightly regret the money I’ve given them, because I have had fun playing, but in the long run, it is much better to spend the time with your family and friends than letting Super Cell dictate your frustration levels.

reviews.t: Great game but customer service isn’t
reviews.x: Amazing game, don’t get me wrong. I’ve played it from 2013 to now and i’ve has lots of fun with it. I got up to town hall 8 with my original village, but when i returned earlier this month, my account got removed from my icloud. I was greatly disappointed and saddened from this, so i contacted supercell through the app and got some amazing help IN THE BEGINNING. It was all going swimmingly when i was informed they couldn’t recover my old base. I was not angered at this because i had already made good progress on my new account and had spent money on this account. Earlier this morning however, i woke up to a message from Supercell saying “i see you have logged on to your missing village! Congratulations!” But i hadn’t. I was confused and said i didn’t have access to my first account with the correct download receipts from 2013. I knew my old account wasn’t coming back, but i had spent 10 dollars on my new account and mad really good progress, so i was excited to be back into the game. About 2 hours ago i logged on to the app to see I was Banned for “Account phishing”. I now have lost 2 accounts, both dear to me and am very unhappy with the service i’ve revived. Gameplay wise, it’s incredible, but just make sure to connect your account if you don’t want it deleted or banned.

reviews.t: Great game but I have an idea
reviews.x: So, I have been playing coc for about 3 years, and I really like it. But for a while, I’ve been thinking and gathering ideas from other players. I think you guys at Supercell should host daily tournaments for clans. What you would do is split the tournaments into 8,16, or even 32 clans in one lineup. A “game” is like war, except only for 12 hours. And if your clan wins it all, each player should receive 250 gems, 500,000 coins, and 500,000 elixir. You have to enter a tournament and you only have 24 hours to prepare. Each clan has to have 15 members or more. And other than that, any clan can join any tournament. And I also think if y’all do this, you should be able to invite clans that your friend is in so you 2 can compete against each other. So yeah, I hope you can agree to this and I’m fine if you do it, you can change some stuff up a bit. From CarsonPlayz_YT aka Rushed Crusher (But not for long :)

So I’ve been playing clash of clans on and off for around 2 years and I’ve actually put effort into the game and I’ve noticed some things that get on my nerves well one collecting recourses isn’t hard it’s a strategy game there are many many ways to collect recourses not only from you collectors and some upgrades are costly but my problem is the time it takes to upgrade things.. now I understand the more time clash consumes from us the more money you’ll make but as a rushed townhall nine say i wanna upgrade a tower 4 days upgrade a cannon that’s a few days everything is days with extremely gets on my nerves but I completely understand why it’s that way and second I wanna talk about the builder base you could have added farms trade villages or extra things to collect recourses with But no you decided to add another base to the game to basically trash all of our hard work and time on our main base and for the fact there’s only one builder Cmon clash the gem mine is also cool but 3-4 gems every 4-5 days is outrageous but other wise than those thing I love clash of clans :) 💕

*Please read till end. Potential way to increase in game sales.* I understand why many games have gone to free downloads with paid in game content/boosts/upgrades/currency etc. Of course I’d rather pay a fair price one time but this style allows you to get a boost from time to time. Which is nice. And we know its good for the developers because they can continue to improve the game and make a profit. BUT, can we please get better pricing on the walls? I’ll spend money to upgrade weapons and buildings. But walls cost way too much. With so many great air troops and jump spells/abilities I find the best use for walls is just to divert the few troops who like to walk around. I know there are many layouts where even low level walls will divert troops long enough for weapons to take them out. But normally they just get destroyed way too fast. And it’s tough to upgrade the walls even while spending a fair amount of money. I used to play in the arcades as a child. I may have spent $5-10 but I got several hours of entertainment. $20 in CoC gets you nothing when it comes to walls. At my level about $20 will let me upgrade 8 wall pieces out of 300! I know there are more expensive upgrades. But this is for walls! Unless you put archers or laser cannons on top of the walls I can’t see them being worth that much. Just a joke. Not a real suggestion. BUT! You ever think about shock damage on walls? Make us buy and build generators that power the walls? Everything is else is great. Keep the good content coming. Thanks if you read this whole thing. Joe

This is in response to the below reviewer who said the servers go for every 6-1/2 minutes or so. Almost every time I lost connection to the servers, it’s because my Internet connection to my own router or modem was spotty. The only exception to this is if I got kicked off because a game or server update started as I was playing the game. This is coming from a CoC player since the game was released years ago. The designs are unique and the game constantly tries to add new features like builder mode, clan wars, etc. It’s not difficult to build up your town unless you’re impatient and want to be the best person within a week. All games take patience, skill/strategy, and time to improve (1) stats and (2) experience. Great game. I often delete it because it’s easy to get addicted to, but that’s the only downside I can think of adding. Even then, that’s a personal problem because the game is fun!

reviews.t: The only game I play every day
reviews.x: This has been one of my favorite games for years. It’s very addicting and a lot of fun. Playing with friends and joining different clans across the world adds to the fun. Friends in your clan can donate army’s and spells to help you attack other clans. I would give this game a 9/10. This game will always be a staple to have for mobile games. The only down side is the long wait times to build in your village. The higher level you are, the longer the wait time is to build. Some building take days to upgrade and some building take almost weeks to build if you are at a higher level. I would even watch ads or play mini games if I could speed up the building times. It’s the most annoying part of this game. But all and all this game is worth the time you put into it. I’ve been playing it for years and years. If you are reading this review go ahead and download clash of clans now, you won’t regret it.

reviews.x: When u play this u see a person that is townhall 12 ur like oh crap this is gonna take along time but tenchniqually u start as a town hall 3 and it goes bye really fast until u reach town hall 8 me myself got it a few months ago I am a town hall lvl 7 and everything is fine just getting my king and stuff and my dark purple walls I recommend don’t use gems save them for your builders to get more yes it may take awhile to save up but the more builders u have the faster stuff goes I recommend 4 builders DONT RUSH it will be ur weakness take ur time upgrade ur walls upgrade ur defenses upgrade elixir and gold mines if u rush u will be a town hall lvl 11 down at silver 1 also upgrade ur troops to the max then upgrade ur town hall before u do that make sure u are fully ready to all clash of clans people also great gameplay, graphics, animations, pictures, it is one of the best games in this world also if u don’t like this game go check out clash of Royale amazing 1v1 to 2v2 game I really recommend all supercell games

reviews.t: Game is fun, but needs improvements
reviews.x: Hey guys, hopefully this review will make it to the supercell team. I have played this game for awhile and as a player I’ve noticed the dificulteis it is to climb to the top. To start with I want to talk about upgrading the walls. I’m at a point where my next walls upgrade will be 4mil per wall. This seems very unbalanced compared to what it costs to upgrade the buildings. I do want to say tho, thank you supercell team for coming out with the magic books!!! I just couldn’t bear the idea of waiting a month for a TH upgrade! Anyhow, the walls, way too expensive to upgrade, 4mil for a single piece of wall when a defense building costs only about twice as that, “maybe a way to add a less expensive way to upgrade the walls if you choose to let your builder work on it for awhile? Just an idea!” Many players have very rushed walls and it seems like a general issue. Another thing are the heroes, I mean, come on, 3 heroes, and my queen now costs 90k DE to upgrade. It would be fine if it was 1 heroes, now upgrading all 3, plus the lab troops with just a couple DE colector. By the way, thanks for adding the boost for 1 gem only for the collectors!! Overall I think the game is cool, but the people at the bottom are struggling to get to top, need to ease a little on the costs of these things. Thanks for reading!
