reviews.t: Biggest cash grab on the App Store
reviews.x: I’ve played clash of clans for roughly 3 years. Multiple times I have maxed out almost everything. This means that multiple times I got to spend all of my resources on maxing an item out. Why multiple? Because Supercell decides to update their game every few months and add in more levels to everything. For the people who have already had these buildings or troops maxed out get to pay the same amount of resources to upgrade it again. When Supercell adds new levels they reduce the cost of previous levels. However, to the people who already have the highest level this means absolutely nothing. You get to spend the same amount of resources to level everything up again when you already spent more than it is currently worth. Perhaps I wouldn’t have an issue with this if supercell gave back to the players who already paid more for an upgrade than its now worth. This has happened a handful of times throughout my history of playing this game, and because of that I’m done with this game for good. If you wanna put hours of time into this game to see your progression mean absolutely nothing then continue on with this game.

reviews.t: Honestly the best game for mobile games.
reviews.x: Alright so this is a long due review for this game. I’ve had this game for roughly five years and I gotta say that the replay ability in this game is amazing. Yes you will get burnt out and yes you will say “OMG THESE UPGRADE TIMES ARE OUTRAGEOUS” but let me tell you that it is all worth it in the end. Another great thing I myself find great about this game is how you can play both casually or competitively and have rewarding experiences both ways. Big appreciation to the devs for listing to critics and players and making improvements to the game. This game has come a long way and has become an amazing game. If you enjoy clash of clans I highly recommend checking out the few other games Super cell has put out there. I’m not much of a reviewer but as a person who has played video games my whole life I’ve gotta say this game definitely stands out among other great games. Thanks for reading this hopefully you enjoy the game and thanks Super Cell for such an amazing game!

I started this game in early 2014 and ever since then it has become my favorite mobile game ever. It’s mix of strategic base-building and attacking make it a very addictive game that will keep you on for hours. The clean and smooth running graphics make it very appealing to the eye and, in general, the game is very bright and vibrant. Although it is an old game from 2012, it seems new with the brand new Th12 coming out and more and more updates coming out. Although, as you get up Th8 and above (I’m currently a Th9,) the upgrades get a lot pricier and take more time to upgrade. This means that it isn’t that of a Pay-To-Win game. You could also say that this makes the game harder and not too quick to finish. Having trophies is another great way of keeping players playing for a long time. This is a great game that I think has something for all players. Have a great day and keep on clashing!

In this game you build a village you can make a clan of up to 50 people or you can join a clan that someone has made then you can join into what’s called clan wars. When you first start out the match making is very good ( not the war match making regular attacking) as you move up in town halls you get your barbarian king and later your queen. Now this all sounds good and by the time you get your king and queen and then also your grand warden wizard the match making becomes very unfair. They have these things called leagues I’ll come back to that in a sec they also have levels in this game levels are nothing this whole game is based off what town hall level you are. So going back to the league your placed in one and every so often it rests...why ...? Good question you can email customer support but don’t expect an answer...so as you build your base and like you can attack people,people can also attack you and like at the beginning you can beat the person your attacking because your much stronger and people can attack you that are much stronger most often a level and some times a league above you. You can can email customer support and ask them to explain why but honestly don’t bother it’s a waste of time. They say we have over 1 million 5 stars I wonder about that. You would think if they have over a million 5 stars they would match people up better......when you spend a lot of time getting loot and upgrading stuff only to have it taken by someone who is 2 times strong then you. This is not just a one time thing this is an on going thing in this game if you don’t spend money on the game to build your base to max lvl they don’t care.

reviews.t: I enjoy playing this game but I give this two stars because...
reviews.x: The reason I’m giving the game two stars is because of the power potion. There’s the term “rushing” and there’s the term “engineering” the reason I hate the power potion is because in war, there’s a good chance ESPECIALLY AFTER THE CLAN GAMES which happen every week, that a “max town hall” or a town hall 11 is majorly rushed with the war weight of a town hall 6, and I’ve seen lower. In the last war my clan had, we went against a stacked level, and ONE engineered base. I don’t mean to be a crybaby about the rewards given from clan games, but personally, I think a lot of people feel how I feel with the power potion. I also feel that the majority of clashers DONT EVEN NEED THE POWER POTION. After all, not everyone’s an engineer. I believe my clan mate “Dre Day” has become inactive due to engineers and power potion. WHICH IS A BAD COMBINATION. It’s terrible to see a town hall 11 with LEVEL ONE CANNONS AND ARCHER TOWERS three starring a near max town hall nine. I know I’m not the only one who dislikes engineering bases, so if anyone from supercell reads this, PLEASE HEAR ME OUT. I really enjoy this game and I’d hate to see it fall apart just cause a minority of players which are town hall 11 or 12 decides to only upgrade their laboratory. PLEASE SUPERCELL, IF ITS NOT TOO MUCH TO ASK REMOVE THE POWER POTION OR AT LEAST EDIT IT SO THAT TROOPS ARE ONLY RAGED FOR THE FIRST THIRTY SECONDS OF BATTLE AND NOT MAXED OUT FOR PROVIDED TOWN HALL’S LAB. Thank you for listening to your consumers and thank you for creating one of the best games of all time, and PLEASE DONT LET THE GAME FALL APART JUST BECAUSE OF ENGINEERS.

My sons and husband have been playing this together and with family friends for over two years. This is a game where it takes considerable time to grow in your clans, your networking, etc. Our sons also used their own money to occasionally invest in their clans. It’s a traditional, end of the evening down-time that they all look forward to every night, and it IS a fun game. About two weeks ago, my ten year old lost access to his own clan and all his own stuff, for no known reason. We did the right thing and contacted the managers of this game. Their automated system asked a ton of time consuming questions, that my husband helped with, including clan names, iPad model, money vested, etc...over two years worth. Instead of restoring our son’s stuff, they blocked him completely out of Clash of Clans and made the ridiculous excuse of “phishing”. He doesn’t even know what that is! There is nothing we can do. We have a ten year old booted out of all his creation, his own money, and out of the family’s traditional recreation time, where he was also connected with friends from our previous home town. He is devastated, and there is nothing we can do. There is no one to hold accountable. Consider yourself warned.

reviews.t: Great game, completely free to play, minor issues
reviews.x: I got clash of clans at least two years ago, and I love it to this day. The strategies are good, and the game has something that all the copies don’t. But that doesn’t mean it doesn’t have problems. I am currently play on a different device that I started, due to kindle fires not having a backup to stop you from losing all progress after updating. However, that is a simple problem to fix, just don’t play on a kindle fire. The next problem it has is the extremism prices of walls. When you get highs level in this game the wall prices exponentially skyrocket, costing millions of the in game currency to upgrade just a single wall segment. Then the finally problem is how long it takes to get high level. It can take years to get into the higher level ranks, and by then most people stop. However, I think these problems are out weighed by the game’s style and how it never asks for money to play. It’s graphics, play style, and community are amazing. Thanks for reading this mega review. I think I took too much time out of my day to write it.

So I hear a lot of people complain that theirs so much ground defense when it comes to coc that u can’t do nothing unless u attack from the air and that theirs not enough air defenses available for your bases that I agree with but not being able to attack on the ground that just isn’t so I’ve been playing this game about 4 years now I don’t think I’ve ever used air attacks I use the same troops and spells every attack for any base all valks about 5 giants and about 9 wizards and 1 pekke I use 4 quake spells to take out their outside wall spread the giant along that wall to take fire then spread wizards out to take out any out side obstacle when their cleared I drop my pekke then about 18 valks in a single file line the i non stop drop my 4 rage spells plus my one haste spell ware the hole base is covered in about 30 seconds I wipe out maxed out town hall 11s i 100% them about 15% of the time the other 85% I take out about 90% of the base if u get used to using this troop method I promise u will never look at any other troops again I’ll 2 star a maxed out th11 with this method 19 out of 20 times every time and I’ll get 1 star on #20 I never loose

I love this game and have been playing it for a long time, and there are very few things I need to complain about, but one of the main problems I encounter in the game is the upgrade times for buildings. In the beginning of the game things only take a few hours to upgrade and then they start to take longer amounts of time to upgrade as their levels go up, which is understandable. But, once you get to townhall 9 and above, things start to take over a week to upgrade, and with a limited amount of builders, this can be very frustrating since you can only upgrade a certain amount of things before waiting a week which results in a very slow feel in the game. Recently, there was an event called the Hammer Jam, in which everything upgraded 2x faster than normal. I thought the reduced times were much more realistic since they still took a few days but not weeks and it really helped me advance my base and increase my love of the game.

reviews.t: Possible solution for some of these other reviews.
reviews.x: Great strategy game. I have a max th10 and near max th7. Definitely get in a clan as soon as you can if you’re new and communicate with the other members. I’m a co/former leader of a clan that merged back into our diminished “old” clan (long story). Been warring with the same group of guys for years, 500+ war wins with a little over 100 losses. Stop by and check us out, DOOM, lvl 14 clan. So.. for the point of this review, I’ve read a few that don’t like losing their troops after successful raids. I’ve always thought it’d be a good idea to have a “donation pot,” call it whatever you want. But the point is for players to be able to go to a screen where members have donated troops and pick out whichever ones are available instead of requesting troops. Obviously requesting is still an option. It would be good for members who have a bunch of troops queued and no where to send them at the time. So to kind of please the people who lose troops at the end of the raid, it’d be cool to dump all those troops in the pot too so they’re not completely lost. Very good game, and the latest update was great 👌🏼

It used to be a 4 Star because of one problem: lagging and overpriced stuff. Now it’s a 3 Star because the problem is getting worse. The updates you made recently are super cool, but what has been a problem that has STILL not been fixed is the lagging and annoying ‘no connection; retry’ message even though I’m connected to WiFi. Yes, my WiFi has problems sometimes. But I know this is not the WiFi because other online apps work perfectly fine - games and social media. If I’m during an attack, the message will pop up and I’ll be forced to retry to connect even if I’m not finished. Then I’ll lose trophies. Even worse is when it happens during an attack during war. It’s super annoying and I can’t even have a conversation for ten minutes without it popping up or even showing the WiFi bar warning thing. I’ve lost a lot of trophies because of it, lost opportunities to attack because of it. I know it’s not just me because multiple other people I know have to deal with this. It’s at the point where it’s so annoying it’s not fun to play. Please fix it.

So first of all, I would like to say that this game is amazing. I’ve been playing for about a year, then had a break, and now I came back, but that’s not what this review is about. In this review I would like to give suggestions for the future of the game. In the future, you should add “building queues,” which is a feature that allows you to plan out your builds and make it so one thing starts building/upgrading after the previous building. This will benefit players in many ways. Another suggestion I have is to raise the gem mines’ “gem per day,” since it’s fairly low even at max level. Even remove obstacles with give you more gems much faster, so the gem mine now would be pretty much useless. My last suggestion is to release the Santa’s Surprise spell once again in Clashmas 2018, since it would be nice to have it for just one more year! Anyways, thanks for reading my long review, and again, this game is amazing! (5 stars)

reviews.t: Fun at first, gets old quick
reviews.x: This game would be so much more fun if it didn't take forever just to be able to save up the resources to upgrade anything. Whenever you are finally able to upgrade anything it takes FOREVER!!!! When you get up to the higher town halls you will have to wait up to 10 days for a single building that took you a month to save for because you get attacked 3 times a day. The builder base made a few improvements from the regular base but the higher you go in that it starts to turn into the same situation except nobody attacks you, that said if you don't attack other people regularly you will never be able to save up for anything. The matchmaking is very poor, you will find that when playing against other people that they are better than you and its not really that close of a gap so you will rarely be able to win. The builder base is even worse for that as you will almost always find yourself matched up against somebody who has a higher level base, better defenses, and more troops. Not really worth your time unless you're willing to put real money into the game to be able to upgrade troops, walls, and buildings faster.

I am only 13, and not old, but this is a great game. If your kid wants this game because he/she says it is educational, that IS a lie. This game is not educational, however there is managing currency, SLIGHTLY. But it is still fun. Now, another thing is, you can build a “village”, and there are some villages out there that use walls and other buildings to create bad images, BUT that is not a big problem. Those are very rare. A final thing is that there is clan chat (A clan is where players can join together) and a global chat. Players can cuss and swear, I have had this instance once, but there are solutions to this. 1. Filter clan chat. Once you join the game, you can go to the options menu, and tap filter clan chat. This will help greatly. 2. Invite only. When you create a clan, you can make it so that only the leader and co leaders can accept players to join. But all in all, this is a great game where friends and strangers alike can come together and dominate the world! (In game of course) -TheCarsonKid TH 9 THUNDER HEROES PS this game is free

This game is amazing! I enjoy re designing my village and upgrading my items. The thing I like most about this game though, is that everything is balanced, while I’m writing this review, I’m at town hall level 7 and so far in the game, I’ve noticed a certain balance. Nothing is too overpowered, yet, some troops are better than others, and some aren’t, regular barbarians can make up in numbers what they don’t do in damage, but then they can be easily overcome by bombs. Then as you unlock the more powerful troops, it’s more so the opposite, such as giants, because they take up more room. I also like how there are many different battle strategies that all work, and how as you upgrade, everything gets better, but things also get more expensive, yet again, the balance. What I’m trying to say here is that nothing is overpowered in this game, and everything is balanced. Great Work!! I don’t believe I’ve ever seen a game of this type this good

reviews.t: This game used to be fun but now...
reviews.x: This game was great a long time ago, but the endless parade of changes in the name of “support” have ruined it. You work hard to achieve maxing the game then when you do the goal is to try to be the top trophy winner, but there’s seemingly an unbalanced system for top players. You spend hours, literally, not figuratively in a matchmaking waiting screen to attack someone for a paltry number of trophies and then when you’ve done this 2-3 times the system allows some equivalent leveled player from a lower league to take more trophies than you’ve earned in your entire day forcing you to play twice as much to make up the difference. The only way this is sustainable is how the players in the top clans do it, by having multiple people playing a single account, or to have no life outside the game. I’m afraid that there’s no incentive to actually reach the top in this game. It’s only fun when your level is low. Addressing Clan wars, there’s no way to win at those either because either you’re up against clans engineered to win by exploiting the matchmaking system or by cheating in one of several ways making you wonder how your top ranked clan just got entirely wiped out by an entire clan. This game used to be fun, but now it’s just stressful.

reviews.t: Great Game! Just a few issues...
reviews.x: First of all, I love this game. It’s fun, addicting, cooperative, competitive, and plays smooth. The home village has great gameplay with clans and clan games! Although it can be seen as pay to win, it’s really not that bad, at least not NEARLY as bad as Clash Royale which I don’t play anymore. My only complaints are with the Builder Base and the Trader First, the Builder Base, it’s completely pointless and boring. The gameplay really doesn’t add that much to the game and I only go to the builder base to collect loot. Also, the matchmaking is a complete joke. I’m currently a Builder Hall 5, and 9/10 times I face a bh 6 or 7. It’s complete BS, I lose almost every time because of their higher level troops and base. Also, builder games better not continue because I will actually quit clan games if they do, the builder base is worthless. Second, the Trader. When I first saw the announcement I was genuinely excited, but when I saw the update I was very disappointed, yet another attempt for more money from Supercell. It’s complete bs that you have to use gems to buy crap items that you can acquire through clan games! Plus, they are SO EXPENSIVE it costs 400 gems for a ring of walls when it takes 3 to upgrade ONE wall to level 9! Yah, never using the Trader until they change it to Gold, Elixir, and Dark Elixir. Sorry for the rant, I really do like this game, I’m just letting Supercell know my thoughts on the current state of the game. My review will change with time.

I have to say this game can be addicting and I agree with others who say that once you get to the top levels it does get expensive. I do love it when the developers give us days to boost for 1 gem and also when they give us days where troops or potions are cheaper THANK YOU. The only reason I have it at 4 stars is because if the developer reads this I would like them to know it’s a good game one, and two please let us keep our surviving and victorious troops after we get 100% victory in a battle. I kind of made up my own thinking when my king survived but was sleeping, my thinking was that he needed rest... but now that I’ve read what others have to say, I agree that those troops should be ready for next battle. Esp with how expensive it can be in the later levels. I want to max out everything before moving up a town hall but to be honest it seems like it would take forever. But I have plenty time. I usually play the game when I have 5 min in the am and before bed. Battle until I can’t cause I have to wait for troops and potions to train/be ready. Overall pretty cool game.

Hey guys. I’ve been playing this game non-stop for 2.5 years and I still love it just as much as the beginning. I have 3 accounts with the biggest being a maxed th9 about to be a th10. Clan games are interactive, wars are fun and genius and attacking is practical and requires strategy and tactic. The reason i think people think walls are overpriced is because people focus too much on progressing the base and getting bigger and less about the teamwork that makes clash stand out from other iOS games EVEN clash royale. Supercell did an INSANE job at matching up the amount of elixer needed AND gold needed to build and max ones base. If walls were any cheaper, Wed see massive stockpiles of gold on people bases when u try to attack a near-maxed TH. My th9s troops and walls are going to max AT EXACTLY THE SAME TIME. After about th8 it mostly becomes a focus on getting into a clan that suits you and trying to build a war streak with other buddies. It’s really the construction of a strong clan that makes the game fun. U can do that at most any level. Not good at wars? 1. Get better, 2. Clan games! Everyone can do those and they make the clan look good. If ur impatient, we’ll that’s why they made clash royale. If ur a strategy and businessman like me, this is the game for you. Thanks for reading!

reviews.t: Got banned trying to recover account
reviews.x: A year and half ago I stopped playing. Got a new phone couldn’t upload my old city. Tried to get it back. Provided receipts and answers what I could about my old village in an attempt to get it back. Of course supercell is too big of a company to talk to us mere peon customers person to person and after getting responses from and automated response customers service “agent” named Christine. Who I quote as saying, “we believe you that this is your village please provide us with receipts of purchase which I did, I did not get any response except permanent banishment from the game for trying “steal” an account that has my last time in it... the SAME name that’s on the card I used to make gem purchases. The village hasn’t been used in two years, has my name on it, I provided receipts and bc no actually person would talk to me and work with me I get banned with no warning. And of course all the money I’ve spent is now in their pockets and I highly doubt I will be refunded. Very disappointed in supercell. Be careful how you spend your money here they do not care about you as a customer. All they want is impulse buyers who keep their mouths shut apparently.

reviews.t: Supercell plz fix this I beg you
reviews.x: I'm sad because I have a ios 5 iPad and I can't update it any ,ore so now I can't get in flash of clans and I was a th7 and it took me a whole year to get this far and I don't remember any of my clash clans information to link the device or put it in my new phone :( I think I need to star all over but them it is not fun anymore because it's not my first base I built and I'm just so sad because m sitting here thinking did i really use all those hours that really just got wasted in my life if there could please be a update or something to allow you to play clash of clams in a older version please and I bet there are other people just like me in my same position except they have an even height TH and mabye they played since then game came out like three years ago and they probably hade a I pad like mine and now guess what they go into clash of clans and they find out the cant get in and they wasted all those hours and time to get that it's a horrible feeling and to those people in the same position as me I just want to say your not the only one that is feeling the pain there many other people In the same position and plz supercell I just hope you can fix this that would not only help me but other people. Thank you whoever read this review.

Ive seen this game through most of its life, I’ve played for a total of 4 years so far. But that includes my first 2 accounts and this one. I remember when they first introduced heroes into the mix. Then friendly battles. Then clan wars. Then perhaps the most recent game changing update. The night village. When I first saw the boat on my screen I was filled with joy I can’t even begin to explain. I watched every captains log and waited patiently for the new update. Then it happened. In the span of about a week, the eye of the whole CoC community turned and set its sights on this new world. And like the colonial powers of old, me and everyone else flocked to this area and wanted to grow as fast as possible and began to spend more time there than in our main village. Battles dwindled and versus matches skyrocketed. I may not be the best, but I am happy where I am and I’m slowly upgrading my stuff. But all the time I cannot get over my love for this game and it’s features.

I have been playing this game since it came out and continue to do so everyday, with that being said I can tell you it’s addicting and fun. Things take longer to do the higher leveled you are and base setups can get harder to do but theres only been one issue and that’s the design flaws the game has. Examples such as being you can join a clan simply for troops and then leave, global chat being filled with “join my clan” 24/7, and lack of new content. There are others such as being able to raid a Townhall 5 with maxed out balloons you got from your Townhall 11 friend (lol what a joke) or being banned from global chat from making a joke while the people spamming “join me” are just fine. It’s a great game but the people and poor design it has can really be quite sad, the only major issues I would say to fix would be the chat spammers and being able to raid someone who just got the game with maxed troops, other than that the game is pretty great if you don’t mind spending a few $5 every now and then.

This game has been my go to mobile game for about 4 years now. I’ve played on and off in those years, and in that time I’ve gotten myself to level 102 and about halfway finished maxing my th9. This and Clash Royale are my all time favorite mobile games, and I have nothing but positive things to say until this. When you get into a high level clan, you will inevitably have some guy’s level 12 little brother in the clan with you, who will always wanna be giving you troops. It shouldn’t have to be said that when I request for balloons, I’m not asking for your little level 2s. But the kid won’t quit and no one will ever say anything cuz they don’t want to offend his level 135 brother, who happens to be co-leader. Supercell, I’m begging you. Put in request settings. When you go to request for troops, rather than typing up what you want in the box, I would like to see something where it just pulls up the little menu that has all the troops (sort of like when you are training troops) and you just tap the troop(s) you want, how many of each, and then maybe have a little slider bar with the minimum troop level that you will accept. This way people can’t troll you and give you stuff you don’t want.

I woke up this morning and my clash account reset some how I have no idea... anyway I contacted support and we went back and forth sending info needed in order to recover my account. I’m very specific with the details even providing them with info such as my wife being the clan leader and we two are the only ones in it. I provided him with all the purchase receipt needed and he tells me there’s nothing he could do... I firmly tell him “Nay, failure is not a option” he tells me there’s nothing he can do. I respond telling him, I followed all his direction to the T. There’s gotta be more then just giving up.... he has yet to respond going on now for 45min.. when I first contacted him he was replying every 5 to 10min... once I got onto him for giving up he stopped responding... I then provided new info and still have yet to receive any response.. I then told him if he didn’t wish to help me then to forward me to someone else since the app won’t allow me to leave until this guy responds... since he won’t respond I can’t receive any help from any other support specialist... all I know is this guys name is Casey... Very disappointed with his customer service. Hopefully the developers/support read these reviews and contact me.

Coc is a great game to play overall. All i ask is that developers add a function that allows us users to edit our number of active army troops. I would like to be able to switch my active troops with my reserved troops that i already have pre loaded so that i may be able to fight and go right into another fight with full troops. Only thing wrong with this is if all my troops arent used in the 1st attack the number of old troops are just added to my new active troops which makes it harder for me to attack in the formation that i liketo use to attack. Although there is donating, and i could get my desired number of troops by doing so eveyone doesnt always want what troops i may have to offer and to be fair and understanding to my clan mates i dont donate junk troops. Also its a waste to simply delete the troops for nothing in return, especially when i am low on mana and am attacking for 6 stars in hope of recieving the treasury bonus. Please read this in add this function!!

This game is fantastic! I have seen a lot of games like this before but this one is by far the best. The whole “clans” implementation is great. You get to work with other players to beat other other clans is one of my favorite features. Many will say that it’s amazing because it truly is! Boom Beach is as close as it gets to this game and it’s no competition for Clash of Clans. But like any game, it has flaws, one of which is the upgrade feature; I’m not sure I see the point in waiting 8 days to upgrade a Pekka to level 2 or waiting 14 days to upgrade a town hall to level 10. The second small flaw is the wall prices, it takes forever! It’s absurd that it cost 4 million gold or elixir a piece to upgrade the walls. 125 walls x 4,000,000 gold or elixir is a total of 500 million gold or elixir for just level 12 walls for only 125 of the walls that you have. But other than those small features, THE GAME IS FANTASTIC. If you want to join my clan it is “The Marvels.”

The builder base update was so sick. It brought me back to playing clash and I've enjoyed it. That is, until the clock tower nerf. It ruined the ability to get a consistent three wins when I have the time to boost. The nerf not only slowed the speed multiplier, but also drastically reduced the length. At lvl 5, I would've been able to attack at maximum time for all three winning battles. The problem is that (especially in higher tier battles) they can last up to the max time. That means I only get the boost effecting my training reducement once. This has ruined the fun of getting the attacks and made me less active once again. At least reduce the cool down time between boosts by more than one hour if you're going to cut the lengths of the boosts in half. Or just return it to the way it was. Also, add a give up option for versus battles when I know I’m going to lose. I’m tired of watching someone use all 4 mins of their attack when they beat me 1 minute and 30 seconds into their attack. It wastes my time and the already nerfed clock tower boost which, currently maxed, is only 9 mins. 9/4=2.25, meaning my boost could be wasted by only two attacks.

I love how all these people give it 5 stars yet they have negatives about the game. Anyway, cool game no doubt about it. Fun, addictive, and great presentation. The games gameplay seems good at first until you start playing. Overpowered characters that you can’t stop. Max dark witches on builder base can be stopped if you have the right defense, but if your opponent places them in the right spot there’s no base in the world that will defend against it. Troops are dumb. They attack random objects, stop halfway, turn around then go to another object. Matchmaking is horrendous in the builder base! You can get matched with a guy who has higher lvl defense than your troops can handle, and higher lvl troops than your defense can handle. It makes no sense for a guy with lvl 14 witches to be attacking a guy who has BH of 5 or 6 with 2-4 lvl troops less. Unlike most people, I don’t upgrade my Builder Hall until I upgrade everything. Others rush and unlock higher lvl defenses and troops and you get paired up with them anyway. So you get punished for playing the game properly while people who rush get rewarded. But at least they don’t forget to remind you how there’s new deals and packages you can buy at the shop. Ohhh goody!!

reviews.t: Dark elixir/Builder base and now clan games
reviews.x: So... dark elixir is so hard to get and even produce because it’s very slow. I don’t have enough resources to upgrade my drill/storage because it’s a lot. I may only be town hall 7 but maybe you could also just remove the builder base. The builder base is stupid and supports gemmers/rushers. It’s nice having gems but it’s hard fighting other players. You can’t upgrade anything because you don’t have enough resources if any at all. Just like dark elixir. You don’t have to listen or care about any of this but it’s just an opinion. You really don’t think about the very few do ya? Clan games, what a stupid idea. I’m alone in my clan so I can’t get rewards when I finish just because I couldn’t get enough points? If I can’t get 1000 points but 500 points instead then I require another member. That’s impossible because I don’t have 3000+ trophies. Think about those of us who don’t have as mush as the professionals and town hall 11 people. If you didn’t understand the 3000+ trophies thing that because people think you need a lot of trophies to be good and then people will flood to your clan. Make a statement to fix all the problems in YOUR game. People still town hall snipe. People still cheat their way to victory and if you can’t fix it, no one will. Just a suggestion but maybe we could controls our armies. It would make raids easier and would help people like me and other lower level town halls stand a chance to get what we need to advance in the game. It’s not a lot to ask the rest above this but are problems. This is only a suggestion.

I played forever in 2013 and loved the game. But recently wanted to redownload and get my village back. After contacting customer service I was asked several questions about the account which I answered. And then I was asked to send a receipt of any purchases made otherwise I couldn’t get my account back. I looked up and down to find the receipt but couldn’t. That was 4 years ago! After I said that to the customer service representative they kept giving me the same response that I had to “verify” my account even though I had answered several other questions. While I know it’s their policy I was never told anything in response to my problems other than “send the receipt” then the thread was ended by their side of the conversations. I found it rude that they would just end it. Then when I restarted the conversation I was told the same thing several times and told “repeated related messages” would not be looked into. Personally I felt that I was talking to a machine that didn’t understand me, when all I wanted was the get my 6th grade village back that I spent money on and worked on forever. Let alone I can’t even use the same nickname that’s become a trademark.

reviews.t: One small problem in new update
reviews.x: I’m giving one star so they will hopefully see this: Using one of the new boost potions, the one that temporarily upgrades your troop level to the maximum that your current laboratory level allows, it does work on the builder base, however, I noticed that there is a glitch in the fact that it does not actually increase the number of troops per camp. For a direct example that I experience, my current troop level for giants is lvl 6, and I used the potion so now it says that are lvl 8, and I know that at lvl 8 I should have 3 troops per camp, but I still only have 2. Then, when I attack, I noticed there is a UI glitch in the number of available troops. When I had picked giants for two army camps, it stacked 3 giant cards on one army camp but only 1 giant card for the second army camp. Then when I used all 4, it said I had 2 more left somehow, but I was unable to place them. Same thing happened for bombers. Hope you can clarify as to whether or not the potion in builder base actually increases the number of troops per camp, or not. If it does, hopefully it gets fixed soon. If it doesn’t, I don’t see a huge point in using such a potion for builder base.

I love this game to be completely honest. It has a great sense of progression with you upgrading your base over time. The upgrades are for the most part, balanced. The addition of Builder Bases was a great idea. Although I feel there are several great things about this game, there is one problem. This is, the people who you are matched up against in Builder Base battles. I upgrade all of my defenses and yet I am still being beat by people who are an entire Builder Base level higher than me. This gives them an upper hand. People should be matched against people of the same Builder Hall level so that everyone that is matched together will have the capability to get all upgrades that your opponent has and there is no advantage. This would make it so that you aren't being beaten by someone who has things you don't have access to at all. With this also being your main source of resources, you can barely upgrade due to the rare wins. Even when adjusting troop setups and strategies, I can't get a success. Now don't think I all of a sudden hate this game for that. It's a great game with one problem that doesn't even affect the entire game because this only affects your Builder Base and not your main base. Overall, I love this game.

I've been playing this game from the beginning and watched it evolve into what it's known as now and with the last update this year released today it makes this game much better the hype for clan game and your first war ever makes remembrance of this game when you are ever gone for a long time and draws you every time the servers are good and the balances also are great with 5 levels added to the barbarian king and archer queen dark elixir is hard to get but that's ok but there's one thing I would want for the next update is a recovery system for troops that survived the battle for example you can buy a new building at either TH7 or TH6 the building takes 1 day to make and you can take troops that that are wounded above 1/2 hp and it takes 1/2 the cost of elixir and takes 1/2 the time to heal and once healed they go back to the army camp and you can delete from the queue and so you don't have to reuse them and so if they're from a war attack they don't come back and about the other 1/2 that's under 1/2 hp they would all die I would like this and I know some other people would also like this and this game is awesome as I said and I would download this game on every platform I have if I could but this game isn't pay to win as a lot of people say because people say that you need to pay real money in order to get all the builder huts while it is very easy to do so you don't need to get real money to get all builder huts so no matter what people say as long as you have patience you can max everything out with 5 builder huts for free unlike people say just do what you need to do and want to do and until you stop playing keep on clashing And if you're reading this near x mas merry Christmas

I love this game. It’s super fun and super addictive! I started playing it a couple months ago and I’d recommend it to anyone! Some things get pricey as you get to the higher levels and that slows progress but most games are like that. The only problem I have had with the game is Supercell’s customer service. They are absolutely terrible. I just had an incident where I upgraded to a new phone and had problems loading my village to my new phone. First of all, they won’t let you call them. It’s email only and they take days to respond. Secondly, they told me they found my village and that I would need to answer 10 questions in order to verify. I answered the questions and thought ‘great! I’ll have my village back in no time!’. Man was I wrong. They told me that my answers were precise enough and that they wouldn’t give me my village back. I went back and forth with them for days. With them continuously telling me that they can’t help me and that I couldn’t have my village back. I finally just created a new Apple ID in order to re-save my old village on my old device. It was all such a hassle and they didn’t end up helping me at all. 10/10 would recommend the game but know going into it that the customer service is completely terrible.

Ever since the new builder base update the targeting system is Horrible. You place down troops and they go all the way across the map, and end up getting 0%. I seriously am thinking of deleting this game. And ive learned that the developers are just money hungry. All they want is you to spend money on this game and you keep doing it and they want you to do it more. They love when you pay real money just for the game. But than you realize i just wasted all my money and now im poor. Thats what im dealing with here. The targeting is horrible, the matches are horrible too. You can be a TH7 and match with a TH10 on your village base. And also the crusher is too good, because you place down troops hoping that they win it for you. But instead you get a loss. You dont really need a strategy, since your troops just do theyre own thing. You want them to get the TH they get a builder hut. You want them to get the loot, they get barracks. I really am mad at this game, ive spent lots of time trying to get maxed out an etc but end up losing all my loot and trophies to get in a new league. Im very mad at this.

Long story, I first start to play in 2012 and abandon it at th7 in 2013. Recently I start to play the game again and make it to th9. The game makes no difference during those years beside the builder base. Pro: addictive, objective driven, fragment play time so you can raid once every 20 min without stay online, this is the key factor for a successful mobile game. Even more fun with build base update. Can be casual or very challenge, most popular mobile platform game across the world, highly populated player base. Con: I personally consider this game is a pay to win game, why? For maxing your base defense, troops and hero lvl to max th 11 would takes you at least 3 years with hardcore playing style, which means u have to raid every 20 min and gain maximum loot every attack, beside extremely long construction time and research time and wall upgrade cost, it is not possible for new player to catch up without throwing huge gems or cash to short the time. Trust me, don’t play this game as a new player unless supercell nerf the waiting time for both construction and research or the hero upgrading, u feel like either u rage out or mass cash into this game. Supercell really need to learn how to balance the pay to win factor from blizzard entertainment, bliz games always have a friendly system to get new player to catch up the end game. Typically a game would be dead if new player feels no hope. Again don’t play this game if u r just about it start it. It’s fun at begin but it’s pain to complete your goals without spending thousands of dollars

I already gave up on the regular clash of clans mode because of all the waiting. An 40 minutes to an hour for one attack lol let's be serious who has the patience for that. We leave the game then forget our troops ready then forget about the whole game. But now I gave it a second chance with the builder base mode. I'm almost a max builder hall 5 but I'm just finishing my walls and troops before I go to 6 but I can't because IM TOO BUSY GETTING MATCHED WITH MAX BUILDER HALL 6s!!!! I get it that I'm a bit of a low level to be a BH5 at 2200 trophies but do you really expect me to believe that there are no other BH5s like me in my trophy range? They literally 3 star me with night witches or level 11+ cards ALL THE TIME!!! They have more and stronger troops, an extra Crusher, a max level roaster and more walls. I cannot win until I'm knocked allllll the way down to 2000 trophies and by that time my boost ran out (WHICH YOU NERFED FOR NO REASON AT ALL!!!) Unfortunately this brings me back to the same reason why I stopped playing clash of clans. I'll come back in about 3 months to see if my clock tower is ready... hopefully I don't forget about this game again.

I love Clash of Clans but seriously guys if this comment can even have the slightest chance in the world to be seen by anyone who works on the game itself, please the time for upgrades is absolutely ridiculous it’s so hard to gain as much loot as possible at times and as you get to TownHall 9 it gets worse from there unless you have lots of money to spend, for example there is a building that I want to upgrade but also keep in mind that from this one building there is also 4 or 5 more of the same kind of buildings so for that ONE building it would cost you about 6 million gold to upgrade and that 6 million will not come over night, then on top of that the time for that ONE building to finish upgrading is about 12 days...? Really? I have to wait this long for that ? Seriously it’s ridiculous. But anyways it’s a great game and I’m on it almost everyday, I’m still giving it the 5 stars it deserves.

I think Clash of Clans is a great game however I think their can be updates that can be more game changing and that Supercell should listen more to its fans or supporters. What I think should be added that would be game changing is a control hut or what ever you want to call it. So basically it is a small hut that adds 1 more space for your army. It's a small hut like thing that takes up the space of a builder hut. What it does is that it you have to train a troop, but you can't put heroes in here. When you train a troop it would cost elixer or dark elixer the neat thing is that to put a troop in there it would cost 2-3 times more of that resource or "loot". The reason for the name is because their are settings in the control hut that will either tell that troop to attack a building by tapping the building you want it to attack or a defending troop or it can not follow what it is supposed to do like for a golem in there it would instead attack resources or attack anything it wants. The buff the troop would get is 2 times damage. The debuffs is it has 3/4 of what the normal troop's health would be and half of the speed the troop normally has. The best part is that you can choose it to sleep or guard. The guard will act like a hero and defend in a normal cannon radius and sleep is for regenerating it's health meaning you have to let it sleep for a certain amount of time is 2-3 times the amount a level 30-45 hero's regeneration takes. If the troop dies in battle or defense you will have to retrain that troop and can't delete the troop from the hut, so until it dies you can't retrain a different troop. This building will also be available at town hall 10 or 11. This building will also cost 5,000,000 elixer to build and take 4 weeks to build. I think this a neat idea and that it is also fair. If you think this should be added then you can change anything you want about it even the name if you'd like. That is what I think should be added to the game.

Fun game takes a lot of your time away, Wife will hate it, because of how addicting it can be. They need to work out a few bugs when it comes to bases building war strategy’s only which makes it hard to even stand a chance at clan wars against these clans but it has gotten much better. I feel Troop’s are very well laid out and fair. Slow process of upgrading but well thought out for level design. Switching to use both gold and elixir for upgrading walls should be at TH 8 not TH9. because you can be stuck at th8 for months just trying to collect gold if you want to upgrade everything before moving to next TH which is the way I personally role. Extra base is a great way to pass time 👍👍thumbs up to designer and engineer of game on that one. I am done with the crap targeting. It is so stupid when your barbarian king sprints through your heal spells, past the defenses, to the other side of the map just to attack a builder hut. Ever since the builder base update the targeting went to crap, and I have lost so many battles in the builder base because my giants walked past the crusher to the other side of it to attack the cannon that was being upgraded. Please fix the targeting because I just can't play when all strategy goes out the window and you have to be lucky for your troops to target the building that was three feet in front of them and not the one behind it on the other side of the wall. Recently I spent an hour and a half building a new base, so that I could win more defenses and protect my loot, I hit the save base button it said it saved, and it didn't save. At the time I was worried that I might have to put some of my walls back in my base, because I have seen people missing walls after doing a huge redesign of their base, but I was not expecting to have to put my entire base back. In my opinion the developers are trying to find more ways to get money out of people and leaving huge glitches in the game and ignoring them, because they don't get money for fixing glitches.

This game is really fun I've been playing for over 4 years I do get a little inpatient at times waiting for buildings to be completed but I love upgrading all of the same type like the archer towers and see them turn from the wooden and green tower to the black with little skulls on them. The game designers have done a wonderful job keeping up with new features like new soldiers, buildings, and A Whole Other Base!!! The second builder base is a really interesting addition to the game "I do feel that the the crushers are a little overpowered but none the less cool" and as always the walls are Super hard to get to max level but once done is rewarding in itself!! Overall these games "Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Clash of Clans" the games made by The same game designers are fun and ever expanding and always being updated so if you start one up you'll have something to play for the next 5-10 years "unless you buy gems and rush through it which is fine and fun too :)!!!"

Builder base match making is ridiculous. It's impossible to get 3 wins in a day. I have a lvl 1 battle machine and I'd say about 90% of the time I get paired up with people who have maxed lvl 10. You get more trophies for winning than loosing so you normally have to loose twice and win once to stay consistent which is mental. Most troops are terrible like night witch and minions but other like barbarians and archers can be used with no skill and get guaranteed 1 star. Crushers are pretty overpowered. I've never seen a base where it isn't a crusher lure. The AI is mental and will walk to the other side of a base to run into a crusher if there is the slightest gap in walls. The only way to attack at higher levels is to use sucky air troops or pray you get lucky and your troops take it out right between the crushers attack. Also, guard post next to crusher is too obvious and agin troops will walk to the other side of a base is they even smell a hint at a guard post. Again, air troops on the regular base are below par with other strategies. They take equal skill but are significantly less effective. I think buffing minions on both sides of the bases are needed.
